definitions.definition: connected with the emotions

examples.text: He has no affective ties to his family.
examples.translation: 他对自己的家庭没有感情。

definitions.definition: ( especially of a nerve ) carrying something towards the centre of a body part
a written statement that someone makes after promising officially to tell the truth . An affidavit can be used as proof in a law court .
to cause a group to become part of or form a close relationship with another, usually larger , group , or organization
definitions.def_translation: 使并入，使隶属（较大的团体或组织）；使紧密联系

examples.text: a college affiliated to the University of Mumbai
examples.translation: 孟买大学附属学院

examples.text: The school is affiliated with a national association of driving schools.
examples.translation: 这所学校隶属于一个全国驾驶学校协会。

definitions.definition: an organization that is connected with or controlled by another, usually larger , organization

examples.text: Our college is an affiliate of the university.
examples.translation: 我们学院隶属于这所大学。

definitions.definition: a link on an internet page that takes you to a website where you can buy a product . The company that makes the product pays something to the owners of the internet page for every product they sell in this way.
definitions.def_translation: 联盟营销链接：顾客点击链接购买产品。品牌商通过网络，与带货推广者在带有这种链接的网页上合作销售产品，并与这些销售伙伴分享利润。

examples.text: This article contains affiliate links.
examples.translation: 本文包含营销链接。

examples.text: Remember that your main target is to drive web traffic to your site that will click on the affiliate links.
examples.translation: 请记住，您的主要目标是将网络流量吸引到您的网站，从而令人点击联盟营销链接。

more_examples.text: I will occasionally include affiliate links on this blog. When you click on them and make a purchase, I receive a small portion of the sale and it helps to keep this site going.
If you attract potential buyers to your website and direct them to the affiliate link you can make a commission from every sale.
Note: There is an affiliate link in this post. See my full disclosure statement below.

definitions.definition: an agreement in which a person or organization puts a link to a company's product on their website , and the company pays them something every time they sell a product through this link
definitions.def_translation: 联盟营销：品牌商与推广者或机构合作，在后者的网页上展示产品销售链接供顾客点击购买，并与销售伙伴分享利润。

examples.text: About 30 percent of our online sales come from affiliate marketing.
examples.translation: 我们大约30%的在线销售额来自联盟营销。

examples.text: Affiliate marketing offers opportunities to work with other entrepreneurs and to earn commission.
examples.translation: 联盟营销提供与其他企业家合作并赚取佣金的机会。

more_examples.text: The report found that affiliate marketing was the second most effective tool at driving traffic to online retailers, after direct e-mail.
We have to deal with the current commercial realities of franchises, co-branding, and affiliate marketing.
The workshop will be about how to generate income through affiliate marketing.

definitions.definition: connected with or controlled by a group or organization
definitions.def_translation: 附属（某组织）的；（与某组织）有关连的

examples.text: She was admitted into the Chicago Medical School, then affiliated with Northwestern University.
examples.translation: 她先是被芝加哥医学院接受，然后又进入了西北大学。

examples.text: He resigned as chairman of the Petra Group and as director of its affiliated companies.
examples.translation: 他辞去了Petra集团主席及其相关公司董事的职位。

definitions.definition: used to refer to people who state that they support a particular political party when they register to vote
definitions.def_translation: （某人在政治上）支持某党派的

examples.text: The button marked "Other" was intended for Republicans and other affiliated voters.
examples.translation: 标注有“其他”的按钮是供共和党人和支持其他政治派别的选民使用。

definitions.definition: a connection with a political party or religion , or with a larger organization
definitions.def_translation: 隶属（关系）；从属关系；联系

examples.text: The group has affiliations with several organizations abroad.
examples.translation: 该团体和数个国外组织有联系。

examples.text: Their lack of affiliation to any particular bank allows them to give objective financial advice.
examples.translation: 他们不隶属任何一家银行，这就使他们能够提供客观的理财咨询意见。

examples.text: political affiliations
examples.translation: 政治联系

definitions.definition: a legal order in which a man who is not married to the mother of his child must pay money to the mother to support his child
definitions.def_translation: 非婚生子女生父身份确认令（法庭令非婚生子女的生父支付抚养费的裁决）

definitions.definition: by marriage

examples.text: affinal relatives
examples.translation: 姻亲关系

examples.text: affinal ties
examples.translation: 姻亲联系

definitions.definition: a liking or sympathy for someone or something, especially because of shared characteristics
definitions.def_translation: （尤指因为有相同的特征而引起的）情投意合，喜爱，吸引

examples.text: She seems to have a natural affinity for/with water.
examples.translation: 她好像天生就喜欢水。

definitions.definition: a close similarity between two things

examples.text: There are several close affinities between the two paintings.
examples.translation: 这两幅画有多处非常相似的地方。

definitions.definition: a credit card that earns a small amount of money for a charity each time something is bought with it
definitions.def_translation: （持卡人每次消费时都会向慈善事业捐一小笔金额的）慈善信用卡，爱心信用卡

definitions.definition: to state something as true

examples.text: The suspect affirmed (that) he had been at home all evening.
examples.translation: 犯罪嫌疑人声称他整个晚上都呆在家中。

examples.text: She affirmed her intention to apply for the post.
examples.translation: 她承认自己有意应聘这一职位。

definitions.definition: to publicly show your support for an opinion or idea

examples.text: The government has affirmed its commitment to equal rights.
examples.translation: 政府声明了其致力于权利平等的承诺。

definitions.definition: a statement or sign that something is true

examples.text: We welcome the government's affirmation of its intention to act.
examples.translation: 我们欢迎政府确认它确实有意图采取行动。

examples.text: The reports are an affirmation that the students are learning.
examples.translation: 这些报告说明学生确实在学习。

more_examples.text: The committee accepted my affirmation that I acted in good faith.
The most straightforward affirmation is to say "yes".
He doesn't need affirmation from the media or his friends.

definitions.definition: the act of saying yes or of showing that you mean yes

examples.text: "Sound familiar?" Obama said, rousing a chorus of affirmations.
examples.translation: “听起来耳熟吗？”奥巴马说，激起一片肯定的声音。

examples.text: She was nodding in affirmation.
examples.translation: 她肯定地点了点头。

more_examples.text: The committee accepted my affirmation that I acted in good faith.
The most straightforward affirmation is to say "yes".
He doesn't need affirmation from the media or his friends.

definitions.definition: support or approval

examples.text: He scours the newspapers for slights and affirmation.
examples.translation: 他在报纸上搜寻轻视和肯定的内容。

examples.text: A young child relies on its mother for comfort, affirmation, and encouragement.
examples.translation: 小孩从母亲那里寻求安慰、肯定和鼓励。

more_examples.text: The committee accepted my affirmation that I acted in good faith.
The most straightforward affirmation is to say "yes".
He doesn't need affirmation from the media or his friends.

definitions.definition: relating to a statement that shows agreement or says "yes"

examples.text: an affirmative answer/response
examples.translation: 肯定的回答／答复

definitions.definition: a word or statement that shows agreement or says "yes"

examples.text: He replied in the affirmative (= he said "yes").
examples.translation: 他回答说是。

examples.text: She asked the question expecting an affirmative.
examples.translation: 她问这个问题是希望得到肯定的答复。

examples.text: US"Were you in New York on 3 March?" "Affirmative." (= "Yes.")
examples.translation: “3月3号你在纽约吗？”“是的。”

definitions.definition: If a government or an organization takes affirmative action , it gives preference to women, black people , or other groups that are often treated unfairly , when it is choosing people for a job .
definitions.def_translation: （政府或机构招聘雇员时优先雇用常受到歧视的女性、黑人或其他群体的成员的）积极补偿行动，平权措施

definitions.definition: in a way that shows agreement or means “yes”

examples.text: She answered affirmatively.
examples.translation: 她肯定地回答。

examples.text: I responded affirmatively to each question.
examples.translation: 我对每个问题都做出了肯定的回答。

more_examples.text: He nodded his head affirmatively.
Respond affirmatively at the computer prompt.
The application must be sworn to affirmatively as true and correct.

definitions.definition: someone's gender , especially when it does not match the gender they were said to have at birth
definitions.def_translation: 确认性别：个人自我认定的性别，尤指与出生时被指定的性别不同的情况。

examples.text: She campaigned to change the company's dress policy so that all employees could dress in a way that reflected their affirmed gender.
examples.translation: 她发起运动以改变公司的着装政策，以便所有员工的着装都能反映出他们所自我确认的性别。

examples.text: The study showed that trans baby boomers typically began living in their affirmed gender around age 50.
examples.translation: 该研究表明，跨性别婴儿潮一代通常在50岁左右开始以他们自我确认的性别生活。

examples.text: Transgender people can face challenges if the gender marker on their legal documents does not match their affirmed gender identity.
examples.translation: 如果跨性别者法律文件上的性别标志与他们自我确认的性别状况不符，他们可能会面临别人的挑战质疑。

more_examples.text: The study recorded participants' natal sex but not their affirmed gender.
The athletics association allows trans women to compete in their affirmed gender.
The majority of transgender youth who make a social transition remain living in their affirmed gender.

definitions.definition: to fasten or stick one thing to another

examples.text: She affixed a stamp to the envelope.
examples.translation: 她把一张邮票贴在信封上。

definitions.definition: a letter or group of letters added to the beginning or end of a word to make a new word

examples.text: The affixes un- and -less are often used to make negative words, such as "unhappy" and "careless".
examples.translation: 词缀 un- 和 -less 常用来构成表示否定意义的词，如单词 unhappy 和 careless。

definitions.definition: If a problem or illness afflicts a person or thing, they suffer from it.

examples.text: It is an illness that afflicts women more than men.
examples.translation: 患这种疾病的女性多于男性。

examples.text: a country afflicted by civil war
examples.translation: 饱受内战蹂躏的国家

definitions.definition: something that makes you suffer

examples.text: Malnutrition is one of the common afflictions of the poor.
examples.translation: 营养不良是困扰穷人的常见问题之一。

definitions.definition: the state of having a lot of money or owning many things

examples.text: What we are seeing increasingly is a society of private affluence and public squalor.
examples.translation: 我们所见的，是一个私产愈见富足而国家日趋贫困的社会。

examples.text: The nation's affluence has made two- and even three-car families the norm.
examples.translation: 国家的富足使两车之家乃至三车之家成为常态。

more_examples.text: Most Americans continue to enjoy considerable affluence.
Increasing affluence has led to many consuming a diet with more processed food than fresh vegetables.
This city doesn't enjoy the typical suburban affluence that other areas do.

definitions.definition: having a lot of money or owning a lot of things

examples.text: affluent nations/neighbourhoods
examples.translation: 富有国家／富人区

definitions.definition: the bad effects of living in a society where many people are too rich , such as always wanting new, expensive things or having to work too hard
definitions.def_translation: （由于社会中许多人过于富裕而引起的）富恙，心理富贵病（如总是追求新奇和高档消费品或工作过劳）

definitions.definition: to be able to buy or do something because you have enough money or time :

examples.text: I don't know how he can afford a new car on his salary.
examples.translation: 我不知道他靠工资怎么能买得起新车。

definitions.definition: to allow someone to have something pleasant or necessary

examples.text: The hut afforded little protection from the elements.
examples.translation: 这间棚屋几乎不能遮风挡雨。

examples.text: Her seat afforded her an uninterrupted view of the stage.
examples.translation: 她的座位很好，可以一览无余地看到整个舞台。

definitions.definition: not expensive

examples.text: nice clothes at affordable prices
examples.translation: 物美价廉的衣服

definitions.definition: (used about houses , etc.) able to be bought or rented by people who do not earn a lot of money
definitions.def_translation: （房屋等）让收入较低者有能力购买或租用的

examples.text: They have increased their provision of affordable housing in order to make home ownership accessible to buyers who would otherwise be unable to buy.
examples.translation: 他们增加了经济适用房的供给量，目的是让否则无力购房的人群买得起自己的房屋。

examples.text: According to the guidelines, ten percent of the dwellings in the development must be affordable.
examples.translation: 指导方针规定，该房地产开发项目百分之十的住宅必须是经济适用房。

definitions.definition: a use or purpose that a thing can have, that people notice as part of the way they see or experience it

examples.text: In design, perceived affordance is important — that is, our implicit understanding of how to interact with an object.
examples.translation: 在设计方面，感官可见的预设用途是很重要的——这就是我们对应该如何使用某物的模糊认识。

definitions.definition: the action of planting trees on an area of land in order to make a forest
a fight in a public place

examples.text: Wallace was charged with causing an affray at a Southampton nightclub.
examples.translation: 华莱士被指控在南安普顿一家夜总会寻衅滋事。

definitions.definition: a consonant sound that consists of a plosive and then a fricative made in the same place in the mouth

examples.text: The "ch" sound at the beginning and end of "church" is an affricate.
examples.translation: 单词church中，起始音和终结音ch都是塞擦音。

definitions.definition: a remark or action intended to insult or offend someone

examples.text: He regarded the comments as an affront to his dignity.
examples.translation: 他认为这些话侵犯了他的尊严。

definitions.definition: to insult or offend someone

examples.text: I was most affronted by his comments.
examples.translation: 他的话是对我的极端侮辱。

examples.text: an affronted look/glance
examples.translation: 受到冒犯的神情／透出受了侮辱之意的一瞥

definitions.definition: belonging to or relating to Afghanistan or its people
a person from Afghanistan
a tall , thin dog with long , smooth hair , and a pointed nose
a country in Central Asia
someone who is very interested in and enthusiastic about a particular subject

examples.text: a club for model railway aficionados
examples.translation: 铁路模型爱好者俱乐部

examples.text: an aficionado of French cinema
examples.translation: 对法国电影入迷的人

definitions.definition: a long / longer distance away

examples.text: We export our products to countries as far afield as Japan and Canada.
examples.translation: 我们的产品出口远销到日本、加拿大等国。

examples.text: Our students come from Europe, Asia, and even further afield.
examples.translation: 我们的学生来自欧洲、亚洲甚至更远的地方。

definitions.definition: written abbreviation for away from keyboard : used when you stop taking part in a discussion in a chat room for a short time
definitions.def_translation: （网上聊天用语）离开键盘（away from keyboard的缩写）

definitions.definition: burning

examples.text: The whole village was aflame.
examples.translation: 整个村子都陷入一片火海中。

definitions.definition: red or gold , as if burning

examples.text: It was autumn and the trees were aflame with colour.
examples.translation: 时值秋天，树林绚烂似火。

examples.text: Her cheeks were aflame with embarrassment/anger.
examples.translation: 她的脸窘／气得通红。

definitions.definition: very excited

examples.text: Aflame with desire, he took her in his arms.
examples.translation: 他欲火中烧，将她拥入怀中。

definitions.definition: floating on water

examples.text: You can keep afloat for longer if you lie on your back.
He managed to stay afloat by holding on to the side of the boat.
examples.translation: 他抓住了船舷才使自己没有沉到水底。

examples.text: She spent seven days afloat on a raft.
examples.translation: 她在一只木筏上漂流了7天。

definitions.definition: having enough money to pay what you owe
definitions.def_translation: 有偿债能力的;经济上周转得开的

examples.text: The business had to sell off some of its assets to keep afloat.
Many small businesses are struggling to stay afloat.
examples.translation: 许多小企业惨淡维持经营。

definitions.definition: excited and nervous
definitions.def_translation: 激动不安的;紧张兴奋的

examples.text: I'm all aflutter about meeting him after so long.
examples.translation: 久别后将再次见到他，我激动不已。

examples.text: Paul had walked into the room and set my heart aflutter.
examples.translation: 保罗走进了房间，我紧张得心怦怦直跳。

definitions.definition: happening or being planned or prepared
definitions.def_translation: 进行中的；策划中的；准备中的

examples.text: There are plans afoot to launch a new radio station.
examples.translation: 成立一家新广播电台的计划正在酝酿之中。

definitions.definition: → before
mentioned earlier

examples.text: The aforementioned Mr Parkes then entered the cinema.
examples.translation: 前面提到的这位帕克斯先生接着进入了电影院。

definitions.definition: the person or people mentioned earlier

examples.text: The aforementioned was/were seen waiting outside the building.
examples.translation: 有人看到前面提到的这个／这些人在楼外等候。

definitions.definition: to experience problems , punishment , or harm because you do not obey a rule or disagree with a powerful organization , group , or person

examples.text: He was 15 when he first ran afoul of the law.
examples.translation: 他在15岁时第一次触犯法律。

examples.text: At one point Seeger fell afoul of the US government for his anti-war actions.
examples.translation: 西格一度因他的反战行动触怒了美国政府。

definitions.definition: feeling fear , or feeling worry about the possible results of a particular situation
definitions.def_translation: 畏惧的，害怕的;担忧的，发愁的

examples.text: She was afraid for her children (= feared that they might be hurt).
examples.translation: 她很担心孩子们的安全。

examples.text: I've always been afraid of flying/heights/spiders.
examples.translation: 我一直都怕坐飞机／恐高／怕蜘蛛。

examples.text: He was/felt suddenly afraid.
examples.translation: 他突然害怕起来／感到恐惧。

examples.text: Don't be afraid to say what you think.
examples.translation: 不要害怕说出自己的想法。

examples.text: She was afraid (that) he might be upset if she told him.
examples.translation: 她担心告诉他之后他会不高兴。

more_examples.text: She's afraid of being attacked if she walks across the park.
He wasn't afraid to stand up to bullies.
The government is afraid of further serious rioting today.
Being afraid of the dark, she always slept with the light on.
Don't go up the tower if you're afraid of heights.

definitions.definition: used to politely introduce bad news or disagreement :

examples.text: This is your room - it's rather small, I'm afraid.
examples.translation: 这是你的房间——恐怕是太小了点儿。

definitions.definition: If you do something afresh, you deal with it again in a new way.

examples.text: She tore up the letter and started afresh.
examples.translation: 她撕掉信，又重新写。

examples.text: We agreed to look afresh at her original proposal.
examples.translation: 我们同意重新考虑她最初的建议。

definitions.definition: the continent that is to the south of the Mediterranean Sea, to the east of the Atlantic Ocean, and to the west of the Indian Ocean
belonging to or relating to Africa or its people

examples.text: African history/music
examples.translation: 非洲历史／音乐

definitions.definition: a person from Africa
a person who lives in the US and is a member of a race of people with dark skin that originally came from Africa
related to or involving a person who lives in the US and is a member of a race of people with dark skin who originally came from Africa

examples.text: The new high school is located in the heart of Denver's historically African-American community.
examples.translation: 这所新高中位于丹佛市的传统非裔美国人社区的中心。

examples.text: More than 20 new museums dedicated to African-American history have been built around the country.
examples.translation: 全国各地新建了20多座专门展示非裔美国人历史的博物馆。

more_examples.text: President Obama was the first African-American president of the Harvard Law Review.
The city’s south side is a predominantly Hispanic and African-American area.
Rice became the first African-American woman to hold the position of Secretary of State.

definitions.definition: a Christian religious group that is one of the Protestant Churches
a small plant with purple , pink , or white flowers that is grown in a container in a house
a language that is related to Dutch and is spoken in South Africa
definitions.def_translation: 南非荷兰语，阿非利堪斯语

definitions.definition: a South African person whose family was originally Dutch and whose first language is Afrikaans
definitions.def_translation: 南非白人，布尔人（指南非的荷兰移民后裔）

definitions.definition: a style for curly hair , particularly Black people's hair , in which it is allowed to grow naturally into a thick , rounded shape
definitions.def_translation: （尤指类似一些黑人的自然发型的）埃弗罗发式;（圆形蓬松卷曲的）非洲式发型

examples.text: In his youth he had an Afro.
I think he looks good with an afro.

more_examples.text: He no longer wore the big shades and the Afro.
The singer first grew his afro at the age of ten.
When he took his hat off a huge ginger Afro emerged.
He was about 6 foot tall and had the curliest afro I've ever seen.

definitions.definition: of or connected with Africa

examples.text: Afro-Caribbean culture
examples.translation: 加勒比黑人文化

examples.text: Afro-American literature
examples.translation: 美国黑人文学

definitions.definition: a style for Afro hair (= curly hair allowed to grow naturally into a thick rounded shape ) in which the hair is tied on top or at the side of the head in a rounded shape , usually one on each side of the head
definitions.def_translation: 埃弗罗爆炸头，埃弗罗蓬蓬头（发式）

examples.text: I put my daughter's hair in Afro puffs.
examples.translation: 我给女儿梳了一个埃弗罗蓬蓬头。

examples.text: An afro puff is a simple do-it-yourself style consisting of one or more puffs.
examples.translation: 埃弗罗蓬蓬头是一种自己就可以梳的简单发式，可以梳一个或者两个蓬蓬。

more_examples.text: As a father, if I manage a relatively straight parting separating my daughter's two Afro puffs, the mums at school coo over me as if I were the reincarnation of James Brown.
Since the natural hair movement started, Afro puffs have become one of the most beloved styles.
In this article, we will tell you how to do afro puffs.
Here's how to get your hair into an Afro puff.

definitions.definition: a person living in, or originally from, the Caribbean , whose ancestors (= the people related to you who lived a long time ago) came from Africa
definitions.def_translation: 非洲裔加勒比人，加勒比黑人

examples.text: UKThe study is a comparison of Asians, Afro-Caribbeans, and white Caucasians with type 2 diabetes.
examples.translation: 这项研究比较罹患二型糖尿病的亚洲人、加勒比黑人和白人。

definitions.definition: being an Afro-Caribbean
definitions.def_translation: 非洲裔加勒比人的，加勒比黑人的

examples.text: an Afro-Caribbean woman
examples.translation: 一名加勒比黑人女性

examples.text: Britain's Afro-Caribbean population
examples.translation: 英国的非洲加勒比裔人口

definitions.definition: relating to Afro-Caribbeans
definitions.def_translation: 与非洲裔加勒比人有关的，与加勒比黑人有关的

examples.text: Afro-Caribbean hair products
examples.translation: 非洲裔加勒比人的美发产品

examples.text: Afro-Caribbean music/rhythms/beats
examples.translation: 加勒比黑人音乐/韵律/节拍

definitions.definition: giving central importance to the culture and history of Africa and people from Africa
definitions.def_translation: 以非洲历史文化和非洲人为中心的

examples.text: She helped establish several Afrocentric arts organizations.
examples.translation: 她帮助建立了几个以非洲文化为中心的艺术组织。

examples.text: Many African Americans have embraced Afrocentric fashion such as the head wrap.
examples.translation: 许多非裔美国人已经接受了以非洲文化为特色的时尚，比如裹头巾。

more_examples.text: He comes from the province of Bahia, where Brazil's most Afrocentric carnivals are held.
Highlights of the literary festival included a stage focusing on Afrocentric authors.
She helped found a school with an Afro-centric curriculum in Chicago.
We regularly discussed Afrocentric themes, images, books and values, all of which helped to give the children a sense of self.
His music showed a shift from gangsta rap to politically conscious Afrocentric rap.
He spoke of the need for a longer-term Western engagement with Africa from an Afro-centric perspective.
Some black people here say they don't observe Kwanzaa because they think it's anti-Christmas, too Afrocentric or simply too different from other American holidays.

definitions.definition: an educational movement (= a set of aims and ideas ) that gives central importance to the culture and history of Africa and people from Africa
definitions.def_translation: 非洲中心主义（旨在教育人们肯定非洲人和非洲历史文化的重要性的运动）

examples.text: Proponents of Afrocentrism say that the contributions of Black African people have been downplayed or discredited as part of the legacy of colonialism and slavery.
examples.translation: 非洲中心主义的支持者说，殖民主义和奴隶制的遗留问题之一是非洲黑人的贡献被淡化或抹黑。

examples.text: They wore African-inspired prints and expressed an interest in Afrocentrism.
examples.translation: 他们穿着有非洲特色的印花服裝，表达了对了解非洲中心主义的兴趣。

more_examples.text: At that time, the civil-rights movement was brewing and notions of Afrocentrism were just gaining currency.
Afrocentrism is an approach to the study of world history that focuses on the history of people of recent African descent.
Afrocentrism seeks to correct what it sees as mistakes and ideas perpetuated by the racist philosophical underpinnings of western academic disciplines.
He shifted emphasis away from gangsta nihilism toward the light of Afro-centrism, self-love and a unified hip-hop culture.

definitions.definition: a style of literature , music , art , etc. that combines science-fiction elements (= stories or ideas about an imagined future ) with ideas from the culture and history of Africa and African people
definitions.def_translation: 非洲未来主义（植根于非洲历史文化和非洲人身份的带有科幻元素的文学、音乐和艺术风格）

examples.text: What makes Afrofuturism different from standard science fiction is that it’s steeped in African traditions and black identity.
examples.translation: 非洲未来主义小说与一般科幻小说的不同之处在于它深深植根于非洲传统和黑人身份之中。

examples.text: Afrofuturism is embodied in the movie Black Panther, the music of Janelle Monáe and Sun Ra, and the novels of Octavia Butler.
examples.translation: 电影《黑豹》、珍妮尔·梦奈和桑·拉的音乐以及奥克塔维亚·巴特勒的小说都体现了非洲未来主义。

more_examples.text: In Afrofuturism, Black people imagine and create whole worlds where we not only achieve greatness, but we are thriving in our own culture.
Afrofuturism is the reimagining of a future filled with arts, science and technology seen through a black lens.
The term Afrofuturism was conceived a quarter-century ago by white author Mark Dery in his essay “Black to the Future”.
What drew you to Sun Ra and Afro-Futurism?

definitions.definition: in or towards the back part of a boat
following in time , place , or order
definitions.def_translation: （时间、地点或顺序）在…之后;（一个）接着（一个）

examples.text: Let's go for a walk after breakfast.
examples.translation: 我们吃过早饭去散步吧。

examples.text: Some people believe in life after death.
examples.translation: 一些人相信死后灵魂依然存在。

examples.text: Her name came after mine on the list.
examples.translation: 名单上她的名字排在我后面。

examples.text: There's a good film on the day after tomorrow.
examples.translation: 后天有一部不错的电影。

examples.text: She waited until well after midnight.
examples.translation: 她一直等到后半夜很晚的时候。

examples.text: She went back to work soon after the birth.
USIt's a quarter after four.
examples.translation: 4点1刻了。

examples.text: She just keeps on working, day after day (= continuously).
She just keeps on working, week after week (= continuously).
We've had meeting after meeting (= many meetings) to discuss this point.
examples.translation: 我们一次又一次地开会讨论这个问题。

examples.text: Jessie seemed very small after (= in comparison with) Michael's children.
examples.translation: 与迈克尔的孩子们比起来，杰西显得很矮小。

examples.text: The children have to learn to tidy up after themselves (= after they have made things untidy).
examples.translation: 孩子们必须意识到，自己弄乱了东西，就得自己收拾整齐。

examples.text: She slammed the door after (= behind) her.
examples.translation: 她随手砰地关上了门。

examples.text: We ran after (= followed) him, but he escaped.
examples.translation: 我们去追他，但是他逃脱了。

examples.text: Could you lock up after you (= when you leave), please?
examples.translation: 请你离开时锁好门好吗？

definitions.definition: to be looking for someone or something or trying to find or get them or it:

examples.text: The police are after him.
examples.translation: 警察正在追捕他。

definitions.definition: used to say politely that someone can go ahead of you or do something before you:

examples.text: "Can I pour you some coffee?" "Oh no, after you."
examples.translation: “我给你倒点咖啡吧？”“噢，不用，你先来吧。”

more_examples.text: I'll meet you down at the club after work.
The boat sank almost immediately after it had struck the rock.
She was amazed at how calm she felt after the accident.
Apply the sun cream liberally to exposed areas every three hours and after swimming.
If we turn left at the next junction, we should hit the main road after five miles or so.

definitions.definition: typical of or similar to the style of

examples.text: a painting after Titian
examples.translation: 一幅模仿提香的画作

examples.text: a concerto after Mozart
examples.translation: 模仿莫扎特风格的协奏曲

definitions.definition: used when giving someone or something the same name as another person or thing

examples.text: He was named Mark after his grandfather.
examples.translation: 他以祖父的名字命名为马克。

definitions.definition: later than someone or something else

examples.text: Hilary got here at midday and Nick arrived soon after.
examples.translation: 希拉里中午到了这儿，随后不久尼克也到了。

examples.text: I can't go next week - how about the week after (= the following week)?
examples.translation: 下星期我去不了，下下星期怎么样？

examples.text: She got back at 4.30 and went to see Emilie after (= after she got back).
examples.translation: 她4点半回来的，随后就去看望埃米莉了。

more_examples.text: He collapsed at work and died soon after.
After nine years in Cambridge, Susannah and Guy moved to Watlington, where they lived happily ever after.
Let's feed the kids first and have our dinner after.
You have a good cry and you'll feel better after.
Mary left the company and I found another job shortly after.

definitions.definition: at a time that is later than another event

examples.text: Three months after they moved out, the house was still empty.
examples.translation: 他们搬出去3个月了，这座房子仍然空着。

examples.text: He was captured in 1940 soon after the fighting began.
Shortly after we set off, the car started to make a strange noise.
examples.translation: 我们出发不久，车子就发出奇怪的噪音。

examples.text: I went to the post office immediately after I left you.

more_examples.text: Soon after we set off, Molly said she felt sick.
He bought a train ticket immediately after talking to her.
I'm going home straight after netball practice.
Soon after moving to London, she got a new job.
A year after leaving his job, he is still unemployed.

definitions.definition: coming after

examples.text: an after-dinner speech
examples.translation: 宴会后的讲话

examples.text: an after-hours club
examples.translation: 深夜营业的夜总会

examples.text: after-sales service
examples.translation: 售后服务

definitions.definition: If you can do something after a fashion , you can do it, but not well.

examples.text: I can cook, after a fashion.
examples.translation: 我会做饭，但做得不太好。

examples.text: Paul played the piano and we all sang, after a fashion.
She followed in her aunt's footsteps, after a fashion, by becoming a journalist.
They have kept the publishing house running, after a fashion.
Despite growing up in poverty, he was educated after a fashion.

definitions.definition: despite earlier problems or doubts

examples.text: The rain has stopped, so the game will go ahead after all.
examples.translation: 雨已经停了，所以比赛还会继续下去。

definitions.definition: used to add information that shows that what you have just said is true

examples.text: I do like her - after all, she is my sister.
examples.translation: 我当然喜欢她，毕竟她是我姐姐呀。

definitions.definition: after the usual hours of work

examples.text: I often do some of my own work after hours.
examples.translation: 我经常在下班后做一些自己的活儿。

definitions.definition: If you drink in a bar after hours , you drink alcohol at a time when it is not allowed by law .
definitions.def_translation: 在违禁时间，在正常营业时间之外

examples.text: The police are trying to stop after-hours drinking.
examples.translation: 警方正设法禁止在违禁时间内饮酒。

definitions.definition: used to say politely that someone can go ahead of you or do something before you
definitions.def_translation: （用于让别人先走或先用饮食）你先请

examples.text: "Can I pour you some coffee?" "Oh no, after you."
examples.translation: “我给你倒点咖啡吧？”“噢，不用，你先来吧。”

examples.text: Let's go to our table now. Please, after you.
"Do you want to sign the card?" "Yes, please, but after you."
"Did you want to say something?" "No, no, after you."
After you, Elizabeth. I can see you're in a hurry.

definitions.definition: having the same opinions or interests as you
definitions.def_translation: 与（某人）观点（或兴趣）相同

examples.text: She's a woman after my own heart.
examples.translation: 她是个与我情趣相投的女人。

definitions.definition: the material , including the placenta , that is pushed out of a woman's or female animal's body soon after she has given birth
the care of people after they have left a hospital or prison
definitions.def_translation: （病人出院后的）护理;犯人出狱后的安置

definitions.definition: an unpleasant effect that follows an event or accident , sometimes continuing for a long time or happening some time after it

examples.text: Headaches are an aftereffect of this sort of accident.
examples.translation: 头痛是这种事故的一种后遗症。

definitions.definition: a pleasant feeling produced after an experience , event , feeling , etc.

examples.text: The team were basking in the afterglow of winning the cup.
examples.translation: 球队沉浸在夺杯的喜悦中。

definitions.definition: an image of something that you seem to see when you are no longer looking at it or when it is no longer there

examples.text: His eyes watered and swam with afterimages of the explosion.
examples.translation: 他的眼睛满是泪水，漂浮在爆炸的后像中。

examples.text: The ball streaked past him so fast that it seemed to leave a pale after-image in the dusk.

more_examples.text: There is a phenomenon in which a red circular afterimage is produced by someone staring at a green circular patch for a minute or so, and then looking at a white wall.
What you saw was almost like an afterimage left on the retina when a light goes out.
In my head was an after-image of a pair of photographs from a textbook on physiology.
The impression of her lingers, an after-image on your retina after the film has finished and the lights are still down.
His work on Optics is a study of those visual sensations of which common men never become aware, such as blind spots, after images, and astigmatism.

definitions.definition: the life , for example in heaven , that some people believe begins after death

examples.text: They'll be reunited in the afterlife.
examples.translation: 他们将在另一个世界重聚。

definitions.definition: the period that follows an unpleasant event or accident , and the effects that it causes
definitions.def_translation: （不快事件）结束后的一个时期；（不快事件的）后果

examples.text: Many more people died in the aftermath of the explosion.
examples.translation: 更多的人死于爆炸后的一段时间里。

definitions.definition: the period that starts at about twelve o'clock or after the meal in the middle of the day and ends at about six o'clock or when the sun goes down

examples.text: It was a sunny afternoon.
examples.translation: 那是一个阳光明媚的下午。

examples.text: She works three afternoons a week at the library.
examples.translation: 她每周在图书馆工作3个下午。

examples.text: It was on a Saturday afternoon.
examples.translation: 那是在一个星期六的下午。

examples.text: My baby usually sleeps in the afternoon.
examples.translation: 我的宝宝通常在下午睡一觉。

examples.text: Let's go to the park this afternoon.
examples.translation: 我们今天下午去公园吧。

examples.text: I spoke to her yesterday afternoon.
examples.translation: 我昨天下午跟她说过话。

examples.text: I'll meet you tomorrow afternoon at about 3.30.
examples.translation: 我将在明天下午3点半左右和你见面。

examples.text: She's coming round on Wednesday afternoon.
examples.translation: 她将在周三下午到这儿来。

examples.text: He's been in a bad mood all afternoon.
examples.translation: 他整个下午心情都不好。

examples.text: She likes to have an afternoon nap.
examples.translation: 她喜欢在下午小睡一会儿。

examples.text: We got an early-/mid-/late-afternoon flight.
examples.translation: 我们乘坐的是下午一两／三四／五六点钟的飞机。

more_examples.text: It had been raining hard most of the afternoon.
He spent the afternoon doing jobs around the house.
The meeting has been scheduled for tomorrow afternoon.
She walks the dog for an hour every afternoon.
I will have to cancel this afternoon's class - I'm sorry it's such short notice.

definitions.definition: a friendly way of greeting someone when you meet them in the afternoon

examples.text: Afternoon, Bob!
examples.translation: 下午好，鲍勃！

definitions.definition: a meal eaten in the afternoon , usually including cake , sometimes several different cakes , and often sandwiches , with tea to drink
definitions.def_translation: （通常包括蛋糕和茶的）午后茶点

examples.text: The hotel offers a famous afternoon tea including tiny sandwiches, homemade scones with clotted cream and jam, and a wonderful selection of pastries.
I invited a group of friends over to my house for afternoon tea.
We serve tasty snacks all day as well as breakfasts, lunches, and afternoon teas.

more_examples.text: Afternoon tea is served in the museum cafe between 2pm and 4pm.
We stopped at a bakery for afternoon tea.
He had afternoon tea at his club.

definitions.definition: every afternoon or on many afternoons
definitions.def_translation: 每天下午;在许多个下午

examples.text: He works afternoons.
examples.translation: 他在下午工作。

definitions.definition: a relaxed social event in which people sit and talk after they have been at a party or nightclub
definitions.def_translation: （在参加派对后或在夜总会玩乐后的）轻松社交活动

definitions.definition: to spend time at an afterparty

examples.text: The hotel has a huge bar that we afterpartied in.
examples.translation: 那家酒店有一个大型酒吧，我们参加派对后就会在那里聚会。

definitions.definition: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal

examples.text: What's for afters, Dad?
examples.translation: 甜点吃什么，爸爸？

definitions.definition: a liquid with a pleasant smell that a man puts on his face after shaving
a sudden movement of the earth's surface that often follows an earthquake and is less violent than the first main movement

examples.text: The initial earthquake was followed by a series of aftershocks.
examples.translation: 初震后又发生了一系列的余震。

definitions.definition: the taste that a particular food or other substance leaves in your mouth when you have swallowed it
definitions.def_translation: （饮食等在口中留下的）后味，余味，回味

examples.text: The medicine left an unpleasant aftertaste.
examples.translation: 药服下后在口中留下了一股怪味道。

definitions.definition: an idea , thought , or plan that was not originally intended but is thought of at a later time
definitions.def_translation: 事后想法;事后添加的事物

examples.text: She only asked me to her party as an afterthought.
examples.translation: 她原本没有请我去参加她的聚会，只是后来才想起来的。

examples.text: The pillars seem to have been added to the entrance as an afterthought.
examples.translation: 这些柱子好像是完工后在入口处添加上去的。

definitions.definition: after the time mentioned

examples.text: We had tea, and afterwards we sat in the garden for a while.
examples.translation: 我们喝了茶，后来在花园里坐了一会儿。

examples.text: They separated, and soon/shortly afterwards Jane left the country.
examples.translation: 他们分手了，此后不久简就离开了这个国家。

more_examples.text: We agreed on a price but afterwards they wanted £10 extra.
If you're a good boy at the doctor's I'll take you swimming afterwards.
Everyone would go into the hall for assembly and then afterwards we'd go to our respective classes.
I vote (that) we go to the cinema first and eat afterwards.
He said he had to go to a meeting now, but that afterwards he'd come and discuss the problem.

definitions.definition: a brand name for a large , iron cooker that keeps its heat
definitions.def_translation: 雅家炉（一种可用以烹饪或取暖的保温炉灶）

definitions.definition: a story about the lives of people who have a good standard of living and live in the English countryside
definitions.def_translation: 雅家小说（反映英格兰乡村中家境较好者的生活）

definitions.definition: one more time

examples.text: Could you spell your name again, please?
examples.translation: 请您再拼一次您的名字好吗？

examples.text: If he does it again I'll have to tell him.
examples.translation: 如果他再这么做，我就不能不提醒他了。

examples.text: Deborah's late again.
examples.translation: 德博拉又迟到了。

examples.text: Throw it away and start again.
examples.translation: 扔了它，重新开始。

definitions.definition: back to the original place or condition

examples.text: We went to Edinburgh and back again all in one day.
examples.translation: 我们去了爱丁堡，当天又返了回来。

examples.text: Get some rest and you'll soon be well again.
examples.translation: 休息一下，你很快就会康复的。

definitions.definition: If something happens once again, it has already happened several times before:

examples.text: You are reminded once again of the author's love of the sea.
examples.translation: 你会再次感受到作者对大海的热爱。

definitions.definition: said after an unpleasant experience to show that you do not intend to do it again:

examples.text: He drove me back home last night. Never again!
examples.translation: 昨晚他开车把我送回家。以后再也不让他送了！

definitions.definition: If something happens yet again, it has already happened many times before:

examples.text: I'm afraid it's been delayed yet again.
examples.translation: 恐怕这又给耽误了。

definitions.definition: repeatedly :

examples.text: I've told you again and again not to do that.
examples.translation: 我一再告诉过你不要那样做。

definitions.definition: If you do something all over again, you start again from the beginning :

examples.text: It's already taken me two hours - I don't want to have to do it all over again.
examples.translation: 这已经花了我两个钟头了，我可不想从头再做一次。

more_examples.text: If you think it's wrong, cross it out and write it again.
"I never want to see you ever again, " he shouted as he stormed out of the house.
I'm not going to let him repair my bike again because he made a really bad job of it last time.
I was very nervous about driving again after the accident.
If the phone lines are busy, please try again later.

definitions.definition: in addition to the amount we know about or have mentioned already

examples.text: They are paid half as much again as we are.
examples.translation: 他们的薪水比我们的多一半。

definitions.definition: repeatedly

examples.text: I've told you again and again not to do that.
examples.translation: 我一再告诉过你不要那样做。

examples.text: It's a theme that crops up again and again in her work.
She was arrested again and again, but somehow managed to continue her campaign.
Using a thesaurus is the best way to avoid repeating the same words again and again.
Again and again, he reverts to his tactic of using legal language in order to confuse listeners.

definitions.definition: disagreeing with a plan or activity

examples.text: She spoke against the decision to close the college.
examples.translation: 她声言反对关闭学院的决定。

examples.text: 50 people voted against the new proposal.
examples.translation: 50人投票反对这一新提案。

examples.text: I'm very much against the idea that it is the woman's job to bring up the child.
examples.translation: 对于抚养孩子是女人的活儿这一想法，我坚决反对。

examples.text: Germany are playing against Brazil in the cup final tonight.
examples.translation: 德国队在今晚的决赛中对阵巴西队。

examples.text: She's always rebelled against authority.
examples.translation: 她总是对抗权威。

examples.text: She sold the house even though it was against his wishes.
examples.translation: 她卖掉了房子，尽管这违背了他的愿望。

examples.text: They called a demonstration to protest against proposed job cuts.
examples.translation: 他们召集了示威游行来抗议削减工作机会的提议。

examples.text: Are you for or against my proposal?
examples.translation: 你赞成还是反对我的提议？

examples.text: Sanctions against the country should be lifted.
examples.translation: 应该取消对这个国家的制裁。

examples.text: Stricter controls will help in the fight against inflation.
examples.translation: 更加严厉的调控措施将有助于抑制通货膨胀。

examples.text: Criminal charges will be brought against the driver.
examples.translation: 将对司机提起刑事诉讼。

examples.text: They decided not to take legal action against him.
examples.translation: 他们决定不起诉他。

examples.text: They were up against a powerful pressure group.
examples.translation: 他们面临一个强大的压力集团。

examples.text: We came up against a lot of problems in the course of building our extension.
examples.translation: 我们在扩建过程中遇到好多问题。

examples.text: The chances/odds against you winning such a competition are enormous.
examples.translation: 你赢得这样一场比赛的可能性极小。

examples.text: It's against the law (= illegal) to leave children under a certain age alone in the house.
examples.translation: 将某个年龄以下的孩子单独留在家里是违法的。

examples.text: It's against my beliefs/principles to be nice to someone I dislike just because they're in a senior position.
examples.translation: 对于我厌恶的人，我不会仅仅因为他比我职位高就对其和颜悦色，这有违我的处世原则。

examples.text: Against all probability (= although it was extremely unlikely) we found ourselves in the same hotel.
examples.translation: 不可思议的是，我们发现自己竟然住进了同一家旅馆。

examples.text: I wouldn't dare say anything against him (= criticize him) to his mother!
examples.translation: 我不敢对他妈妈说他的坏话！

definitions.definition: If you have something against someone, you dislike them for a reason :

examples.text: I've nothing against him - I just don't have much in common with him.
examples.translation: 我一点都不讨厌他，只是和他没有太多相似之处。

definitions.definition: If something counts /goes/ works against you, it gives you a disadvantage :

examples.text: Lack of experience will generally count against you in an interview.
examples.translation: 一般而言，缺乏工作经验会成为面试的不利因素。

more_examples.text: The case against her was circumstantial.
The court issued a contempt citation against city council members who refused to comply with a court order.
She brought a civil action against her former employer.
His doctor advised him against smoking.
I'd strongly advise against making a sudden decision.

definitions.definition: next to and touching or being supported by (something)

examples.text: Why don't we put the bed against the wall?
examples.translation: 为什么不把床紧靠墙放呢？

examples.text: He loved the feel of her soft hair against his skin.
examples.translation: 他喜欢她那柔滑的头发贴着他的肌肤的感觉。

examples.text: The rain beat against her face as she struggled through the wind.
examples.translation: 她在风雨中艰难行进，雨水打在她的脸上。

examples.text: The police officer had him up against the wall, both arms behind his back.
examples.translation: 警察把他双手别在身后按到墙上。

examples.text: She leaned against the door.
examples.translation: 她倚着门。

definitions.definition: in front of or compared to
definitions.def_translation: 以…为背景；以…作衬托；和…对照

examples.text: Paintings look best against a simple white wall.
examples.translation: 画挂在没有任何装饰的白墙上看上去效果最好。

more_examples.text: The dog cocked its leg against a tree.
I've got a bruise where I hit my leg against the corner of the table.
The room was packed and we were crammed against the door.
We could hear waves crashing on/against the shore.
She sank back against the cushions.

definitions.definition: in the opposite direction to

examples.text: The last part of the course was hard because I was running against the wind.
examples.translation: 最后一段赛程很艰难，因为我是顶风跑。

examples.text: Commuting is not so bad when you are travelling against the traffic.
examples.translation: 如果你是逆着主车流而行，乘车上下班倒也不错。

definitions.definition: as a protection or defence from the bad effects of

examples.text: We've insured the car against fire, theft, and accident.
examples.translation: 我们给车上了火灾险、窃盗险和交通事故险。

examples.text: The police have to arm themselves against attack.
examples.translation: 警察必须得配备武器以防受到攻击。

more_examples.text: The circuitry in this fighter aircraft has been protected against strong magnetic fields.
As a student you're cocooned against the real world.
The Chancellor's countermeasures against inflation have been completely ineffective.
Does your travel insurance cover you against the loss or theft of cash?
White blood cells help defend the body against infection.

definitions.definition: If you do or achieve something against (all) the odds /against all odds , you do or achieve it although there were a lot of problems and you were not likely to succeed .
definitions.def_translation: 尽管困难重重;在极为不利的情况下

examples.text: Against all the odds, he recovered.
examples.translation: 他克服一切不利病况康复了。

definitions.definition: If you do something against the clock , you do it as fast as possible and try to finish it before a certain time .
When people do something against the clock , the time they take to do it is recorded , in order to find which person or attempt is the fastest .
If a football team scores a goal against the run of play , they score when the opposing side has been playing better or had more opportunities to score .
definitions.def_translation: （面对更强大或占上风的对手）逆袭

examples.text: West Brom scored against the run of play just before half time.
examples.translation: 西布朗足球队逆袭成功，临近半场时攻入一球。

definitions.definition: If you do something against time /the clock , you do it as fast as possible and try to finish it before a certain time .
definitions.def_translation: （为了如期完成而）争分夺秒，加快工作，抢时间

examples.text: It was a real race against time to get all the costumes sewn for the play.
examples.translation: 赶制演出的戏装真是如同与时间赛跑一样。

definitions.definition: If something is against your better judgment , you think it would be wiser not to do it.

examples.text: Against my better judgment, I gave him the job.
examples.translation: 我违心地给了他这份工作。

definitions.definition: different from what is expected
definitions.def_translation: 出乎所有人的预料；意想不到的是

examples.text: Contrary to all expectations, she was accepted by the academy.
examples.translation: 意想不到的是，她竟然被学院录取了。

examples.text: The film has, against all expectations, been a box-office hit.
I had always wanted to move to Europe and against all expectations I had done so at last.
Contrary to all expectations, he reached the Wimbledon final.
His career with the team ended last week when, contrary to all expectations, his contract was not renewed.

definitions.definition: a condition in which there are not enough gamma globulins (= protein that gives protection against diseases ) in the blood
(of a person ) with the mouth wide open , especially showing surprise or shock ; (of the mouth ) wide open , especially in surprise or shock
definitions.def_translation: （尤指表示惊奇或震惊而）大张着嘴的

examples.text: We watched, our mouths agape in excitement.
examples.translation: 我们看着，兴奋得张大了嘴。

examples.text: Audience members were staring at each other agape as if to say "Did you hear what I just heard?"

more_examples.text: There she sat, mouth agape, as she took in her new surroundings.
People wandered around the scene with mouths agape, some in tears, some simply sitting on the street in shock.
Children and adults alike watched with jaws agape.
His audacious vision left some software developers agape.

definitions.definition: a type of love that is not sexual and is not concerned with yourself; used especially in Christianity to refer to Christian love
definitions.def_translation: （尤指基督教的）圣爱，无条件的爱

examples.text: Agape is a giving love, entirely unselfish.
examples.translation: 基督教的圣爱是一种完全无私的给予之爱。

examples.text: A central lesson of The Marriage Of Figaro is that eros can mature into agape, sexual attraction into mature love.
examples.translation: 《费加罗的婚礼》的一个核心教训是，爱欲可以成熟为无条件的爱，性吸引力可以成长为成熟的爱。

more_examples.text: The Greeks separated various facets of love, and those involved in marriage are eros, philia and agape.
The word that best describes this kind of love is not “eros", not “agape", but yet another Greek word, “philia", which means “love between friends".
God gives you agape - deep, unconditional, fatherly love.

definitions.definition: a thick , clear substance that comes from seaweed , used for growing organisms such as bacteria in scientific work , and also for making liquids thicker
definitions.def_translation: 琼脂（海草中提取的一种透明粘稠物，可用于微生物培养基和食物增稠剂）

definitions.definition: a thin wooden stick covered in a substance that is burned to produce a pleasant smell , especially as part of a religious ceremony
definitions.def_translation: (尤指作为宗教仪式一部分的) 香，熏香，香脂

definitions.definition: a hard stone with patterns of different colours , often bands (= long , narrow pieces ) of colour that are translucent (= partly transparent )

examples.text: There are many varieties of agate from moss agate to layered or banded agate.
When I was about 10 years old, I started collecting and polishing agates.

more_examples.text: My mum has a brooch with a slice of agate that looks like a landscape.
From the outside the nodules are lumpy white spheres, but when cut in half and polished they are revealed as banded agates.
The archaeologists discovered beads of gold, carnelian and agate.

examples.translation: 她的眼神里透着调皮。

definitions.definition: to get out of a vehicle , especially a train or bus
definitions.def_translation: （尤指从火车或公共汽车上）下来，下去

examples.text: The suspect alighted from the train at Euston and proceeded to Heathrow.
examples.translation: 犯罪嫌疑人在尤斯顿下了火车，接着又赶往希思罗机场。

definitions.definition: to land on something

examples.text: A butterfly alighted gently on the flower.
examples.translation: 一只蝴蝶轻轻落在那朵花上。

definitions.definition: to find or unexpectedly see something
definitions.def_translation: 发现；偶然碰见；无意间发觉

examples.text: As she glanced round the room her eyes alighted upon a small child.
examples.translation: 她环视房间，目光无意间落在一个小孩身上。

examples.text: I spent an hour in the bookshop before alighting on the perfect present.
examples.translation: 我在书店里逛了一个小时才发现这本书——当作礼物真是再合适不过了。

definitions.definition: to put two or more things into a straight line , or to form a straight line
definitions.def_translation: 使成一条直线；对准；校直

examples.text: Align the ruler and the middle of the paper and then cut it straight.
examples.translation: 用尺子比齐纸的中线，然后沿尺子裁开。

examples.text: When you've aligned the notch on the gun with the target, fire!
examples.translation: 当枪的标尺、准星和目标成一条直线时，开火！

examples.text: Make sure the columns align in the chart.

more_examples.text: The left eye of the patient and the right eye of the examiner are aligned.
The "star in the East", he says, could have been Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn aligned in the constellation Pisces on 20 February 6BC.
The mounting rails are to be placed at the 25 percent and 75 percent positions along the length and have to align with the rafter.

definitions.definition: the same as or similar to something else

examples.text: Our business model will become more aligned with the needs of our customers.
examples.translation: 我们的商业模式将更加符合客户的需求。

more_examples.text: We aim to create a service where our goals and yours are totally aligned.
As a result of these changes, my value system and my daily work are more aligned.
We compete against each other on the football field, but otherwise we have aligned interests.
He didn't have a restaurant background, but his beliefs were so aligned with mine that I knew we could be partners.
You'd have a hard time finding any five people more aligned politically than these men.
I've found that unions and employers are completely aligned on bringing health-care costs down.

definitions.definition: supporting or agreeing with another person , organization , or view

examples.text: He resigned, saying the president should appoint someone who was more aligned with his views.
examples.translation: 他辞职了，说总统应该任命一个更赞同其观点的人。

definitions.definition: an arrangement in which two or more things are positioned in a straight line or parallel to each other

examples.text: This mattress supports the body in a way that keeps the neck and spine in alignment.
Try to keep your head in alignment with your spine.
The problem is happening because the wheels are out of alignment.
examples.translation: 出现这个问题是因为车轮定位不正。

definitions.definition: an agreement between a group of countries , political parties , or people who want to work together because of shared interests or aims

examples.text: New alignments are being formed within the business community.
examples.translation: 在商界，新的联盟关系正逐渐形成。

definitions.definition: similar to each other

examples.text: The children all look very alike.
examples.translation: 孩子们长得都很像。

more_examples.text: The twins look alike, but they differ in temperament.
The film's message is that rich and poor are alike.
As babies, the twins were so alike that I just couldn't tell them apart.
Our views on politics are very alike.

definitions.definition: in a similar way

examples.text: The twins even dress alike.
examples.translation: 这对双胞胎甚至穿得都一样。

examples.text: My father treated us all alike.
examples.translation: 父亲待我们一视同仁。

more_examples.text: His latest play has delighted theatre audiences and theatre critics alike.

We argue sometimes, but we usually think alike when it comes to important things.

definitions.definition: used after referring to two groups of people or things to show that both groups are included

examples.text: Friends and family alike were devastated by the news of her death.
examples.translation: 听到她去世的噩耗，无论家人还是朋友都悲痛欲绝。

definitions.definition: → alimony
food
the parts of the body that food goes through as it is eaten and digested

examples.text: I had an abscess in the lower part of my alimentary canal.
There may be an obstruction in the alimentary tract.

more_examples.text: Give him something to drink that is not too irritating to the alimentary canal.
Foods that are high in fibre help peristalsis to take place in the alimentary canal.
A bowel movement every day is not a guarantee of a healthy alimentary canal.
Crohn's disease is a chronic inflammatory disorder that can affect the entire alimentary tract.
Mental or emotional factors can exert a powerful influence on the alimentary tract.

definitions.definition: a regular amount of money that a law court orders a person to pay to his or her partner after a divorce (= the legal ending of a marriage )
definitions.def_translation: （离婚后法院判决一方支付给另一方的）赡养费，生活费

definitions.definition: an amount taken from a larger quantity , so that it can be tested , etc.

examples.text: After centrifugation, aliquots of serum were frozen at -70°C until analysis.
examples.translation: 在离心之后，血清试样在检测前被冻存在零下70度。

definitions.definition: a quantity that can be divided into another quantity an exact number of times
living , not dead

examples.text: She's alive and well and living in New Zealand.
examples.translation: 她活得好好的，现住在新西兰。

examples.text: Doctors kept him alive on a life-support machine.
examples.translation: 医生使用生命维持机来维持他的生命。

examples.text: The lost hikers were able to stay alive by finding shelter in a cave in the side of the mountain.
He must be 90 if he's still alive.
examples.translation: 如果他还在世的话，肯定有90岁了。

more_examples.text: She wept for joy when she was told that her husband was still alive.

If an avalanche strikes, skiers can be buried alive by snow.

definitions.definition: If something is alive, it continues to exist .

examples.text: Relatives of the missing sailors are struggling to keep their hopes alive.
examples.translation: 失踪水手的亲人们仍然苦守着他们能生还的希望。

more_examples.text: She wept for joy when she was told that her husband was still alive.

definitions.definition: If you are alive to something, you are thinking about it or familiar with it.

examples.text: I ski for the excitement, but I'm also always alive to the risks.
examples.translation: 我滑雪是为了追求刺激，但是我也从没有忘记这项运动的风险。

definitions.definition: full of things that are living and moving
definitions.def_translation: 充满，满是，到处都是（有生命的或活动的东西）

examples.text: The pond was alive with frogs.
examples.translation: 池塘里到处都是青蛙。

definitions.definition: a substance that has the opposite effect or chemical behaviour to an acid
any of a group of soft , white metals that are chemical elements and react easily with other substances
having an effect or chemical behaviour opposite to an acid

examples.text: Some plants will not grow in very alkaline soils.
examples.translation: 有些植物不会在非常碱性的土壤中生长。

examples.text: Ocean water today is somewhat alkaline.
examples.translation: 今天的海水带点碱性。

more_examples.text: Normally, seawater is slightly alkaline.
Because it's an alkaline substance, baking soda helps neutralize acidity.
alkaline batteries

definitions.definition: any of the chemical elements beryllium , magnesium , calcium , strontium , barium , and radium . They react easily with other substances .
the amount or level of an alkali (= a substance with the opposite effect or chemical behaviour to an acid ) in a substance

examples.text: The alkalinity of soil is measured by its pH value.
examples.translation: 土壤的碱度是由其pH值来衡量的。

examples.text: The water is warm and has high alkalinity.
examples.translation: 水是温暖的并具有高碱度。

more_examples.text: You can add baking soda to the water in your swimming pool to raise the alkalinity.
Many families monitor the acidity or alkalinity of their gardens or lawns.
The pH scale is used to measure the acidity or alkalinity of something.

definitions.definition: a type of chemical found in plants that often acts as a drug or poison , or is used in medicines
definitions.def_translation: 生物碱（植物中的化学物质，常用于制药或作为毒物）

examples.text: Morphine and cocaine are powerful alkaloids.
examples.translation: 吗啡和可卡因是强力的生物碱。

definitions.definition: any gas in a group that contains only carbon and hydrogen atoms , with the carbon atoms joined together in a simple chain
definitions.def_translation: 链烷，烷烃（单链链接碳氢化合物）

examples.text: Alkanes, such as butane and methane, are very flammable.
examples.translation: 丁烷，甲烷等烷烃均为易燃物品。

definitions.definition: any gas in a group that contains carbon and hydrogen atoms , with the carbon atoms joined together in a double bond
definitions.def_translation: 烯烃，链烯（双链链接碳氢化合物）

examples.text: Ethene and propene are alkenes.
examples.translation: 乙烯和丙烯都是烯烃。

definitions.definition: an alcoholic
a group of atoms that consist of an alkane that has had one hydrogen atom removed ; often used before another noun in the name of chemical substances

examples.text: an alkyl iodide
examples.translation: 一种碘代烷

examples.text: an alkyl ammonium salt
examples.translation: 一种烷基季铵盐

definitions.definition: an unsaturated compound of hydrogen and carbon (= one that does not contain the greatest possible number of hydrogen atoms ) that has at least one triple bond , for example acetylene
every one (of), or the complete amount or number (of), or the whole (of)

examples.text: The judge cleared the court of all but (= everyone except) herself and the witness.
examples.translation: 法官命令所有人退出法庭，只留下她自己和证人。

examples.text: I've been trying all day to contact you.
Did you really drink all of the milk?

examples.translation: 你为什么老是对我怒气冲冲的？

examples.text: It's very kind of you to come all the way to meet me.
examples.translation: 你这么大老远赶来接我，真是太感谢了。

examples.text: So long as he's happy - that's all that matters.
examples.translation: 只要他幸福就行了——那是最重要的。

examples.translation: 所有动物都必须吃东西才能生存。

examples.translation: 她有4个孩子，都不到5岁。

examples.translation: 全体演员都在台上站成一排向观众鞠躬。

examples.translation: 你把它全喝光了？

examples.translation: 鸡蛋都破了。

examples.translation: 现在钱全都是我的了！

examples.text: All my friends agree.
examples.translation: 我的朋友全都同意。

examples.text: She had £2,000 under the bed and the thieves took it all.
examples.translation: 她把2000英镑藏在了床底下，贼全都给偷走了。

examples.translation: 你还记得去年我们跟警察闹出的那一堆麻烦事儿吗？

examples.translation: 我不得不使出浑身解数劝她同意。

definitions.definition: considering all the different parts of the situation together:

examples.translation: 总的说来，我觉得你做得很不错。

definitions.definition: used when you make a comment or criticism , so that it seems less severe or is less likely to offend someone:

examples.translation: 我只是觉得结尾处可以稍微短一点儿。

examples.translation: 她尚在襁褓之中的时候双亲就过世了，因此我是她唯一的亲人。

examples.text: The princess lived all alone in the middle of the forest.
examples.translation: 公主一个人孤零零地住在森林深处。

examples.text: Can you believe he built that house all by himself?

examples.translation: 有段日子我们确实过得很艰难，但是现在一切都过去了。

examples.text: The baby got food all over her dress.
examples.translation: 宝宝弄得身上都是饭。

examples.text: The cake was all eaten last night.
examples.translation: 昨晚蛋糕全都吃完了。

examples.text: The downstairs rooms were painted all in greens and blues.
examples.translation: 楼下的房间全都粉刷成了绿色和蓝色。

examples.text: Don't let her get you all upset.
examples.translation: 不要因为她的缘故而伤心烦恼。

examples.text: She's been all over town looking for you.
examples.translation: 她跑遍全城到处找你。

definitions.definition: used in front of many nouns to form adjectives meaning "every", "every type of", or "the whole of" that particular thing

definitions.definition: used in front of many adjectives and present participles to mean "everything" or "everyone"
definitions.def_translation: （用在很多形容词和现在分词前）所有，任何

examples.translation: 包括所有费用的价格

examples.text: all-conquering armies
examples.translation: 攻无不克的军队

definitions.def_translation: （用在很多名词和形容词前）完全，十分

examples.text: all-cotton socks (= socks that are made completely of cotton)
examples.translation: 纯棉短袜

examples.text: When cooking the sauce, don't forget that all-important (= most or very important) ingredient, fresh basil.
examples.translation: 做调味汁时，不要忘了加上最重要的配料——新鲜的罗勒。

examples.translation: 你相信存在一个全能的神吗？

definitions.definition: from the very beginning

examples.text: Do you think he's been cheating us all along?
examples.translation: 你认为他自始至终都在欺骗我们吗？

definitions.definition: ever since the beginning of a relationship or process

examples.text: The project's been plagued with financial problems all along the line.
examples.translation: 这个项目自始至终都受到资金问题的困扰。

definitions.definition: everyone

examples.text: I don't want all and sundry knowing about our problems.
examples.translation: 我不想让所有的人都知道我们的问题。

definitions.definition: suddenly and unexpectedly

examples.text: All at once there was a loud crashing sound.
examples.translation: 突然发出哗啦一声巨响。

examples.translation: 我们到那儿时，比赛差不多要结束了。

examples.text: I'd all but given up on you.
examples.translation: 我差不多要放弃你了。

examples.text: His addiction to gambling all but ruined him.

Scientists found that several of the compounds all but stopped the virus.

definitions.definition: capital letters (= letters of the alphabet in the form and larger size that is used at the beginning of sentences and names ) , used especially in order to emphasize something or show that you are angry
definitions.def_translation: 全部大写，全为大写字母

examples.text: Using all caps is considered yelling online.
examples.translation: 在网络上，全部使用大写字母表示大喊的意思。

definitions.definition: written in capital letters (= letters of the alphabet in the form and larger size that is used at the beginning of sentences and names ) , especially in order to emphasize something or show that you are angry about something
definitions.def_translation: 全部大写的，全为大写字母的

examples.text: She keeps getting shouty, all-caps emails from her boss.
examples.translation: 她不断从老板那里收到全部用大写字母写成的、咄咄逼人的电子邮件。

definitions.definition: any people who want to take part in a particular competition or activity
definitions.def_translation: 所有参赛者;全体参加者

definitions.definition: used to show that you think a person deserves a lot of praise for something that they have done

examples.text: All credit to her, she did it all herself.
examples.translation: 她值得大加赞赏，这都是她一个人完成的。

examples.text: All credit to Laker for her silver medal, but we all know she was really going for gold.
All credit to James for at least raising the issue.
She refused to give up when times were hard so all credit to her!

definitions.definition: If something is all expenses paid , it means that you do not have to pay for anything yourself.
definitions.def_translation: 一切费用已付的;别人支付的;免费的

examples.text: She's going on a trip to New York, all expenses paid.
examples.translation: 她将要去纽约旅行——免费的。

examples.text: an all expenses paid trip to New York
examples.translation: 免费去纽约的旅行

definitions.definition: If all eyes are on someone or something, everyone is watching that person or thing and waiting to see what will happen .

examples.text: All eyes are on the president to see how he will respond to the challenge to his leadership.
examples.translation: 所有人都拭目以待，想知道总统如何应付对他领导地位的挑战。

data.word: all good things (must) come to an end

definitions.definition: said when you accept that even enjoyable experiences cannot last for ever
definitions.def_translation: 没有不散的筵席;千好万好总有终

examples.text: It's been a fantastic couple of weeks but all good things must come to an end.
examples.translation: 这两个星期过得真好，但千好万好总有终。

definitions.definition: If all hell breaks loose , a situation suddenly becomes violent and noisy , especially with people arguing or fighting .
definitions.def_translation: 顿时乱作一团（尤指人们突然争吵、打斗起来）

examples.text: One policeman drew his gun and then suddenly all hell broke loose.
examples.translation: 一名警察拔出了枪，人们顿时乱作一团。

definitions.definition: used when you make a comment or criticism , so that it seems less severe or is less likely to offend someone
definitions.def_translation: （提意见或批评时用来缓和语气）我只是觉得

examples.text: All I'm saying is I think the end part could have been a little shorter.
examples.translation: 我只是觉得结尾处可以稍微短一点儿。

examples.text: We should do our best, that's all I'm saying.
examples.translation: 我只是觉得我们应该尽力而为。

examples.text: All I'm saying is that we should be given both sides of the argument.
Too many of these ideas aren't based on logic is all I'm saying.
All I'm saying is that we don't yet have enough evidence to make that claim.

definitions.definition: in a way that risks all your money in a game such as poker
definitions.def_translation: （扑克游戏等中）全下地，下注所有筹码地

examples.text: I bet, he raised me, I raised back and then he went all in.
examples.translation: 我下了注，他比我下得更高，我又反超了他，然后他就索性全下了。

examples.text: He took the view that rather than pass he had better raise all-in.
examples.translation: 他认为，与其不叫牌，还不如干脆全下。

definitions.definition: in a way that shows a lot of determination and a willingness to take a big risk in order to achieve something

examples.text: Rather than take the safer path and keep his day job, Merkley went all in and quit his executive post.
examples.translation: 莫克利没有选择保留自己全职工作这样一条保险的道路，而是破釜沉舟地辞去了主管的职务。

examples.text: Congress and the President have gone all-in to prop up the economy.
examples.translation: 国会和总统采取了破釜沉舟的方法来刺激经济。

more_examples.text: A player going all-in must put all chips into the pot.

definitions.definition: in a way that includes everything in a price or total

examples.text: I calculated that as long as a new fridge cost less than £360 all in, it would have paid for itself in the first year.
examples.translation: 我算了一下，只要新冰箱所有的费用加起来不超过360美元，它第一年就可以自己挣回成本。

examples.translation: 完成这道美味的杏仁葡萄干羊肉咖喱一共只需要区区一个小时。

more_examples.text: The wedding cost £1,500 all in. It was all done on the cheap.

definitions.definition: including everything in a price or total

examples.translation: 总价为695英镑，其中包括第一次咨询的费用。
