examples.translation: 他估计120亿美元为“总价”，包括预备场地和融资的费用。

more_examples.text: Meals, golf, and massage are included in the all-in price.
UK In that year, Thomas Cook was offering an all-in holiday on the Riviera for twenty-eight pounds and sixteen shillings.
There are some good all-in deals that include guided tours.

definitions.definition: risking all your money in a game such as poker
definitions.def_translation: （扑克游戏等中）全下的，下注所有筹码的

examples.text: There was no betting on the round because the player was all in.
examples.translation: 这一轮没有下注，因为这名玩家已经下了所有筹码。

definitions.definition: showing a lot of determination and a willingness to take a big risk in order to achieve something

examples.text: He wants the war to end but he is committed and all in.
The actor is known for his daring, all-in style.
examples.translation: 这名演员以其大胆、破釜沉舟的风格而著称。

more_examples.text: Everyone loves those compelling "all-in" bets in which gamblers shove their whole stack of chips across the green felt.
When it comes to football, we're all in.

definitions.definition: very tired , so you are unable to do anything more

examples.text: I'm going home now - I'm all in.
examples.translation: 我已经精疲力尽了，现在要回家了。

more_examples.text: "I'm off to bed," he said, "I'm all in."
Go and get some rest, you sound all-in.
I offered to help her. She looked all in.

definitions.definition: If something difficult , unpleasant , or strange is all in a day's work for someone, it is a usual part of their job .
definitions.def_translation: 日常工作的一部分；习以为常，不足为奇

examples.text: When you're a nurse, cleaning up vomit is all in a day's work.
examples.translation: 对护士来说，打扫呕吐污物就是分内工作。

definitions.definition: considering all the different parts of the situation together
definitions.def_translation: 总的说来，从各方面来说；总之

examples.text: All in all, I think you've done very well.
examples.translation: 总的说来，我觉得你做得很不错。

examples.text: The cruise wasn't perfect, but all in all it was pretty good.
Taken all in all, I believe that Nelson was the greatest ever British naval commander.
All in all, we'll probably need around 100 hotel rooms at around $100 a night.
I think this proposal is, all in all, quite reasonable.

definitions.definition: used to tell someone to be patient because the thing they are eager for will happen when the time is right

examples.text: Be patient, you'll hear the result all in good time.
examples.translation: 耐心点，到时候你会听到结果的。

definitions.definition: everything is in a good or acceptable state

examples.text: I hope all is well with Jack.
examples.translation: 我希望杰克一切安好。

definitions.definition: a lot of different types

examples.text: There are all manner of architectural styles in the capital.
examples.translation: 首都汇集了各种建筑风格。

definitions.definition: in a state of confusion

examples.text: She's all of a doodah about the wedding arrangements.
examples.translation: 婚礼的筹备让她晕头转向。

definitions.definition: in a state of nervous excitement

examples.text: Peter was coming round for dinner and I was all of a flutter.
examples.translation: 彼得要来吃晚饭，我既紧张又兴奋。

definitions.definition: very quickly

examples.text: It seemed to happen all of a sudden - I felt dizzy and I just collapsed.
examples.translation: 一切似乎都发生得很突然——我觉得头晕，然后就晕倒了。

definitions.definition: used to emphasize the amount or number of something, usually when something is small in a disappointing or unusual way
definitions.def_translation: （通常用于强调数量很少）总共才…，都算上才…

examples.text: In the last two years the book has sold all of 200 copies.
examples.translation: 过去的两年里，这书总共才卖了200本。

definitions.definition: relates to doing something either completely or not at all

examples.text: She either loves you or hates you - it's all or nothing with her.
examples.translation: 她要么爱你，要么恨你——就这么极端。

examples.text: The government has rejected the all-or-nothing approach in favour of a compromise solution.
examples.translation: 政府没有采取极端做法，而是赞成折中的解决办法。

definitions.definition: If you do something all over again, you start again from the beginning .

examples.text: It's already taken me two hours - I don't want to have to do it all over again.
examples.translation: 这已经花了我两个钟头了，我可不想从头再做一次。

examples.text: After the accident, she had to learn to walk all over again.
My legal qualifications weren't valid here, so I basically had to start all over again.
Why do we keep making the same mistakes all over again?
At the end of the season the vines are pruned, and the next year you start all over again.

definitions.definition: everywhere in a particular place

examples.text: Soon the news was all over town.
examples.translation: 很快，消息就传遍了全镇。

definitions.definition: in a lot of different places or in all parts of a place

examples.text: You can buy T-shirts like this all over the place.
examples.translation: 你在哪儿都能买到这样的T恤。

examples.text: There were dirty dishes and clothes all over the place.
examples.translation: 脏餐具和脏衣服到处都是。

examples.text: People were throwing up all over the joint.
Nobody sits around and watches TV together as a family any more - there are laptops and screens all over the shop.

definitions.definition: not correct , regular , or well organized ; changing a lot without reason

examples.text: His drumming was all over the place.
examples.translation: 他的鼓敲得乱七八糟的。

examples.text: The team were all over the shop today.
Shakespeare was all over the shop with his apostrophes.

definitions.definition: (in a way that is) satisfactory or reasonably good
definitions.def_translation: （在某种程度上）令人满意的，尚可的，还算可以的

examples.text: I wouldn't say she's rich, but she's doing all right.
examples.translation: 我不能说她很富有，但是她日子过得还可以。

examples.text: Is everything all right, madam?
examples.translation: 一切都还好吗，夫人？

definitions.definition: only just good enough

examples.text: "What did you think of the film?" "It was all right. Nothing special."
examples.translation: “你认为这部电影怎么样？”“还算可以，没什么特别的。”

examples.text: The food was all right, I suppose, but I've had better.
examples.translation: 我觉得味道还可以，但我尝过更好吃的。

definitions.definition: not unpleasant or bad

examples.text: This wine's all right, isn't it?
examples.translation: 这酒还可以 ，是吧？

examples.text: Her mum's really strict, but her dad's all right.
examples.translation: 她妈妈很严厉，但她爸爸还好。

definitions.definition: very good

examples.text: You can work at home? That's all right, isn't it?
examples.translation: 你可以在家工作？那真是太棒了，是不是？

definitions.definition: used to show that you think someone is lucky or has an easy life when the same is not true for you:

examples.text: It's all right for you - your mum takes care of the children whenever you want.
examples.translation: 你当然不用担心。你妈妈随叫随到，帮你照看孩子。

more_examples.text: Do you still dislike your office, or do you think it's all right now?
"It'll be all right," she said comfortingly.
Are your roses doing all right this year?
It's all right working with him, but living with him would be a different matter altogether.
Would it be all right if I left my suitcase here for a few minutes?
£50 per hour? It's all right for some.
It's all right for people who can afford it.

definitions.definition: safe , well, or not harmed

examples.text: She was very ill for a while but she's all right now.
examples.translation: 有一阵她病得很厉害，但现在康复了。

examples.text: Did you get home all right (= safely) last night?
examples.translation: 昨晚你回家没出什么事儿吧？

definitions.definition: able to manage

examples.text: Are you managing all right in your new job?
examples.translation: 你的新工作还顺利吧？

examples.text: Are you sure you'll be all right on your own?
examples.translation: 你确定你自己一个人不会有什么事吗？

examples.text: Are you all right with those cases?
examples.translation: 你一个人拿这么多箱子，还吃得消吧？

definitions.definition: used to refuse the offer of food or drink :

examples.text: "Can I get you a drink?" "No, I'm all right, thanks."
examples.translation: “你想喝点什么？”“不用了，谢谢。”

definitions.definition: used to show that something is agreed , understood , or acceptable
definitions.def_translation: （表示同意、理解或接受）好的，好吧，可以；得了，行了

examples.text: I'd rather not go to Tricia's party if that's all right with you.
examples.translation: 如果你不介意，我还是不参加特里西娅的聚会了。

examples.text: She seems to think that it's perfectly all right to break the law.
examples.translation: 她好像觉得触犯法律没什么大不了的。

examples.text: All right, I'll lend you the money.
examples.translation: 好吧，我借给你钱。

examples.text: All right, that's enough noise!
examples.translation: 行了，吵死了！

examples.text: Tell me if you start to feel sick, all right?
examples.translation: 你要感到不舒服就马上告诉我，好吗？

examples.text: "Are you sure you won't come with us?" "All right then. If you insist."
examples.translation: “你真的不跟我们一起来吗？”“那好吧，你非让我过去的话，我就去吧。”

examples.text: All right, so I made a mistake (= I accept that I was wrong).
examples.translation: 好了好了，是我的错。

examples.text: Would it be all right if I came?
examples.translation: 我去可以吗？

examples.text: Chris wants to know if it'll be all right to come over to see us this evening.
examples.translation: 克里斯想知道他今晚是否可以过来看我们。

definitions.definition: an answer to someone who has just thanked you for something or just said sorry for something they have done:

examples.text: "Thank you for the flowers." "It's all right (= there's no need to thank me). I thought they might cheer you up."
examples.translation: “多谢你送花给我。”“别客气，我想这些花能让你心情好一些。”

definitions.definition: certainly or without any doubt

examples.text: "Are you sure it was Gillian with him?" "Oh, it was her all right."
examples.translation: “你肯定和他在一起的是吉莉恩？”“啊呀，就是她，千真万确。”

definitions.definition: used to greet someone at the same time as asking if they are well
definitions.def_translation: （打招呼并问好的用语）你好吗

examples.text: "All right, John?" "Not bad thanks, and you?"
examples.translation: “挺好的吧，约翰？”“不错，多谢。你也挺好吧？”

definitions.definition: said with the main emphasis on "right", expressing approval of what has been said or done
definitions.def_translation: （表示赞成某人的言行）太棒了，好

examples.text: "Did you hear I hit that creep who'd been pestering me?" "All right!"
examples.translation: “你听说了吗，我把那个老是纠缠我的讨厌鬼给揍了。”“打得好！”

definitions.definition: said to mean that all the methods of doing something will achieve the same result in the end
definitions.def_translation: 条条大路通罗马;殊途同归

definitions.definition: in every way

examples.text: It was a ghastly business all round.
examples.translation: 从哪方面说这都是笔极其糟糕的生意。

examples.text: It's been a good day all round.
examples.translation: 这一天过得真好，十全十美。

examples.text: Cuts in pollution could benefit our community all round.
She felt that the evening had been a triumph all round.
This new model is an improvement all round on the old one.

definitions.definition: in Western Christianity , 1 November , when all the Christian saints (= people who have received an official honour for having lived in a good and holy way) are remembered . In the Eastern Orthodox Church, All Saints' Day is in the spring .

examples.text: His birthday is on All Saints' Day.
examples.translation: 他的生日在万圣节这一天。

examples.text: All Saints Day is a national holiday in several European countries.
examples.translation: 万圣节在一些欧洲国家是一个全国性的公共假期。

more_examples.text: Some Catholic schools will be closed in honor of All Saints' Day, which is tomorrow.
New Orleans also has a custom of having family reunions at the tomb on All Saints Day.
Halloween trick-or-treating comes from the medieval Christian custom of begging for sweets on All Saints Day, November 1.

definitions.definition: in the Christian , especially the Catholic , Church, 2 November , when people who have died are remembered

examples.text: This is a traditional Italian dish to be eaten on All Souls Day in memory of the dead.
examples.translation: 这是一道传统的意大利菜，在万灵节这一天食用，以纪念逝者。

more_examples.text: The religious observation of All Souls' Day on November 2, is an occasion for many families to erect altars specifically for a parent or other family member who has recently died.
Both Halloween and the Day of the Dead involve the Roman Catholic tradition of All Souls' Day on November 2, when people remember family members who have died.
The feast day of All Souls' Day , celebrated to commemorate those souls condemned temporarily to Purgatory, was inaugurated by St Odilo on November 2, 998.
My mother speaks of trays of marzipan "bones of the dead" that were given to children on All Souls Day.

data.word: all that glitters is not gold

definitions.definition: said about something that seems to be good on the surface , but might not be when you look at it more closely
used to say goodbye , or to end a letter to someone you know well, or to send good wishes to someone
definitions.def_translation: （用于告别或信末祝福）祝一切顺利！

examples.text: All the best to your parents!
examples.translation: 祝你父母万事如意!

examples.text: Hope to see you soon. All the best, Rod.
I wish you all the best with your new job.
All the best, then! It was nice to meet you.
Wish Penny all the best from us, won't you?
Many thanks again for looking after us so well! All the best, Lucy and Dave.

data.word: all the better, stronger, more exciting, etc.

definitions.definition: even or much better , stronger , more exciting , etc.

examples.text: She felt all the better for the drink.
examples.translation: 喝下饮料后她感觉好多了。

examples.text: I've lost ten pounds and I feel all the fitter for it.
examples.translation: 我已经减了10磅，现在感觉身体更健康了。

examples.text: The company's failure was all the more shocking because it was a recognized global brand.
I feel all the stronger for having survived this trauma.
His books encourage young people to think critically, which makes it all the more disappointing when people disparage them.

definitions.definition: even more than before

examples.text: Several publishers rejected her book, but that just made her all the more determined.
examples.translation: 几个出版商拒绝出版她的书，但那恰恰使得她更加坚定。

definitions.definition: despite what has just been said

examples.text: It rained every day of our holiday - but we had a good time all the same.
examples.translation: 假期里天天下雨——不过我们仍然玩得很开心。

data.word: all the time in the world

definitions.definition: a large amount of time available

examples.text: The doctor made me feel as if she had all the time in the world to listen to my problems.
examples.translation: 这个医生让我觉得她似乎有很多时间来倾听我的问题。

definitions.definition: as much as possible or completely
definitions.def_translation: 无保留地，完全地;自始自终地，一直

examples.text: If you want to bring it up with the boss, I'll support you all the way.
examples.translation: 如果你要去找老板，我完全支持你。

definitions.definition: as far as someone or something at a high level in a process or structure
definitions.def_translation: 直到（很高的层次或程度）

examples.text: I'll take my complaint all the way to the managing director.
examples.translation: 我会一直投诉到经营主管那里。

definitions.definition: for all of a period of time

examples.text: There I was thinking you were hard at work and you were upstairs in bed all the while!
examples.translation: 我以为你在努力工作，可你却一直在楼上睡觉！

definitions.definition: the only and small amount or number of something you have

examples.text: Her parents died when she was a baby, so I was all the family she ever had.
examples.translation: 她尚在襁褓之中的时候双亲就过世了，因此我是她唯一的亲人。

examples.text: They went to primary school, but that was all the education they had.
I have a pair of jeans and a T-shirt in my bag and that's all the clothes I have.
She had to repair her relationship with her mother because that's all the family she has.
We sold a few eggs but that was all the income we had.

definitions.definition: if everything happens as expected
definitions.def_translation: 如果一切照常；如果一切顺利

examples.text: All things being equal, I'll be at home on Tuesday.
examples.translation: 如果一切顺利，我星期二就能回家。

definitions.definition: Someone might say that something is good all things considered to mean it was generally good although the situation was not perfect .
definitions.def_translation: 考虑到所有因素，总的说来

examples.text: I think the party was great, all things considered - I mean we didn't have much time to get ready, but it still went well.
examples.translation: 总的说来，我认为晚会是成功的——我指的是我们没有多少时间准备，但仍然一切顺利。

definitions.definition: If you try to be all things to all people , you try to do things that will please everyone.
very awkward with your hands

examples.text: Can you untangle this thread for me? I'm all thumbs today.
examples.translation: 你能帮我解开这个线结吗？我今天手指不灵便。

definitions.definition: as a complete total

examples.text: There were 550 people at the festival all told.
examples.translation: 节日庆典上总共有550人。

definitions.definition: If something is all very well, it is fairly useful or good in some situations but not excellent and not useful or good in every situation .

examples.text: Electric heating is all very well until there's a power cut.
examples.translation: 如果不停电的话，电暖气还可以。

definitions.definition: You say that something is all very well/ fine /good if it seems good by itself but you think that there are problems connected with it
definitions.def_translation: 好像是不错（用来表示其中有问题）

examples.text: It's all very well to want to get rich quickly, but it isn't usually that easy.
examples.translation: 想一下子发财倒是没什么不对，但是通常没有那么容易。

data.word: all work and no play (makes Jack a dull boy)

definitions.definition: said to warn someone that they will not be an interesting person by working all the time
definitions.def_translation: 只用功不玩耍（聪明孩子也变傻）。

data.word: all's fair in love and war

definitions.definition: in love and war you do not have to obey the usual rules about reasonable behaviour
definitions.def_translation: 在情场和战场上可以不择手段。

definitions.definition: If a woman or girl does something by herself, she does it alone or without help from anyone else .

examples.text: She lives by herself in an enormous house.
examples.translation: 她独自一人住在一所巨大的房子里。

examples.text: Holly's only three but she wrote her name all by herself.
examples.translation: 霍丽只有3岁，但她完全能自己写自己的名字。

examples.text: The child was playing by herself in the garden.
She raised four children all by herself.
Her parents started letting her walk to school by herself.

definitions.definition: If a man or boy does something by himself, he does it alone or without help from anyone else .

examples.text: Little Timmy made that snowman all by himself.
examples.translation: 小蒂米独自一人堆成了那个雪人。

examples.text: Why did you leave your little brother by himself?
examples.translation: 你为什么把你的弟弟丢下不管？

examples.text: He spent all evening standing awkwardly by himself.
I asked my husband to help me tidy up but then my friend called, and he ended up doing it all by himself.
He is going to the barber's by himself for the first time today.

definitions.definition: alone or without help

examples.text: The animal had been left in the house by itself for a week.
examples.translation: 这个动物被孤零零地留在了房子里一个星期。

examples.text: A cough will usually get better by itself.
examples.translation: 咳嗽一般自己会好的。

examples.text: Neither group could do anything by itself without agreement from the other.
No single measure by itself can guarantee a healthy life.
Cook the polenta until it is thick enough for a spoon to stand up in it all by itself.

definitions.definition: worried or angry , and sometimes physically hot
definitions.def_translation: 心急火燎的，焦灼不安的，怒气冲冲的

definitions.definition: not damaged
definitions.def_translation: 完好无损地，安然无恙地

examples.text: The radio had been stolen, but otherwise we got the car back (all) in one piece.
examples.translation: 除了收音机被偷之外，我们的车子找回来时完好无损。

definitions.definition: as a single thing and not divided into smaller pieces

examples.text: We want to sell the business in one piece.
examples.translation: 我们想把公司整个卖掉。

definitions.definition: alone

examples.text: I like living on my own.
examples.translation: 我喜欢独自一个人生活。

examples.text: Was he acting on his own or following orders?
He'd left on his own, without telling his parents.
This time of year, the young birds are too weak to survive on their own in the cold, and so need the presence of a parent at all times.
Thank goodness, she's now able to breathe on her own.
I worry that he won't be able to cope on his own.
We can't leave her all on her own.

definitions.definition: without any help

examples.text: I did my buttons up all on my own, Dad .
examples.translation: 爸爸，我的纽扣全是我自己扣上的。

examples.text: Can you do it all on your own? I'm happy to help.
She's got a carer in to help now that she can't do much on her own.
The company couldn't produce the volume needed all on their own, and contracted work out.

definitions.definition: for her use only

examples.text: Mum's got the house to herself this weekend.
examples.translation: 这个周末妈妈独自一人在家。

examples.text: In her new job, Jackie has an office all to herself.
It was very early in the morning and she had the pool to herself.
She likes it when she has her father all to herself.
He sat on the hard chair while she had the entire couch all to herself.

definitions.definition: for his use only

examples.text: Johnny's got the apartment to himself next week.
examples.translation: 约翰尼下周将一个人独享那套公寓。

examples.text: He disliked Patti because he wanted Ed's attention all to himself.
He didn't have a bedroom to himself until he left home.
There weren't many people on the plane so he had a row all to himself.
He had the pool all to himself that afternoon.

definitions.definition: for its use only
definitions.def_translation: 只为自己使用地，不公开地

examples.text: The committee kept the results of the survey to itself (= did not tell anyone), fearing a bad public reaction.
examples.translation: 委员会担心会引发不好的公众反应，因此没有公开调查结果。

examples.text: Until a few years ago, the firm had the Chinese market pretty much to itself.
I set off early so that my new car would have the road all to itself.
I was amazed to find that my class had the whole museum to itself.
The alligator found a water hole all to itself.

definitions.definition: considered to be typical of the US, and respected and approved of by Americans
definitions.def_translation: 典型美国式的;具有典型的美国理念的;为美国人所崇尚的

examples.text: He was the perfect image of a clean-cut, all-American boy.
examples.translation: 他代表了一个俊美的典型美国男孩的完美形象。

definitions.definition: involving people or things from everywhere in the US

examples.text: an all-American talent contest/business consortium
examples.translation: 全美才艺大赛／商会

definitions.definition: used to refer to an amateur sports person from the US who is considered to be one of the best in their sport

examples.text: an all-American football player
examples.translation: 全美最佳美式橄榄球运动员

definitions.definition: an amateur sports person from the US who is considered to be one of the best amateurs in their sport

examples.text: The team was led by an all-American from Yale.
examples.translation: 该队由来自耶鲁大学的全美最佳选手率领。

definitions.definition: all-round
definitions.def_translation: 多才多艺的；全能的（同 all-round）

definitions.definition: taking almost all of your attention and time
definitions.def_translation: 耗尽时间（或精力）的；全身心投入的

examples.text: Money is an all-consuming passion with them.
examples.translation: 他们对金钱的追求达到极致。

examples.text: Her work became all-consuming.
examples.translation: 工作成为她生活的全部。

definitions.definition: extremely important
definitions.def_translation: 极其重要的，至关重要的；首要的

examples.text: It was Johansson who scored the all-important goal shortly before half-time.
examples.translation: 正是约翰森在上半场结束前不久踢进了极其关键的一球。

definitions.definition: a type of wrestling (= sport in which people fight ) in which there are very few rules
doing the work of two or more usually separate parts
definitions.def_translation: 多用途的，多功能的；几合一的

definitions.definition: relating to traditional western medicine

examples.text: Allopathic medicine is what most of us encounter when we go to the doctor.
examples.translation: 我们大部分人看病时接触的都是对抗疗法。

examples.translation: 西方医学中最常规的是对抗疗法。

the fact that a particular phoneme (= speech sound ) can be pronounced in more than one way

examples.translation: 研究人员探索儿童是如何应对音位变体现象的。

definitions.def_translation: （尤指将现有的东西）分配;分派

examples.translation: 他们给每个人都配备了个人专用的办公桌。

examples.translation: 他们给每一个人都单独配发了桌子。

examples.translation: 今年文化部得到的拨款将减少10%。

examples.translation: 这项任务限定在3小时内完成。

examples.translation: 博物馆正计划增加现代艺术展区的面积。

definitions.def_translation: （可租来种菜、水果或花的）小块土地

examples.translation: 公司给雇员的股份分配额还没有确定。

examples.translation: 我们已经把今年划拨的资金全都用完了。

definitions.def_translation: 租地者：在市内或郊外租一小块地种植蔬菜水果或花卉的人。

examples.translation: 如果您正在考虑成为一名城市农夫，则需要考虑一些事项。

definitions.definition: the activity of renting an allotment (= a small piece of ground in or just outside a town for growing vegetables , fruits , or flowers ) and growing things on it
definitions.def_translation: 在市内或郊外租一小块地种植作物

examples.text: If you like to go away most weekends or have a lot of weekend commitments, maybe allotmenteering isn't for you.
examples.translation: 如果您喜欢在大多数周末外出或有很多周末要事去办，那么租地种植可能不适合您。

definitions.definition: one of many forms of a chemical element . For example , coal and graphite are different forms of carbon .
used to describe different physical forms of the same chemical substance

examples.text: Diamond and graphite are allotropic forms of carbon.
examples.translation: 钻石和石墨是碳的同素异形体。

examples.text: an allotropic modification
examples.translation: 同素异形修饰

more_examples.text: Ozone is an allotropic form of oxygen.

definitions.definition: the existence of the same chemical substance in more than one form , each with different physical qualities
given or made available for a particular purpose

examples.text: Did you finish your essay in the allotted time?
examples.translation: 你在规定的时间内完成了论文吗？

examples.text: The magazine story was edited to fit the allotted space.
examples.translation: 这个杂志上的故事经过了编辑，以符合版面空间的要求。

more_examples.text: Conference delegates need to be in their allotted seats when a vote is taken.

definitions.definition: to give permission for someone to do something, or to not prevent something from happening
definitions.def_translation: 使有可能;允许，准许;容许

examples.text: Do you think Dad will allow you to go to Jamie's party?
examples.translation: 你认为爸爸会允许你去参加杰米的聚会吗？

examples.text: You're not allowed to talk during the exam.
examples.translation: 考试期间不许交谈。

examples.text: Her proposals would allow (= make it possible for) more people to stay in full-time education.
examples.translation: 她的提议会使更多的人能够继续接受全日制教育。

examples.text: The loophole has allowed hundreds of drink-drivers to avoid prosecution.
examples.translation: 这个法律漏洞使得数以百计的酒后驾车者钻了空子，逃避了起诉。

examples.text: The government has refused to allow foreign journalists into the area for several weeks.
examples.translation: 该政府禁止外国记者进入这个地区已经有好几周了。

examples.text: Prisoners have been moved to allow the demolition of part of the prison.
examples.translation: 犯人已经转移走了，以便拆除监狱的一部分。

examples.text: Pets aren't allowed in this hotel.
examples.translation: 这个旅馆不准许将宠物带入。

examples.text: Smoking is not allowed in this restaurant.
examples.translation: 这个饭店内不许抽烟。

examples.text: He didn't allow us enough time to finish the test.
examples.translation: 他没有给我们留足够的时间完成测验。

examples.text: Red Cross officials were allowed access to the prison for the first time a few days ago.
examples.translation: 几天前，红十字会的官员首次获准进入该监狱。

examples.text: UKThe referee decided to allow (= officially accept) the goal.
examples.translation: 裁判判定该进球有效。

examples.text: At the weekend I allow myself (= I give myself the special pleasure of having) a box of chocolates.
examples.translation: 每逢周末我给自己开戒，吃一盒巧克力。

examples.text: How much time do you allow yourself (= make available to yourself) to get ready in the morning?
examples.translation: 早晨你给自己留出多少时间来准备？

definitions.definition: a polite expression used when offering to help in some way:

examples.text: You can't carry all those bags yourself - please, allow me.
examples.translation: 那些袋子你自己拎不了——我来帮你吧。

more_examples.text: There is no smoking allowed anywhere on school premises.
You're not allowed to swim when the red flag is flying.
After a long boring afternoon I was finally allowed to leave.
"I will not allow that kind of behaviour in my class, " the teacher said severely.
He took a step backwards to allow her to pass.

definitions.definition: to admit or agree that something is true

examples.text: She allowed that she might have been too suspicious.
examples.translation: 她承认自己可能太多心了。

definitions.definition: to consider something when you are planning something
definitions.def_translation: 顾及，考虑到;为…留出余地

examples.translation: 我们每天给自己留出20英镑的生活开销。

examples.text: You should allow for the plane being delayed.
examples.translation: 你应该考虑到飞机晚点怎么办。

examples.text: We have to allow for the possibility that we might not finish on schedule.
examples.translation: 我们必须考虑到我们有可能不能按时完成。

definitions.definition: a polite expression used when offering to help in some way

examples.text: You can't carry all those bags yourself - please, allow me.
examples.translation: 那些袋子你自己拎不了——我来帮你吧。

examples.translation: 必须严格遵守这一规则，没有例外。

examples.translation: 这一证据表明只有一种解释——他是被他妻子谋害的。

definitions.def_translation: （尤指为特定事项支付的）定期补贴，津贴

examples.translation: 这份工作的特殊待遇包括公司退休金计划和丰厚的差旅补助。

examples.text: I couldn't have managed at college if I hadn't had an allowance from my parents.
examples.translation: 要不是父母定期给我生活费，我没法读完大学。

examples.translation: 大多数班机给乘客的行李重量限额是20公斤。

examples.translation: 我们应该考虑到有可能会遇上恶劣天气，所以应该备足雨伞。

examples.translation: 你应该体谅他——他最近一直病得不轻。

examples.translation: 黄铜是铜与锌的合金。

examples.translation: 这部电影处处都在向希区柯克致敬。

examples.translation: 她的小说充满了文学典故。

examples.translation: 她的音乐作品诙谐、讽刺，富含典故。

examples.translation: 他的诗朴素、简洁，带有一丝隐喻。

examples.translation: 一些冲积矿床富含钻石。

examples.translation: 他与该党的左翼结成联盟。

examples.translation: 行使盟友关系的最重要方法之一就是倾听。

examples.text: Almighty God
examples.translation: 万能的上帝

definitions.def_translation: 非常大的；声音很大的；十分严重的

examples.translation: 突然我们听到厨房中发出一声巨响。

definitions.def_translation: 几乎，差不多，差一点，将近

examples.translation: 她差不多快30了。

examples.translation: 他离开时将近6点了。

examples.translation: 我甚至有点希望自己没邀请他。

examples.translation: 修理要花的钱差不多都可以买个新的了。

examples.translation: 渡船上的乘客几乎都是法国人。

examples.translation: 几乎可以肯定他们会忘记做这件事的。

examples.text: The town was almost entirely destroyed during the war.
examples.translation: 战争期间，这个城市几乎完全被夷为平地。

examples.text: We were bitten by mosquitoes almost every night.
examples.translation: 几乎每天晚上我们都挨蚊子叮。

examples.text: The boat sank almost immediately after it had struck the rock.
examples.translation: 船撞到岩石上，几乎一瞬间就沉了。

examples.translation: 多数艺术家发现几乎不可能只靠艺术谋生。

examples.translation: 我把发生的事情告诉妈妈时，她差点儿气炸了。

a word or phrase that refers to a word or phrase used earlier in a text and replaces it, for example the word "it" in the sentence "Joe dropped a glass and it broke ."

definitions.def_translation: （尤指作为后来存在或发生之事的起因或起源的）前事，前情，先例;祖先

examples.text: Charles Babbage's mechanical calculating engines were the antecedents of the modern computer.
examples.translation: 查尔斯•巴贝奇的机械计算机是现代计算机的前身。

examples.text: Many people feel a great curiosity to find out about their antecedents.
examples.translation: 很多人对于他们的祖先充满了好奇，很想探究一番。

definitions.definition: a word or phrase that a pronoun refers back to

examples.text: In the sentence "He picked a book off the shelf and handed it to Sally", "book" is the antecedent of "it".
examples.translation: 在句子 He picked a book off the shelf and handed it to Sally 中，book 是 it 的先行词。

definitions.definition: previous
definitions.def_translation: （同页中）上面提到的;上文的，前文的

examples.text: When the college was established in 1546, it inherited a hall from each of three antecedent institutions.
examples.translation: 该学院在1546年建立时，从作为其前身的三个机构中分别承继了一座教学楼。

definitions.definition: an anteroom formal
formal for predate
extremely old-fashioned
definitions.def_translation: 早已过时的，十分老式的

examples.text: My mother has some hopelessly antediluvian ideas about the role of women.
examples.translation: 我母亲对女性的角色持有一些老掉牙的观念。

definitions.definition: used to describe a forward direction or movement , for example the normal flow of blood in the body

examples.text: The treatment resulted in improved antegrade pulmonary blood flow.
examples.translation: 这一治疗让肺部血液顺流得到了改善。

examples.text: Antegrade and retrograde catheters are placed prior to cross-clamping.
examples.translation: 顺流和逆流导管在钳闭之前置入。

more_examples.text: There was impaired antegrade aortic blood flow and consequent reduced cerebral blood flow.
Recent advances have led to improved technical success rates for antegrade ureteric stent placement.
In the figures shown, the flow above the red line is antegrade whereas the blood flow under the red line is retrograde.

definitions.definition: a mammal like a deer with horns and long , thin legs that allow it to run very fast

examples.text: a herd of antelope
examples.translation: 一群羚羊

definitions.definition: relating to the medical care given to pregnant women before their babies are born

examples.text: antenatal care/classes
examples.translation: 产前保健／学习班

examples.text: the antenatal clinic
examples.translation: 产前检查诊所

definitions.definition: before a pregnant woman's baby is born

examples.text: Some foetal abnormalities can be detected antenatally.
examples.translation: 有些胎儿异常可以在产前检测出来。

examples.text: High-risk doctors manage pregnancies that are complicated by antenatally diagnosed problems.
examples.translation: 高风险医生管理因产前诊断出的问题而变得复杂的妊娠。

more_examples.text: The care given after the birth is as important as the care given antenatally.
Midwives I saw antenatally have popped in to see how we are doing with breastfeeding.
Many women need to take iron supplements antenatally.

definitions.definition: either of a pair of long , thin organs that are found on the heads of insects and crustaceans (= animals with hard outer shells ) and are used to feel with
the natural ability to notice things and understand their importance

examples.text: Her finely-tuned political antennae helped her to sense problems that less experienced politicians might not detect.
examples.translation: 她敏锐的政治嗅觉使她可以意识到一些问题，而经验欠丰的从政者却可能觉察不到。

definitions.definition: an aerial
third from last

examples.text: X is the antepenultimate letter of the alphabet.
examples.translation: X是字母表中的倒数第三个字母。

definitions.definition: positioned at or towards the front

examples.text: Specimens for examination were taken from the anterior side of the left ventricle from each heart.
examples.translation: 检查样本取自每个心脏左心室的前侧。

definitions.definition: earlier in time
towards the front of the body
a Latin word meaning " front ", used in medical names and descriptions

used to describe a forward movement , for example the normal flow of blood in the body , or a movement of nerve signals away from the body of the cell to the synapse (= the point at which the signal moves to another cell )

examples.text: The right transverse sinus showed slow anterograde flow.
examples.translation: 右横静脉窦显示顺行流速较慢。

examples.text: In neuroscience, anterograde tracing is used to trace neural connections from their source (the cell body) to their point of termination (the synapse).
examples.translation: 在神经科学中，顺行追踪是指从源头（细胞体）到终结（突触）追踪神经联系。

more_examples.text: We randomized the subjects into two groups. Group one underwent anterograde isolated left lung perfusion.
The study used biocytin as an anterograde tracer.
Specific pathways may target the trophic or pathogenic cargo for transcytosis after either retrograde or anterograde transport along axons.
Retrograde amnesia is what you often see portrayed in literature and film. A more common type is anterograde, where the patient is unable to remember events subsequent to the injury or ailment.

definitions.definition: used to describe the fact that someone is unable to remember things that happen after a particular event

examples.text: There is evidence to show that ECT can cause both retrograde (i.e. before treatment) and anterograde (i.e. after treatment) memory loss.
examples.translation: 有证据表明ECT可造成逆行性（即治疗前）遗忘症和顺行性（即治疗后）遗忘症。

more_examples.text: We randomized the subjects into two groups. Group one underwent anterograde isolated left lung perfusion.
The study used biocytin as an anterograde tracer.
Specific pathways may target the trophic or pathogenic cargo for transcytosis after either retrograde or anterograde transport along axons.
Retrograde amnesia is what you often see portrayed in literature and film. A more common type is anterograde, where the patient is unable to remember events subsequent to the injury or ailment.

definitions.definition: a condition in which someone is unable to remember things that happen after the event that caused the condition , which may be a brain injury , a shocking experience , the effect of a drug , etc.

examples.text: Damage in these regions of the brain can result in anterograde amnesia, characterized by the inability to learn new information.
examples.translation: 大脑这些部位的损伤会造成顺行性遗忘症，特点是无法学习新的信息。

more_examples.text: This interruption in the blood supply to his brain had left him with severe anterograde amnesia.
Following the surgery, H. M. was found to suffer acute anterograde amnesia; that is, he could form no new memories, although many types of implicit memory were intact.
Parenteral diazepam is indicated for intravenous administration prior to cardioversion to relieve anxiety and tension and to produce anterograde amnesia.
Anterograde amnesia is a condition in which events that occurred during the time the drug was in effect are forgotten.

definitions.definition: in front of and to one side of another part of the body
in front of and towards the middle of the body
a small room , especially a waiting room , that leads into a larger , more important room
definitions.def_translation: （通往较大、较重要房间的）前厅，接待室，候见室

examples.text: The ministers waited for their meeting in the Cabinet anteroom.
examples.translation: 部长们在内阁接待室等着开会。

definitions.definition: (of a body part ) the state of sloping forwards

examples.text: The normal position of the uterus, when the bladder is empty, is that of anteversion.
examples.translation: 膀胱排空时，子宫的正常位置是前倾。

examples.text: Femoral anteversion and excessive external tibial torsion are often seen in patients with the condition.
These conditions can either be an anteversion or retroversion of the hip.

more_examples.text: Sharp anteversion or retroversion of the uterus can usually be corrected by manipulation of the cervix.
Uterine anteversion produces a posterior shadow in the lower uterine segment.
The anteversion angle is measured using magnetic resonance images.
Hip dysplasia can be caused by structural abnormalities such as a shallow acetabulum or a femoral or acetabular anteversion.

definitions.definition: (of a body part ) sloping forwards

examples.text: An anteverted uterus is considered to be normal, occurring in 75% of women.
examples.translation: 子宫前倾被认为是正常现象，75% 的女性都会出现这种情况。

examples.text: Of the 195 hips operated on, 53% of the hip sockets were anteverted, 42% retroverted, and 5% had neutral orientations.

more_examples.text: Because of maxillary hypoplasia the nose is short and upturning, with anteverted nostrils.
At age 3 the child had mild facial dysmorphism — anteverted ears.
After the first trimester the uterus assumes a forward position as an anteverted or "normal" uterus.
In most females, the uterus lies in an anteverted position.

definitions.definition: a bright spot in the sky that looks like a sun and is at the same height as the sun , but appears opposite it

examples.text: The anthelion is a rare optical phenomenon.
examples.translation: 幻日是一种罕见的视觉现象。

examples.text: Anthelia are caused by the refraction of light through ice crystals in high cloud.
examples.translation: 幻日现象是光通过高空云层中的冰晶发生折射而引起的。

more_examples.text: A very uncommon halo phenomenon is the anthelion, whose name means “against the sun."
Anthelia were observed by Captain Scoresby in the Greenland Sea.
In the photographs, the anthelion is the white spot on the parhelic circle opposite the sun.

definitions.definition: a song that has special importance for a particular group of people , an organization , or a country , often sung on a special occasion
definitions.def_translation: 国歌;（团体组织的）颂歌，赞歌

examples.text: The national anthems of the teams are played at the beginning of international football matches.
examples.translation: 在重大国际足球赛开赛时，演奏各参赛球队的国歌。

examples.text: John Lennon's "Imagine" has become the anthem of peace-lovers all over the world.
examples.translation: 约翰•列侬的《想象》已成为全世界和平爱好者的颂歌。

definitions.definition: a religious song sung by a choir with organ music
Anthemic music is music that has qualities that are suitable for an anthem , such as a strong tune and a serious feeling .
definitions.def_translation: （音乐）庄严肃穆的，国歌般的，圣歌般的

definitions.definition: the part of a flower that contains pollen
a pile of soil created by ants when they are making their nests underground
a person who collects artistic works into an anthology (= a collection of artistic works with a similar form or subject )

examples.text: He is a professional anthologist who compiles a yearly collection of the best new short stories.
examples.translation: 他是一位专业的文选家，每年都会编纂一本最佳短篇小说集。

examples.text: The project honours the work of American folk music anthologist Harry Smith.
examples.translation: 该项目是为了纪念美国民间音乐文学家哈里·史密斯的作品。

more_examples.text: He wrote skits and film scenarios, and was an inspired anthologist.
A lyric poet whose work has won the Pulitzer Prize, she's also a highly respected anthologist.
She is a novelist as well as an anthologist and the editor of a series of popular collections.

definitions.definition: a collection of artistic works that have a similar form or subject , often those considered to be the best
definitions.def_translation: （艺术作品的）选集;（常指）精选集

examples.text: an anthology of modern quotations/American verse
examples.translation: 现代名言集萃／美国诗歌选集

examples.text: This Bob Dylan anthology includes some rare recordings of his best songs.
examples.translation: 鲍勃•迪伦的这张歌曲集收录了他一些最佳歌曲的珍贵录音。

definitions.definition: a very hard type of coal that burns slowly and produces a lot of heat with very little smoke and a small flame
a disease of plants and trees that causes brown or yellow marks on the leaves

examples.text: You can see that these trees have become infected with the fungal disease anthracnose, causing most of the leaves to die.
examples.translation: 可以看到，这些树木已经感染了真菌病害炭疽病，导致大部分叶子枯死。

examples.text: Anthracnose is a very damaging plant disease that can be hard to control once it has become established.

more_examples.text: Researchers are investigating whether the vegetables have an inherited resistance to anthracnose.
The fungi that cause anthracnose live in dead leaves over the winter and then spread in spring.

definitions.definition: a disease that causes fever , swelling , and often death in animals , especially sheep and cattle (= male and female cows ) , and can be passed on to humans
definitions.def_translation: 炭疽病（一种常引起牛羊死亡的传染病，可传给人）

definitions.definition: relating to humans

examples.text: anthropomorphism
examples.translation: 拟人观

definitions.definition: the most recent period in the earth's history , when human activities have a very important effect on the earth's environment and climate (= weather conditions )
definitions.def_translation: 人类世（地球最近的时期，这一时期人类活动对地球环境和气候变化产生了非常重要的影响）

examples.text: Many geologists believe that humans have altered the earth so much since the start of the industrial revolution that we are now living in a new epoch called the Anthropocene.
examples.translation: 许多地质学家认为，自工业革命开始以来，人类已经大大改变了地球，以至于我们现在生活在一个被称为 "人类世 "的新纪元。

more_examples.text: Arguments occur as to when, if at all, the Holocene ended and the Anthropocene began.
To assign a specific date to the onset of the "Anthropocene" seems somewhat arbitrary, but we propose the latter part of the 18th century.
The Anthropocene represents a new phase in the history of both humankind and of the Earth, when natural forces and human forces became intertwined.

definitions.definition: relating or referring to the most recent period in the earth's history , when human activities have a very important effect on the earth's environment and climate (= weather conditions )

examples.text: The Anthropocene Epoch is an unofficial unit of geologic time.
examples.translation: 人类世是一个非官方的地质学时间单位。

more_examples.text: This week, we discuss the Anthropocene age, a time when humans are literally shaping the earth.
Anthropocene extinction is an ongoing extinction event of species during the present epoch as a result of human activity.

definitions.definition: considering humans and their existence as the most important and central fact in the universe
a belief in humans and their existence as the most important and central fact in the universe

examples.text: Our anthropocentrism is ruining the world, for us and every other form of life.
examples.translation: 我们的人类中心主义正在摧毁世界，摧毁我们自己的和其他所有生物的世界。

examples.text: His photographs avoid anthropocentrism, with plants, animals, and humans staged as equals.
examples.translation: 他的照片并不以人为中心，而是将植物、动物和人类摆在平等的位置上。

more_examples.text: Radical anthropocentrism comes close to asserting that humans can do whatever they want to nature and the planet.
Science fiction offers the powerful mix of advanced science, adventure, and anthropocentrism.
Anthropocentrism is understandable but narrow and misguided.
My feeling is that our anthropocentrism is deeply engrained.

definitions.definition: caused by humans or their activities
definitions.def_translation: 由人类活动引起的，人为的

examples.text: anthropogenic emissions of greenhouse gases
examples.translation: 人类活动引起的温室气体排放

definitions.definition: like a human being or an ape
definitions.def_translation: 似人的，类人的;似猿的，类猿的

examples.text: Gorillas, chimpanzees, and gibbons are all anthropoid apes, having long arms, no tails, and highly developed brains.
examples.translation: 大猩猩、黑猩猩和长臂猿都是类人猿，都有着很长的前肢、高度发达的大脑，且没有尾巴。

definitions.definition: related to the study of the human race , its culture and society , and its physical development

examples.text: anthropological research/fieldwork
examples.translation: 人类学研究/实地调查

examples.text: the Anthropological Library/Department
examples.translation: 人类学图书馆/系

more_examples.text: She's working with an anthropological field project this summer.
We tended to view ceremonies - even our own wedding - as interesting anthropological exercises.
He's a linguist specializing in anthropological linguistics.

definitions.definition: in a way that relates to the study of the human race , its culture and society , and its physical development

examples.text: The couple are anthropologically trained scholars of popular music.
examples.translation: 这对夫妇是从人类学角度研究流行音乐的学者。

examples.text: This course examines computers anthropologically, as tools revealing the social and cultural order that produces them.
examples.translation: 本课程从人类学角度研究计算机，将其作为揭示产生计算机的社会和文化背景的工具。

more_examples.text: They’ve produced an anthropologically based folk history.
Anthropologically speaking, the programme is clear-sighted and essentially honest and true.
The study is an anthropologically observed examination of life in mid-19th-century rural England.

definitions.definition: someone who scientifically studies humans and their customs , beliefs , and relationships
the study of the human race , its culture and society , and its physical development
treating animals , gods , or objects as if they are human in appearance , character , and behaviour

examples.text: His drawings of birds are vaguely anthropomorphic.
examples.translation: 他画的鸟有点拟人化的风格。

examples.text: anthropomorphic sculptures/robots
examples.translation: 拟人化的雕塑/机器人

more_examples.text: In these fantasy stories gods are anthropomorphic personifications who exist simply because people believe in them.
People's attitudes about an animal tend to be affected by the animal's anthropomorphic characteristics.
The artist said he enjoys presenting pears in anthropomorphic ways.

definitions.definition: the showing or treating of animals , gods , and objects as if they are human in appearance , character , or behaviour

examples.text: The books "Alice in Wonderland", "Peter Rabbit", and "Winnie-the-Pooh" are classic examples of anthropomorphism.
examples.translation: 像《爱丽斯漫游奇境记》、《兔子彼得》和《小熊维尼》这些书都是拟人创作手法的经典例子。

definitions.definition: to show or treat an animal , god , or object as if it is human in appearance , character , or behaviour
definitions.def_translation: 人格化，赋予人性，当作人对待

examples.text: Problems can develop when people anthropomorphize their pets.
examples.translation: 人们将自己宠物当作人来对待的时候就有可能会出现问题。

examples.text: These ancient trees have a great impact because of our tendency to anthropomorphize, seeing them as surrogates for venerable humans.
examples.translation: 这些古树影响深远，因为我们倾向于将其人格化，视其为伟人的化身。

more_examples.text: Beatrix Potter took comfort in the animals she anthropomorphizes in her stories.
An anthropomorphized fire deity has existed in many cultures.
It's only natural to anthropomorphize machines. People have probably been talking to their cars since they were invented.
He begins his journey in Santo Domingo, a city he anthropomorphizes.
When you study something that long, pretty soon you start to think of them as being human; you start anthropomorphizing.

definitions.definition: opposed to or against a particular thing or person

examples.text: We've received a lot of anti letters about that newspaper article.
examples.translation: 我们收到了很多信，都表明反对报纸上的那篇文章。

examples.text: Just because I won't join you, it doesn't mean that I'm anti you.
examples.translation: 我不加入你们，但这丝毫不意味着我反对你们。

definitions.definition: a person who is opposed to something or someone

examples.text: So what do you think about smoking in public places - are you a pro or an anti (= do you support or oppose it)?
examples.translation: 那么你对在公共场所吸烟的看法是什么——赞成还是反对？

definitions.def_translation: 反对堕胎的;反对流产的

examples.text: anti-abortion activists/groups
examples.translation: 反堕胎积极分子／团体

examples.translation: 防衰老护肤霜

examples.translation: 电视上出现了抗艾滋病的广告。

more_examples.text: The organization supports anti-AIDS efforts in countries across the globe.

examples.text: anti-aircraft defences/fire
examples.translation: 防空工事／炮火

examples.text: His anti-alien tirades did not help to promote his political career.
Anti-alien feelings were mounting.
examples.translation: 反外来侨民的情绪越来越高。

more_examples.text: Volunteers for the anti-alien cause work with officials to stop illegal immigrants.

definitions.definition: opposed to or directed against creatures from other planets

examples.text: The movie is a tale of an incompetent anti-alien group bent on tracking down and destroying invading aliens.
examples.translation: 这部电影讲述了一个无能的反外星组织决心追踪并摧毁入侵的外星人的故事。

more_examples.text: Volunteers for the anti-alien cause work with officials to stop illegal immigrants.

definitions.definition: opposed to or directed against America , American people , or the American government

examples.text: He does not want to be labelled anti-American.
examples.translation: 他不想被打上反美的标签。

examples.text: Anti-American sentiment was high in some countries, especially over the war in Iraq.
examples.translation: 在一些国家，反美情绪高涨，尤其是针对拉克战争的那些。

more_examples.text: He claimed he detected anti-American tendencies in the news coverage.

examples.translation: 他对游行示威的人嗤之以鼻，视他们为‘反美人士‘。

more_examples.text: She claimed that anti-Americans were at the heart of the peace movement.

definitions.definition: intended to treat or prevent anaemia (= a medical condition in which there are not enough red blood cells in the blood )

examples.text: He is given the anti-anaemia drug twice a week.
examples.translation: 他每周服用两次抗贫血药。

examples.text: This dish is a source of the anti-anaemia nutrients iron and vitamin B12.
examples.translation: 这道菜是抗贫血营养素铁和维生素 B12 的来源。

more_examples.text: She recently finished a clinical trial for the anti-anaemia drug.

examples.translation: 反种族隔离的抗议者呼吁进行经济制裁。

examples.text: He joined the anti-apartheid movement at the age of 15.

more_examples.text: The veteran anti-apartheid campaigner continued to speak out.

definitions.definition: something, usually a drug or food , that is believed to reduce or prevent sexual desire

examples.text: This herb is known as an anti-aphrodisiac.
Herbal anti-aphrodisiacs are said to include marjoram.
examples.translation: 据说草本抗春药包括马郁兰。

more_examples.text: It might be possible to use anti-aphrodisiacs instead of insecticides to control the pests.

definitions.definition: having or showing a strong dislike of Asian people , or treating them in a cruel and unfair way

examples.text: There had been anti-Asian feeling in the region for many years.
examples.translation: 多年来，该地区一直存在反亚裔情绪。

examples.text: She's not anti-Asian.

examples.translation: 他们被授予了防止股权稀释的权利，以保护他们的投资。

more_examples.text: The firm granted anti-dilution rights to all of its investors.
The company was criticized for promising that the private equity fund would have anti-dilution rights.
This assumes that he has no anti-dilution protection.
Anyone investing 25% would expect antidilution provisions.
anti-dilution adjustments/measures

definitions.definition: the practice of putting high taxes on imports (= goods from other countries ) in order to try to stop companies from other countries selling their products very cheaply in your country , which damages your country's businesses

examples.text: Many national governments formulate anti-dumping policies in order to protect domestic sellers.
examples.translation: 许多国家政府制定反倾销政策，以保护国内卖家。

examples.text: The US government announced high new antidumping duty rates for some suppliers.
The measures are consistent with the World Trade Organization agreement on anti-dumping.

more_examples.text: Products are covered by anti-dumping laws, while services are not.
A number of anti-dumping measures apply in the steel industry.
To protect their industries, Mexico imposed anti-dumping tariffs of as much as 1,005% on some products.
U.S. purchase prices of imported merchandise were compared during an antidumping investigation.
She said there was a need to examine issues related to special treatment and anti-dumping.

definitions.definition: preventing or reducing vomiting or nausea (= the feeling that you are going to vomit )

examples.text: anti-emetic drugs
examples.translation: 止吐药

more_examples.text: Ginger has anti-emetic properties.
Clinical trials to assess the efficacy of anti-emetic therapy have been conducted.
Patients may be given an anti-emetic medication before chemotherapy.

definitions.definition: a substance , especially a medicine , that is used to prevent or reduce vomiting or nausea (= the feeling that you are going to vomit )

examples.text: The doctor gave her an anti-emetic to stop the sickness.
examples.translation: 医生给她开了止吐药，让她不再恶心。

examples.text: There are some antiemetics for motion sickness and mild nausea that are available over the counter.

more_examples.text: Other medications may be required, such as anti-emetics (anti-nausea drugs), antibiotics, and muscle relaxants.
Before the end of anaesthesia, an intravenous antiemetic may be given.

definitions.definition: opposing fascism (= a political system based on a very powerful leader , state control with no political opposition allowed , and being extremely proud of your country and race )

examples.text: Anti-fascist campaigners said they were convinced that the organization was a front for the ultra-right wing British National Party.
examples.translation: 参加反法西斯运动的人士确信这个组织是偏激右翼党派英国国家党的先头部队。

examples.text: My parents organised the Anti-Nazi League, so there was a lot of antifascist activity at home.
examples.translation: 我父母组织了一个反法西斯联盟，因此在家里也有很多反法西斯活动。

more_examples.text: Outspokenly anti-fascist, the conductor declined to conduct for Mussolini or Hitler.
He was considered an enemy alien from Italy despite his father's Jewish heritage and his family's anti-Fascist leanings.
The movie, set in the 1940s in Franco-era Spain, has a powerful anti-Fascist message.
They were interested in producing the play as antifascist propaganda.

definitions.definition: a person who opposes fascism (= a political system based on a very powerful leader , state control with no political opposition allowed , and being extremely proud of your country and race )

examples.text: As an anti-fascist and feminist, she wrote highly political novels.
examples.translation: 作为一名反法西斯人士和女权主义者，她写的小说充满政治性。

examples.text: He was a Jewish anti-Fascist who fled Mussolini's regime.
examples.translation: 他是一名反法西斯的犹太人，逃离了墨索里尼的统治。

more_examples.text: Some consider him a courageous anti-fascist and a learned iconoclast.
A Jew and an anti-Fascist, she fled south after the occupation of France and joined the resistance.
He is a 23 year old antifascist currently serving a prison sentence.

definitions.definition: opposed to a federalist system of government (= one in which power is divided between a central government and several local ones )
definitions.def_translation: 反联邦主义的;反联邦制度的

examples.text: The Foreign Secretary assured anti-federalist MPs that he would not agree to anything that limited British sovereignty.
examples.translation: 外交部长向反联邦制度的下院议员保证，他反对任何限制英国君权的行为。

definitions.definition: someone who is opposed to a system of government in which power is divided between a single central government and several regional ones

examples.text: Many voters are staunch anti-federalists.
examples.translation: 很多选民是坚定的反联邦主义者。

definitions.definition: a style of playing football in which trying to prevent the opposing team from scoring is more important than scoring goals yourselves. Many people consider this style to be boring and against the principles of the game .
definitions.def_translation: 反足球（一种踢足球的风格，认为阻止对方球队进球比自己进球更重要。许多人认为这种风格不仅乏味而且有悖于比赛原则。）

definitions.definition: working against gravity (= the force that attracts objects towards one another, especially the force that makes things fall to the ground ) , or having the opposite effect to gravity
definitions.def_translation: 反重力的;反地球引力的

examples.text: He says that one day we will all have anti-gravity machines allowing us to zoom up into the sky.
examples.translation: 他说，会有那一天，我们将拥有超越地心引力的机器，让我们可以遨游到天空。

examples.text: They theorized that 70 percent of the universe must be composed of an anti-gravity force called dark energy.
examples.translation: 他们推测宇宙的70%须由一种称为暗能量的反引力组成。

more_examples.text: He believes we reached the Moon with the aid of a secret, anti-gravity device that NASA copied from a captured, alien flying saucer.
The anti-gravity treadmill allows athletes to run maintaining a normal gait, body position and technique, but with body weight effectively reduced by 80 percent.
According to this theory dark energy is a bizarre, anti-gravity effect that appears to be speeding up the expansion of the universe.

definitions.definition: according to some scientific theories or in stories , a force that has the opposite effect to gravity (= the force that attracts objects towards one another, especially the force that makes things fall to the ground )

examples.text: Just as normal attractive gravity slows the expansion of the universe, anti-gravity accelerates it.
examples.translation: 正如正常的引力会减慢宇宙的膨胀一样，反引力会加速宇宙膨胀。

examples.text: In my dream I glide up a flight of steps, suspended in midair by anti-gravity.
examples.translation: 在梦中，我滑行了一段台阶，靠反重力悬浮在半空中。

more_examples.text: In very simple terms, these forces can be thought of as gravity and anti-gravity, or yin and yang.
He describes the Martians as having flying machines operating with a form of anti-gravity.

definitions.definition: a brand name for aerial yoga
definitions.def_translation: 反重力瑜伽（aerial yoga 即空中瑜伽的品牌名）

definitions.definition: opposed to the chasing and killing of animals or birds for food , sport , or profit

examples.text: an anti-hunt campaigner/activist/protester
examples.translation: 反狩猎运动倡议者/活动家/抗议者

examples.text: the anti-hunt movement/lobby
examples.translation: 反狩猎运动/游说

examples.text: The argument between the fox hunting fraternity and the antihunt movement continues.
examples.translation: 猎狐协会与反狩猎运动之间的争论仍在继续。

more_examples.text: "Hunting with dogs is cruel and unnecessary," said a leading anti-hunt campaigner.
Anti-hunt activists use aerosol sprays to put the hounds off the foxes' scent.
Anti-hunt protesters have clashed—sometimes violently—with the crews of whaling ships.
The anti-hunt lobby says its campaign will continue until the law is changed.
New anti-hunt legislation has been announced.

definitions.definition: used to treat or prevent infection , or having the effect of treating or preventing infection

examples.text: If infection attacks the body, anti-infective drugs can suppress the infection.
examples.translation: 如果感染侵袭人体，抗感染药物可以抑制感染。

examples.text: Human milk has anti-infective properties.
antibiotics and other antiinfective agents

more_examples.text: Anti-infective agents such as antibiotics may be prescribed prior to an invasive medical procedure to prevent bacterial endocarditis.
This is a urinary anti-infective agent that does not interact with warfarin.
Anti-infective therapy should be adjusted once the results of cultures and other laboratory studies are available.
There are four types of anti-infective drugs: antibacterial (antibiotic), antiviral, antitubercular, and antifungal.

definitions.definition: a drug or other substance used to treat or prevent infection

examples.text: The ampoules are used to administer anti-infectives, vaccines, or insulin.
examples.translation: 安瓿瓶用于注射抗感染药物、疫苗或胰岛素。

examples.text: Large doses of anti-infective are used.
The big companies have the money to develop antiinfectives.

more_examples.text: Prophylactic use of anti-infectives (bacterial, fungal, viral) should be considered for the prevention and management of infections during this period.
The company had made progress on a new form of anti-infective.

definitions.definition: used to treat or prevent inflammation (= swelling in or on a part of the body ) , or having the effect of treating or preventing inflammation

examples.text: The team is testing the molecules for anti-inflammation and antioxidant properties.
examples.translation: 研究小组正在测试这些分子的抗炎和抗氧化特性。

examples.text: non-steroidal antiinflammation drugs

more_examples.text: The active components have various biological functions including anti-oxidant, anti-microbial , anti-inflammation, anti-diabetic and anti-tumour activity.
Scientists suggest the same compounds that give cherries their bright red colour may also give them their natural anti-inflammation power.
This plant is very high in vitamin E, and also contains anti-inflammation properties that help soft tissue repair.

definitions.definition: An anti-inflammatory drug is one that is used to reduce pain and swelling .
definitions.def_translation: 消炎的，抗炎的;止痛消肿的

examples.text: anti-inflammatory drugs for arthritis
examples.translation: 治疗关节炎的消炎药

definitions.definition: an anti-inflammatory drug

examples.text: Aspirin is an anti-inflammatory.
examples.translation: 阿司匹林是一种止痛消炎药。

definitions.definition: supporting the idea that a pregnant woman should have the freedom to choose an abortion (= the intentional ending of pregnancy )

examples.text: the anti-life lobby
examples.translation: 赞成堕胎的游说团体

definitions.definition: used to describe a type of brake that prevents the uncontrolled sliding of a vehicle by reducing the effects of braking suddenly
preventing or treating malaria (= a disease , common in many hot countries , that you can get from the bite of a flying insect called a mosquito )

examples.text: anti-malarial drugs/medication/medicine
examples.translation: 抗疟药/药物治疗/药物

examples.text: The indigenous people of Peru discovered that quinine had antimalarial properties.
examples.translation: 秘鲁土著人发现奎宁具有抗疟疾的特性。

examples.text: Burn anti-malarial coils and sleep under netting at night.
examples.translation: 点燃抗疟疾蚊香，晚上睡在蚊帐里。

more_examples.text: The anti-malarial drugs familiar to overseas travellers are expensive and only offer short-term protection.
He had taken anti-malarial medication, but caught a strain that was resistant to the drugs.
Effective anti-malarial medicines are in critically short supply.
All crew members are issued with anti-malarial tablets.
Certain medications, including antimalarial agents, may interfere with antibody response to vaccines.

definitions.definition: a drug or other substance that prevents or treats malaria

examples.text: The drug is expected to be licensed as an anti-malarial early next year.
examples.translation: 该药物有望在明年初获得抗疟疾药物的许可。

examples.text: The efficacy rates of some antimalarials are not very high.
examples.translation: 一些抗疟药的疗效不是很高。

examples.text: The organization distributes mosquito nets and anti-malarials.
examples.translation: 该组织分发蚊帐和抗疟药。

more_examples.text: They were trekking through the cloud forest in search of the Cinchona tree, a valuable anti-malarial.
Quinine has been used for many years as an anti-malarial.
It is the cheapest and most widely used antimalarial, but resistance is common.
To reduce the risk of malaria, protect yourself against mosquito bites and take recommended anti-malarials.

definitions.definition: sound that is produced in such a way that it matches exactly and removes the effect of loud and possibly harmful noises , such as those produced by large engines in factories
definitions.def_translation: （用于抵消有害噪声的）抗噪声

definitions.definition: opposed to the production and use of nuclear weapons , or to the production of electricity from nuclear power
definitions.def_translation: 反对生产和使用核武器的;反对使用核能的

examples.text: the anti-nuclear lobby/movement
examples.translation: 反核游说团体／运动

examples.text: Some environmentalists are vehemently anti-nuclear.
examples.translation: 一些环保主义者也是积极的反对使用核能人士。

definitions.definition: blocking the action of oestrogen (= a female hormone affecting the organs involved in producing babies )

examples.text: anti-oestrogen drugs
examples.translation: 抗雌激素药物

examples.text: The drug is the standard anti-oestrogen treatment for breast cancer.

more_examples.text: All of the women in the study had breast cancer, but only half received anti-oestrogen therapy.
This drug had been known for some time to work as an anti-oestrogen agent.

definitions.definition: opposed to a particular political party or to political parties in general

examples.text: He was expelled from the party on grounds of anti-party activities.
examples.translation: 他因反党活动被开除党籍。

examples.text: What made him so popular was his maverick, independent, anti-party establishment status.
examples.translation: 让他如此受欢迎的是他非同凡响、独立而反党派建制的身份。

more_examples.text: Maybe it's only through an anti-party candidate that the break with centralism has a chance of being effective.
Independents are the antiparty force, trying to restructure the partisan political system.
In 1937 he was arrested for alleged anti-party activities.

definitions.definition: Anti-personnel weapons are weapons that are intended to kill or injure people rather than damage weapons or buildings .
definitions.def_translation: （武器）用于杀伤人的；杀伤性的

examples.text: anti-personnel mines
examples.translation: 杀伤性地雷

definitions.definition: opposed to or preventing the use of pesticides (= chemical substances used to kill harmful insects , small animals , wild plants , and other unwanted organisms )

examples.text: The insecticide DDT became a prime target of the growing anti-pesticide movement during the 1960s.
examples.translation: 杀虫剂 DDT 成为 1960 年代逐渐壮大的反杀虫剂运动的主要目标。

examples.text: The state passed what is believed to be the toughest anti-pesticide law in the country.
examples.translation: 该州通过了据信是该国最严厉的反农药法。

more_examples.text: She is cited as an inspiration across the environmental spectrum, by endangered-species advocates and anti-pesticide groups.
Critics question whether the money might be better spent on an antipesticide awareness campaign.
An international antipesticide treaty makes an exception for the use of DDT in malarial areas.

definitions.definition: intended to prevent piracy (= the act of illegally copying and selling music , films , computer programs , etc.)

examples.text: The company sells anti-piracy software to the film and television industries.
examples.translation: 这家公司对影视行业出售防盗版软件。

examples.text: The government has introduced tough new anti-piracy legislation.
examples.translation: 政府对反盗版进行了新的立法。

more_examples.text: Worldwide, the film industry spends billions on anti-piracy measures each year.
All e-book systems place a premium on antipiracy features.
No matter how severe the anti-piracy efforts are, users will figure out how to get around them.

definitions.definition: intended to prevent piracy (= the act of attacking ships in order to steal from them)

examples.text: Nato is considering a significant extension of its anti-piracy mission off the coast of Somalia.
examples.translation: 北大西洋公约组织正在考虑大幅地扩展它在索马里海岸地区的防海盗任务。

examples.text: The European Union recently launched an antipiracy operation in the gulf.
examples.translation: 欧盟最近在海湾地区开展了反海盗行动。

more_examples.text: Royal Navy ships are taking part in anti-piracy patrols in several regions.
Flaws in anti-piracy laws are hampering the fight against ship hijacks in the area.
On Wednesday, an international antipiracy force rescued a cargo ship that had been taken over by pirates.

definitions.definition: intended to protect against plague , a very infectious and serious disease caused by bacteria spread mainly by fleas (= small insects that bite ) on rats or other animals

examples.text: In 1896, when the plague broke out in Bombay, she allowed her son to be injected with the anti-plague serum.
examples.translation: 1896年，孟买爆发鼠疫，她让儿子注射了抗鼠疫血清。

examples.text: an anti-plague recipe of herbs
examples.translation: 草药的抗鼠疫配方

more_examples.text: The authorities instituted an aggressive programme of anti-plague measures.
The antiplague serum was conceived between 1894 and 1895 at the Pasteur Institute.
Between 1897 and 1925, 26 million doses of Haffkine's anti-plague vaccine were sent out.

definitions.definition: intended to prevent or destroy plaque (= a substance containing bacteria that forms on the surface of teeth )

examples.text: Look for a fluoride toothpaste that has anti-plaque agents.
examples.translation: 选用含有抗牙菌斑剂的氟化物牙膏。

examples.text: Sodium bicarbonate is found in some anti-plaque mouthwash products and toothpaste.
examples.translation: 一些抗牙菌斑漱口水产品和牙膏中含有碳酸氢钠。

more_examples.text: Chlorhexidine gluconate is an effective anti-plaque agent, but may cause staining if used for long periods.
Our anti-plaque toothpaste is designed to reduce up to 90% plaque in hard-to-reach areas.
Antiseptic and anti-plaque mouth rinse claims to kill bacterial plaque.

definitions.definition: intended to stop platelets (= cells in the blood ) sticking together to form blood clots (= pieces of thick blood )

examples.text: After surgey, the patient is typically placed on anti-platelet drugs to prevent blood clotting.
examples.translation: 手术后，病人通常要服用抗血小板药物以防止血液凝固。

examples.text: Low-dose aspirin, used as an antiplatelet agent, seems to be safe throughout pregnancy.

more_examples.text: Doctors gave him anti-platelet medication.
Aspirin is commonly used for its antiplatelet effect.
Should serious bleeding occur antiplatelet therapy should be discontinued.

definitions.definition: a drug that stops platelets (= cells in the blood ) sticking together to form blood clots (= pieces of thick blood )

examples.text: Symptoms can be treated via medication, such as anti-platelets, which can help reduce the likelihood of blood clots.
examples.translation: 症状可以通过药物治疗，如抗血小板药物，这可以帮助减少形成血凝块的可能性。

more_examples.text: GP practices are asked to audit patients taking anti-platelets to ensure that the duration of therapy is appropriate.
Current stroke guidelines do not allow antiplatelets until after 24 hours from thrombolysis.
Antiplatelets work by inhibiting the enzymes that cause the platelets to clump together.

definitions.definition: opposed to pleasure , or thinking of pleasure as a bad thing

examples.text: School syllabuses have always been dominated by an anti-smoking, anti-drinking, and generally anti-pleasure agenda.
examples.translation: 学校教学大纲一直以反吸烟、反饮酒和普遍的反享乐内容为主导。

examples.text: His sumptuous art is a response to what he calls an "anti-sensual, anti-pleasure" tradition.
examples.translation: 他奢华的艺术是对他所谓的“反感官、反享乐”传统的回应。

more_examples.text: Our work-oriented ethic, which is anti-pleasure, anti-leisure, and anti-laughter, is perpetuated by our educational systems.
The text articulates a programme of self-discipline and self-improvement which is totally anti-pleasure.
The old anti-pleasure attitudes remained, and they still hang over our heads to this day.

definitions.definition: opposed to or against the police

examples.text: A group of about 100 fans began chanting anti-police slogans.
examples.translation: 大约100名球迷开始高呼反警察口号。

examples.text: I think there are people with an anti-police bias.

more_examples.text: At the other extreme were hooded protesters yelling antipolice abuse.
I am not anti-police but I do strongly object to hindrance to individuals who are going about their lawful business.
He shouted antipolice obscenities when he was arrested.
To me that is just another unjustified, anti police statement.

definitions.definition: opposed to politics or to traditional political activities

examples.text: There is a distinctly anti-political mood, as voters feel that they can make better decisions for themselves than politicians.
I am not a political person - in fact, I am nearly anti-political.
examples.translation: 我对政治不感兴趣——事实上，我几乎是反对政治的。

more_examples.text: He advances an essentially anti-political view of the world.
How do you engage Britain's apathetic, antipolitical teenagers in the political process?
Growing transparency and the scrutiny of politicians by the media are factors in the antipolitical trend.

definitions.definition: beliefs and activities opposed to politics or to traditional political activities

examples.text: There is little doubt that antipolitics is the strongest form of politics among these groups.
The establishment didn't like the language, or the anti-politics, they were propagating.
examples.translation: 当局不喜欢他们的宣传用语或反政治的内容。

more_examples.text: They can make their effect by argument and action, not by a bogus romance with anti-politics.
Many in the establishment are hoping that anti-politics will be self-limiting.
The impasse has prompted alternatives to emerge which may be generating an anti-politics in environmental governance.

definitions.definition: opposed to politics or to traditional political activities

examples.text: They are responding to the anti-politics mood of our age.
One reason why she is so popular is because she's anti-politics.
examples.translation: 她如此受欢迎的一个原因是因为她反政治的态度。

more_examples.text: The campaign has tapped into the public mood which is anti-politician and anti-politics.
They cannot win an election in this anti-politics era by arguing in favour of more government.
His anti-politics rhetoric is highly critical of neo-liberal policies.

definitions.definition: opposed to popular ideas or to popular interests

examples.text: Being avowedly anti-popular in his politics, he was not likely to be very popular in his personality.
A motion reproaching the government for promoting anti-popular policies was tabled by opposition parties.
examples.translation: 反对党提出了一项指责政府推行反民众政策的动议。

more_examples.text: We completely reject these anti-popular measures.
They had hoped to change the government, which they deemed anti-popular.
This strikingly illustrates the profoundly undemocratic and anti-popular sympathies of that group.
These anti-popular regimes commit countless injustices against women.

definitions.definition: informal for anti-pornography

examples.text: She later became a leading anti-porn campaigner.
examples.translation: 她后来成为反色情运动的领军人物。

examples.text: Anti-porn groups have been lobbying the administration to go after the adult-entertainment business.
examples.translation: 反色情组织一直在游说政府打击成人娱乐业。

more_examples.text: Most public libraries have anti-porn policies.
Moralist and anti-porn campaigns are nothing new.
Anti-porn movements are re-emerging among a new generation of feminist activists.
He feels that some people have a very antiporn mindset.
She insists that she is not an anti-porn activist.
He took a hard line against pornography and antiporn activists had high hopes.

definitions.definition: opposed to or not allowing pornography (= books , magazines , films , etc. with no artistic value that describe or show sexual acts )

examples.text: Parents' groups and anti-pornography campaigners have urged the local authority to deny the company a trading licence.
examples.translation: 家长团体和反色情运动人士敦促地方当局拒绝向该公司发放营业执照。

examples.text: A group of adult-oriented businesses sought to block anti-pornography legislation.
examples.translation: 一群以成人为导向的企业试图阻止反色情立法。

examples.text: an anti-pornographic demonstration
examples.translation: 反色情示威

more_examples.text: We have the toughest anti-pornography laws in Western Europe.
There should be stricter implementation of anti-pornographic laws.
Officers from the antipornography unit raided 22 Adults Only stores across the province.

definitions.definition: opposed to or not allowing the use of cannabis (= a drug that is made from dried hemp and is illegal in many countries )

examples.text: He predicts more vigorous anti-pot enforcement at all levels of government.
examples.translation: 他预计各级政府将加大反大麻执法力度。

examples.text: Some of the state’s most prominent anti-pot politicians are taking thousands of dollars in donations from marijuana companies.

more_examples.text: Anti-pot campaigners face a new obstacle.
The administration's efforts to enforce anti-pot laws have faced bipartisan pushback.
The anti-pot lobby’s efforts run counter to a tide of liberalization when it comes to marijuana law.

definitions.definition: opposed to or intended to reduce poverty (= the condition of being extremely poor )

examples.text: While the government raised welfare rates, anti-poverty activists feel the increase is inadequate.
examples.translation: 虽然政府提高了福利额度，但反贫困积极分子仍然认为增幅不够。

examples.text: This forms part of a new package of anti-poverty measures.
examples.translation: 这是新一揽子扶贫措施的一部分。

more_examples.text: The move has been welcomed by anti-poverty campaigners.
Reaction to the plan among antipoverty experts and advocates has been mixed so far.
The minister responsible for antipoverty strategies has launched a whole range of task forces and action groups.

definitions.definition: intended to protect an animal against predators (= animals that hunt and kill other animals )
definitions.def_translation: 反捕食的（其他动物自我保护不受捕食动物的伤害）

examples.text: Seals probably group together primarily as an antipredator strategy.
examples.translation: 海豹聚集在一起可能主要是作为一种反捕食策略。

examples.text: Avoidance is the most common anti-predator behaviour.
examples.translation: 回避是最常见的反捕食行为。

more_examples.text: Camouflage is a common form of antipredator defence.

examples.translation: 第一天上学，孩子们通常都会感到非常不安。

examples.translation: 焦虑症的症状包括恐慌、恐惧和强迫行为。

examples.translation: 那个时候，所有有头有脸的人物都到这家高级小饭馆来进餐。

examples.translation: 随便放哪儿就可以——哪儿都无所谓。
