examples.translation: 今天下午我这里见。

definitions.definition: belonging or relating to a group of white people with pale hair and blue eyes , believed by Nazis to be better than other groups
definitions.def_translation: （尤指浅色头发、蓝眼睛、被纳粹认为是最优等人种的）雅利安人的，北欧日耳曼人的

definitions.definition: relating to the small cartilages (= two pyramid-shaped parts ) and muscles that are connected at the back of the larynx
used in comparisons to refer to the degree of something

examples.text: She'll soon be as tall as her mother.
examples.translation: 她很快就会和她母亲一样高了。

examples.text: I can't run as fast as you.
examples.translation: 我跑得没你快。

examples.text: skin as soft as a baby's
examples.translation: 像婴儿一样娇嫩的肌肤

examples.text: It's not as good as it used to be.
examples.translation: 这个不如以前好了。

more_examples.text: Feel my toes - they're as cold as ice.
Country life isn't always as peaceful as city-dwellers think.
I don't think he's been watering these plants - the soil is as dry as a bone.
She can't run as fast as she used to.
The apple pie was as good as the one my grandmother used to make.

definitions.definition: used to describe the purpose or quality of someone or something

examples.text: The people in the crowd rolled up their programs and used them as bullhorns.
She works as a waitress.
examples.translation: 她是名服务员。

examples.text: It could be used as evidence against him.
examples.translation: 这可以用作对他不利的证据。

examples.text: The news came as quite a shock to us.
examples.translation: 这个消息让我们都很震惊。

examples.text: I meant it as a joke.
examples.translation: 这话我只是当玩笑讲的。

more_examples.text: He wouldn't be my choice as a friend.
Yesterday the selectors chose Dales as the team's new captain.
Chris has an evening job as an office cleaner.
If we clear out the spare room, you can use it as a study.
His latest film is described as a 'romantic comedy'.

definitions.definition: because

examples.text: As it was getting late, I decided to book into a hotel.
examples.translation: 因为天色已晚，我决定找家旅馆投宿。

examples.text: You can go first as you're the oldest.
examples.translation: 你可以第一个去，因为你年纪最大。

more_examples.text: I'd frayed the edges of my jeans as that was the fashion in those days.
I asked the teacher if I could be excused from football practice as my knee still hurt.
The ceasefire treaty was meaningless, as neither side ever had any intention of keeping to it.
Improved safety measures in cars can be counterproductive as they encourage people to drive faster.
This man is desperate and should not be approached as he may have a gun.

definitions.definition: during the time that

examples.text: I saw him as I was coming into the building.
examples.translation: 我进楼时看到了他。

examples.text: He gets more attractive as he gets older.
examples.translation: 随着年龄的增长，他变得愈发有魅力。

more_examples.text: He checked off their names on the list as they got on the coach.
Everyone cheered as the winners received their medals.
Just as I was sitting down to watch TV, the phone rang.
The flames grew larger as the fire spread.
I tripped as I got off the bus.

definitions.definition: in the same way

examples.text: As I was just saying, I think the proposal needs further consideration.
examples.translation: 正如我刚才所说的，我认为这个提议需要进一步考虑。

examples.text: As is often the case with children, Amy was completely better by the time the doctor arrived.
examples.translation: 就像经常发生在儿童身上的情况一样，医生赶到时，埃米的病情彻底好转了。

examples.text: He got divorced, just as his parents had done years before.
examples.translation: 他离婚了，（完全）重蹈了多年前他父母婚姻破裂的覆辙。

examples.text: This year, as in previous years, tickets sold very quickly.
examples.translation: 像往年一样，今年的票卖得很快。

examples.text: Knowing him as I do, I can't believe he would do such a thing.
examples.translation: 以我对他的了解，我无法相信他会做这样的事。

more_examples.text: The town centre looks exactly as it did when it was built in 1877.
She told me not to ask any questions, just to do as she did.
Sound and pictures can be stored digitally, as on a CD.
My grandmother died a natural death , as she would have wanted.
They face a hard task, as yesterday's discussions amply demonstrated.

definitions.definition: although

examples.text: Angry as he was, he couldn't help smiling.
examples.translation: 尽管他很生气，可还是忍不住笑了。

definitions.definition: If you do something as (if) to the manner born , you do it very well and very naturally as if it is usual and easy for you.
usually

examples.text: As a general rule, I don't read detective novels.
examples.translation: 我通常不看侦探小说。

definitions.definition: if all other methods fail
definitions.def_translation: 作为最后一招，在万不得已的时候

examples.text: British police are supposed to use guns only as a last resort.
examples.translation: 英国警方只有在万不得已的时候才能开枪。

definitions.definition: If something is done as a matter of course , it is a usual part of the way in which things are done and is not special .
definitions.def_translation: （作为）理所当然的事；（当作）常规

examples.text: Safety precautions are observed as a matter of course.
examples.translation: 安全防范措施作为常规检查进行。

definitions.definition: used to add something more to what you have just said
definitions.def_translation: 说真的（表示在刚刚说的基础上在加一点）

examples.text: The shoes are still stylish, and as a matter of fact , I'm wearing a pair right now.
examples.translation: 这样的鞋子还是很时髦的，说真的，我现在脚上就穿着一双。

definitions.definition: used to say that you do not agree with what someone has just said or that the opposite of what they say is true
definitions.def_translation: 事实上（表示不同意别人刚刚所说的，或是事实刚好相反）

examples.text: We're not losing population in our town. As a matter of fact, people are moving in.
examples.translation: 我们的镇子没有出现人口流失，事实上，人们正在搬到这里来。

definitions.definition: because of something

examples.text: Profits have declined as a result of the recent drop in sales.
examples.translation: 由于最近销售量滑坡，利润下降了。

examples.text: As a result of the accident, he suffered permanent brain damage.
In future, extreme weather events are likely to be worse and more frequent as a result of climate change.
She died last week as a result of complications from Parkinson's disease.
It was suspected that the building had collapsed as a result of structural failure.

definitions.definition: when considered as a group and not in parts

examples.text: The population as a whole is getting healthier.
examples.translation: 总体看来，居民的健康状况正在改善。

definitions.definition: compared to

examples.text: He earns $80,000 a year, as against my $40,000.
examples.translation: 他年薪8万美元，而我的年薪是4万美元。

definitions.definition: very typical and normal in America
definitions.def_translation: 如苹果派一样美国化;美国特色;具有美国特色

examples.text: He defended his driving, saying "fast cars are as American as apple pie."
examples.translation: 他为自己的驾驶风格辩言道：“跟苹果派一样，开快车可是典型的美国特色。”

examples.text: Diverse families are now becoming as American as apple pie.
examples.translation: 多元化家庭在美国一如苹果派般平常。

definitions.definition: at the time that something happens

examples.text: We don't own a car - we just rent one as and when we need it.
examples.translation: 我们没有车——只是在需要的时候就去租一辆。

definitions.definition: completely bald

examples.text: When he took off his hat, we saw that he was as bald as a coot!
examples.translation: 他脱帽后，我们发现他头全秃了！

examples.text: He was as bald as a coot by the time he was 20.
He was skinny, bald as a coot, and he didn't have a tooth in his head.
Did you know he's as bald as a coot under that wig?
I don't care if you're as bald as a coot - I still love you!

definitions.definition: as well as you can

examples.text: It is a difficult passage, but just translate it as best you can.
examples.translation: 这段文章确实很难，不过你尽力翻译就可以了。

examples.text: We're just ordinary people trying to raise our family as best we can.
They keep up their cultural traditions as best they can.
He began, as best he could, to rebuild his life.
I explained the situation to her as best I could.

data.word: as big, fast, good, etc. as ever

definitions.definition: as big , fast , etc. as at any time before
definitions.def_translation: 像往常一样大／快／好（等等）

examples.text: The restaurants are as good as ever and no more expensive.
examples.translation: 这些饭店的饭菜仍像往常一样美味可口，而且也没有涨价。

examples.text: The group's political tactics remain as aggressive as ever.
This year's event promises to be as big as ever, with over 10,000 tickets sold.
Well into her eighties and she remains as active as ever.
Huge numbers of tourists flock to the area and the problem of illegal parking is as bad as ever.

definitions.definition: rather than

examples.text: She's a personal assistant, as distinct from a secretary.
examples.translation: 她是私人助理而不是秘书。

examples.text: The rate of increase, as distinct from the amount of the increase, is really what's important here.
Material comfort was seen as distinct from overall happiness.
To be a lover of nature, as distinct from a lover of perfectly tended gardens, is to reject pesticides and herbicides in all their forms.
I like to think that our staff work with us, as distinct from working for us.

definitions.definition: extremely dry

examples.text: I don't think he's been watering these plants - the soil is as dry as a bone.
examples.translation: 我想他没给这些植物浇水——土都干透了。

definitions.definition: in the same way as always

examples.text: As ever, I was the last to find out.
examples.translation: 像往常一样，我又是最后一个知道的。

examples.text: As ever, his writing is lucid and witty.
The hotel staff were, as ever, incredibly helpful.
The orchestra, brilliant as ever, treated us to a variety of classic music.
As ever, the best produce came from local farms.

definitions.definition: used before you mention a fact that is familiar to everyone, including children

examples.text: As every schoolboy knows, the earth revolves around the sun.
examples.translation: 地球绕着太阳转，这是小学生的常识。

definitions.definition: used to say that something has good qualities but could be better

examples.text: It's a good essay as far as it goes.
examples.translation: 这篇短文还算不错。

data.word: as far as someone is concerned

definitions.definition: in a particular person's opinion

examples.text: As far as I'm concerned, feng shui doesn't work.
examples.translation: 在我看来，有关风水的说法根本就沒有道理。

examples.text: As far as I'm concerned, education is education whether it happens inside or outside the classroom.
As far as she was concerned, learning English was the most important thing.
As far as Louise was concerned, Will wasn't paying her enough attention.
As far as he was concerned, the blame for his financial woes lay with the state.

data.word: as far as someone is concerned

definitions.definition: if we are discussing or thinking about a particular thing

examples.text: As far as unemployment's concerned, a change of policy on job creation would be a good idea.
examples.translation: 就失业问题而言，改变创造工作机会的有关政策会是个好主意。

examples.text: We've done very badly as far as planning is concerned.
Allowing people to bring in large bags is a risk as far as safety is concerned.
The club has an important place in the community as far as golf is concerned.
As far as the weather's concerned, I'd stay indoors today, if I were you.

data.word: as far as the eye can/could see

definitions.definition: for a long distance until something is so far away and small it cannot be seen any more
definitions.def_translation: 一直到眼睛看不见的地方;直到看不见;远出视野

examples.text: The road stretched into the distance as far as the eye could see.
examples.translation: 大路向远方延伸，直到天边。

data.word: as fast as your legs would carry you

definitions.definition: as quickly as possible

examples.text: He scuttled back into the house as fast as his legs would carry him.
examples.translation: 他匆忙全速奔回屋里。

definitions.definition: said to introduce a list of things

examples.text: The winners are as follows - Woods, Smith, and Cassidy.
examples.translation: 获胜者如下：伍兹，史密斯和卡西迪。

examples.text: The demographics broke down as follows: 48 percent male, 52 percent female, 16 percent under 18 years old, 25 percent age 18-45, 40 percent age 46-65, 19 percent age over 65.
The key trends observed were as follows: low turnout in rural places, higher turnout in urban areas, low turnout for anti-government parties.
Overall, 762 incidents were reported, broken down as follows: violent crimes, 430; vandalism, 212; weapons-related incidents, 56; and substance abuse-related offences, 64.

definitions.definition: used to talk about how another person or thing is affected by something

examples.text: As for Louise, well, who cares what she thinks.
examples.translation: 至于路易丝嘛，哼，谁管她是怎么想的。

definitions.definition: almost

examples.text: The decorating is as good as finished - I just need to finish off the painting.
examples.translation: 装修接近完工——我只需要把漆刷完就大功告成了。

definitions.definition: very guilty , miserable , or ugly
in the same way as two people who are married

examples.text: Although never married, they lived together as husband and wife for 50 years.
examples.translation: 尽管没有结婚，他们却像夫妻一样共同生活了50年。

definitions.definition: used to say that you are not interested in or worried about something that has happened or that someone has said
definitions.def_translation: 好像我会在乎似的，我才不在乎呢

examples.text: He said he didn't approve of what I'd done, as if I cared.
examples.translation: 他说他对我的所作所为不赞同，我才不在乎呢。

examples.text: She called to tell me I'd upset Sam with my comments. As if I care.
She keeps sending me photos of her cats, as if I care.
So the first thing he wanted me to know was that he didn't judge me for my decision. As if I cared.
Anyway, he's not talking to me at the moment, as if I cared.

data.word: as if it is going out of style

definitions.definition: very quickly or much more than people normally do
definitions.def_translation: （比正常情况下做得）非常快且更多

examples.text: She was gulping down sandwiches and cakes as if they were going out of style.
examples.translation: 她大吃三明治和蛋糕，吃得又快又多。

data.word: as if you owned the place

definitions.definition: in a way that is too confident
definitions.def_translation: 神气得好像自己是主人;喧宾夺主

examples.text: He walked into the office as if he owned the place.
examples.translation: 他走进办公室，神气得好似主人一样。

definitions.definition: said to show that you do not believe something is possible

examples.text: "Did you get a pay rise?" "As if!"
examples.translation: “你加薪了吗？”“没影的事儿！”

definitions.definition: used to describe how a situation seems to be

examples.text: She looked as if she'd had some bad news.
examples.translation: 她看上去好像有什么坏消息似的。

examples.text: I felt as though I'd been lying in the sun for hours.
examples.translation: 我觉得好像已经晒了好几个小时的太阳。

examples.text: They stared at me as if I was crazy.
examples.translation: 他们盯着我，就像看疯子一样。

definitions.definition: in the state that something is in at the present time

examples.text: Will you wait till it's finished or take it home as is?
examples.translation: 你是等着它完全做好呢，还是就这样拿回家？

definitions.definition: If someone asks how they should prepare your drink and you say as it comes, you mean that any way will be acceptable .

examples.text: "How do you like your coffee?" "Oh, as it comes."
examples.translation: “你要什么样的咖啡?”“噢，随便。”

definitions.definition: already

examples.text: I'm not buying the children anything else today - I've spent far too much money as it is.
examples.translation: 今天我不会再给孩子们买任何别的东西了——我花的钱已经太多了。

definitions.definition: sometimes said after a figurative (= not meaning exactly what it appears to mean ) or unusual expression
definitions.def_translation: 可以说是;在一定程度上

examples.text: If he still refuses we could always apply a little pressure, as it were.
examples.translation: 如果他还是拒绝，我们总还可以在一定程度上给他施加点压力。

definitions.definition: an exam of a standard between GCSE and A level taken in England and Wales , which allows more subjects to be studied than is possible at A level because less information needs to be learned for it. Students then take A2 exams , usually a year later , which together make a full A level qualification .
definitions.def_translation: （英格兰和威尔士地区的）高级补充程度会考

examples.text: I'm doing (= studying) five AS levels.
examples.translation: 我正在学习5门高级补充程度会考课程。

examples.text: AS level French
examples.translation: 高级补充程度会考法语考试

definitions.definition: probably

examples.text: As likely as not, she'll end up in court over this problem.
examples.translation: 关于这个问题她最终很可能会诉诸法律。

examples.text: In those days, a woman would as likely as not be widowed by 50.
If children are not given boundaries, they will as likely as not feel insecure.
You will find a warm welcome at the hotel and, as likely as not, several more groups of walkers.
If you are a billionaire, you as likely as not have several homes scattered around the globe.

definitions.definition: by chance

examples.text: We ran out of petrol on the way home, but as luck would have it, we were very near a garage.
examples.translation: 我们在回家的路上汽油用光了，幸好当时离加油站不远。

definitions.definition: the same amount again

examples.text: My fare was £10, and it was almost as much again for the children.
examples.translation: 我的船费将近10英镑，孩子们的加起来差不多是我的两倍。

definitions.definition: almost

examples.text: He as much as admitted that it was his fault.
examples.translation: 他实际上已经承认那是他的错。

data.word: as much as the next person

definitions.definition: as much as anyone would

examples.text: I enjoy winning awards as much as the next guy, but other things are more important to me.
examples.translation: 我跟别人一样喜欢得奖，不过对我来说，还有其他更重要的事情。

data.word: as much as you can do

definitions.definition: If you say something is as much as you can do, you manage to do it, but with great difficulty .

examples.text: I felt so ill this morning, it was as much as I could do to get out of bed.
examples.translation: 我今天早上病得很厉害，几乎下不了床。

definitions.definition: If you say that you thought / expected /said as much, it means that something bad that you thought / expected /said would happen has happened .

examples.text: I knew he'd fail - I said as much at the time.
examples.translation: 我知道他会失败——我早就说过了。

definitions.definition: the same

examples.text: Go on, lend me the money - you know I'd do as much for you.
examples.translation: 快点，借钱给我吧——你知道我也会同样借钱给你的。

data.word: as much, quickly, soon, etc. as possible

definitions.definition: as much, quickly , soon , etc. as something can happen or be done

examples.text: Please take your seats as quickly as possible.
examples.translation: 请尽快入座。

examples.text: I'll go as soon as possible.
examples.translation: 我会尽快走。

examples.text: I'm looking for a hair spray that will keep my hairstyle in place for as long as possible.
We try to protect him from the bullies as much as possible.
Try to explain the situation as calmly as possible.

definitions.definition: in a way that has never been possible before

examples.text: Satellite technology offers the opportunity, as never before, for continuous television coverage of major international events.
examples.translation: 卫星技术为实现重大国际事件的不间断电视报道提供了前所未有的机会。

definitions.definition: starting from a particular time or date

examples.text: As of next month, all the airline's fares will be going up.
examples.translation: 自下月起，所有航空公司的机票价格都将上调。

definitions.definition: used to say that someone is very old
If a group of people do something as one man, they do it together at exactly the same time .

examples.text: As one man, the delegates made for the exit.
examples.translation: 代表们全都向出口走去。

definitions.definition: rather than

examples.text: I'd prefer to go in May, as opposed to September.
examples.translation: 我更愿意5月份去，而不是9月份。

examples.text: What about the stores that they own, as opposed to the ones they lease?
Too little is made of music that is good (as opposed to merely popular).
People should be able to get out into nature and experience it, as opposed to glimpsing it from afar.
The goal is to inspire lasting changes as opposed to offering quick fixes.

definitions.definition: according to the instructions

examples.text: I had two spoonfuls after lunch, as per instructions.
examples.translation: 我按照说明午饭后吃了两匙。

definitions.definition: as usual

examples.text: Carlo turned up without any money, as per usual.
examples.translation: 卡洛出现时又像往常那样身无分文了。

definitions.definition: very safe

data.word: as smooth as silk/a baby's bottom

definitions.definition: extremely smooth

examples.text: Her skin was as smooth as silk.
examples.translation: 她的皮肤如丝一般光滑。

definitions.definition: used to show that the name , explanation , etc. of something tells you something else about it

examples.text: Variable rate loans, as the name implies, have a variable interest rate.
examples.translation: 可变利率贷款，正如名字所暗示的，是一种利率可能变化的贷款。

examples.text: Limewater is made from calcium hydroxide and, as this implies, can be used as a calcium supplement for aquariums.
As its name implies, the function of a herb processor is to chop herbs.
It is a non-use aquifer so, as the name implies, nobody in the city drinks its water.
As its title implies, thefilm is about the team's final baseball season.

data.word: as the actress said to the bishop

definitions.definition: used to show that someone has said something that could have another meaning connected to sex
definitions.def_translation: 诙谐地暗示某人的言语有情色意味

examples.text: It slides right into the hole, as the actress said to the bishop.
examples.translation: “它不偏不倚地滑进洞里”，这话很暧昧。

definitions.definition: one of the stated possibilities that is true

examples.text: When the election is called in April, or June, as the case might be, we shall be ready for it.
examples.translation: 不管选举是在4月还是6月举行，我们都将做好准备。

examples.text: At around three o'clock, we'll break for a drink or a light snack, as the case might be.
You'll then be able to retire to your rooms or join us in the Atrium Bar for drinks, whatever the case might be.
Clients are then free to decide whether to continue with the subscription or not, as the case might be.
Keep running or swimming, or whatever the case might be, and your cardiovascular health will improve.

definitions.definition: used to say that a distance is measured in a straight line between two points or places
definitions.def_translation: 笔直地，成直线地，沿直线

definitions.definition: about

examples.text: He was uncertain as to which road to take.
examples.translation: 他拿不准该走哪条路。

examples.text: There's no decision as to when the work might start.
examples.translation: 至于工作什么时候开始，还没有作出决定。

definitions.definition: changing the subject to
definitions.def_translation: （表示转到另一个话题）至于，关于

examples.text: As to where we'll get the money from, we'll talk about that later.
examples.translation: 至于到哪儿去搞到这笔钱，我们以后再说吧。

data.word: as ye sow, so shall ye reap

definitions.definition: used to mean that the way you behave in life will affect the treatment you will receive from others
as you are doing a job or activity
definitions.def_translation: 在工作中;在活动进行过程中

examples.text: We have a flexible approach to what we're doing that allows us to make any necessary changes as we go along.
examples.translation: 我们的工作方式很灵活，这使我们在工作中可以作出必要的改进。

examples.text: I'll explain the rules as we go along.
examples.translation: 我会在进行过程中解释规则。

examples.text: So as we're going along wrapping presents, she jumps up and runs out of the room for no reason.
Like everyone, we make things up as we go along.
We start with a basic treatment plan and then we adapt it as we go along.
We're all learning as we go along.

definitions.definition: used to agree to a request , especially when you do not approve
definitions.def_translation: （尤指实际并不同意某人的要求时）悉听尊便

examples.text: "I think we should leave now." "Very well. As you wish."
examples.translation: “我觉得我们该走了。”“那好吧，悉听尊便。”

definitions.definition: used to emphasize a description of an unpleasant characteristic

examples.text: She's really quite unpleasant about other people and she's as mean as hell.
examples.translation: 她对待他人很不友好，并且还吝啬得要命。

definitions.definition: unable to see well

examples.text: I'm as blind as a bat without my glasses.
examples.translation: 不戴眼镜我就看不清。

definitions.definition: with extreme confidence or without the respect or politeness people usually show
definitions.def_translation: 及其胆大妄为;极为唐突无礼

examples.text: She marched into the store, as bold as brass, and demanded her money back.
examples.translation: 她厚着脸皮闯进商店要求把钱退给她。

definitions.definition: extremely clean
very easy to hear

examples.text: Clear as a bell, from the back of the theatre came a child's voice saying, "I want to go home".
examples.translation: 从戏院的后面传来一个小孩清脆响亮的声音：“我要回家。”

definitions.definition: very easy to understand

examples.text: The instructions were as clear as day.
examples.translation: 使用说明上写得清清楚楚。

definitions.definition: certain

examples.text: It's as clear as day that the government is going to win the election.
examples.translation: 政府肯定会赢得选举。

definitions.definition: very difficult to understand

examples.text: His instructions were as clear as mud.
examples.translation: 他的指示让人稀里糊涂。

definitions.definition: very calm or very calmly , especially when this is surprising
definitions.def_translation: （尤指出奇地）镇静，冷静，泰然自若

examples.text: She walked in as cool as a cucumber, as if nothing had happened.
examples.translation: 她泰然自若地走进来，好像什么事也没发生过。

definitions.definition: completely deaf
definitions.def_translation: 一点儿也听不见，完全失聪

examples.text: Grandad's as deaf as a post.
examples.translation: 爷爷一点儿声音也听不见了。

data.word: (as) easy as pie/ABC/anything/falling off a log

definitions.definition: extremely easy
completely free to do as you want
very eager and interested in everything
used as a way of describing a person you see , and are surprised to see , in a particular place
definitions.def_translation: （表示见到某人本人感到惊奇）本人，本身

examples.text: I looked up from my newspaper and there he was, as large as life, Tim Trotter!
examples.translation: 我看完报纸抬起头来，竟意外地看到了蒂姆‧特罗特，真的是他本人，一点儿没错。

definitions.definition: very light
very long

examples.text: There was a list of complaints as long as your arm.
examples.translation: 投诉足可以列一个很长的单子。

definitions.definition: extremely silly or stupid
If two men talk (as) man to man, they talk seriously and honestly together on an equal level .
definitions.def_translation: （谈话）开诚布公地，平等而坦率地

definitions.definition: very pleased

examples.text: She was as pleased as Punch about the news.
examples.translation: 听到那个消息她心花怒放。

definitions.definition: extremely proud or satisfied with yourself

examples.text: Jones was once described by a friend as being as proud as Lucifer.
examples.translation: 琼斯曾被一位朋友形容为相当自负。

definitions.definition: never late or always at the same time

examples.text: In this country the trains are regular as clockwork.
examples.translation: 在这个国家，列车非常准时。

examples.text: He calls me every day at ten, as regular as clockwork.
examples.translation: 他每天十点钟给我打电话，非常准时。

definitions.definition: very straight

examples.text: The old lady's back is still as straight as a ramrod.
examples.translation: 这位老太太的腰杆还是那样挺拔。

definitions.definition: extremely straight

examples.text: The road runs (as) straight as a die for 50 or so miles.
examples.translation: 这条路笔直地延伸了50英里左右。

definitions.definition: completely honest

examples.text: She's as straight as a die, I can trust her to tell me what she's really thinking.
examples.translation: 她非常坦诚，我相信她会告诉我她的真实想法。

definitions.definition: for certain
definitions.def_translation: 肯定，毫无疑问，千真万确

examples.text: One day he'll realize that I was right, as sure as eggs is eggs.
examples.translation: 毫无疑问，他总有一天会认识到我是对的。

definitions.definition: used for emphasis

examples.text: There better be another way in - I'm sure as hell not climbing up all those steps.
examples.translation: 最好还有别的路可以进去——我是肯定不会爬那么多台阶的。

definitions.definition: very stupid

examples.text: He's a very skilled football player but he's as thick as two short planks.
examples.translation: 他是个技术很好的足球运动员，但是他这人是笨到了极点。

definitions.definition: very strong , and not easily made weaker

examples.text: He might be in his eighties but he's tough as old boots, that man.
examples.translation: 那个男人可能已经有80多岁了，可他身体依然硬朗。

definitions.definition: Tough food is very difficult to cut or eat .
If someone is (as) white as a sheet , their face is very pale , usually because of illness , shock , or fear .
definitions.def_translation: （指某人的脸色）苍白的，面无血色的

data.word: as, if, when, etc. the spirit moves someone

definitions.definition: taking action only when you feel is the right time , not following a plan

examples.text: It's impossible to predict what he'll do - he just acts when the spirit moves him.
examples.translation: 根本不可能预测他会做什么——他做事情纯凭感觉。

definitions.definition: used to add emphasis to an adjective or adverb
definitions.def_translation: （用于强调形容词或副词）非常，很，无比

examples.text: He's as fat as anything (= very fat).
examples.translation: 他很胖。

definitions.definition: in comparison with most other things of a particular type , especially when you do not think that type of thing is very good
definitions.def_translation: 就某类…而言，和一般…相比（尤指认为此类事物不太好）

examples.text: It was quite a good film, as horror films go.
examples.translation: 就恐怖片而言，这片子还算不错。

examples.text: I suppose the concert was OK, as these things go.
examples.translation: 就此类演出而言，我想这次音乐会还可以。

examples.text: As burgers go, it was a pretty good one, I guess.
I mean it was reasonably entertaining, as kids' movies go.
It was an okay campsite as these things go.

data.word: as/so far as I can tell

definitions.definition: used to say what you have noticed or understood

examples.text: There's been no change, as far as I can tell.
examples.translation: 依我看，一直都没有变化。

examples.text: As far as I can tell, we'd get no benefit from these changes.
They haven't done any research as far as I can tell.
So far as I can tell, they usually ignore complaints.
It's a tiny kitchen, but so far as I can tell it has everything we need.

definitions.definition: used to say what you think is true , although you do not know all the facts

examples.text: He isn't coming today, as far as I know.
examples.translation: 据我所知，他今天不来。

examples.text: As far as I know, there is no evidence to back up his claims.
I asked him to give her some money, and as far as I know, the matter was taken care of.
I haven't seen Ray for years, but so far as I know, he's still alive.
So far as I know, her students were unaware of the incident.

definitions.definition: used to say what your personal opinion is about something

examples.text: She can come whenever she likes, as far as I'm concerned.
examples.translation: 就我而言，她什么时候想来都可以。

examples.text: As far as I'm concerned, a good online shopping site should be easy to use.
That's the best argument for more women in business ,so far as I'm concerned.
My family no longer exists as far as I'm concerned.
So far as I'm concerned, she is an absolute goddess.

definitions.definition: one of the positions of the body used in yoga

examples.text: The downward dog is a posture or "asana" used in yoga.
examples.translation: 下犬式是瑜伽中使用的一种姿势或“体式”。

examples.text: In this branch of yoga, each asana is joined to the next to create a flowing series of movements.
examples.translation: 在瑜伽的这一分支中，每个体式都与下一个相结合，形成一系列流畅的动作。

more_examples.text: The ancient yogis developed asanas partly by observing how animals move.
The muscles and organs of the abdominal area are fully activated in this asana.
The half bridge is a more advanced asana.
There will be two daily classes, including asana, pranayama and meditation.

definitions.definition: the part of yoga that consists of holding the body in different positions

examples.text: Asana (the physical practice) is only one part of yoga.
examples.translation: 体式（身体练习）只是瑜伽的一部分。

examples.text: Hatha yoga includes asana (physical postures), pranayama (breath control), and deep relaxation.
examples.translation: 哈达瑜伽包括体式（身体姿势）、调息（呼吸控制）和深度放松。

more_examples.text: The ancient yogis developed asanas partly by observing how animals move.

The course covers the practice and teaching of asana and pranayama.

definitions.definition: abbreviation for as soon as possible
definitions.def_translation: 尽快（as soon as possible的缩写）

examples.text: Please reply ASAP.
examples.translation: 请尽快答复。

definitions.definition: abbreviation for antisocial behaviour : behaviour , such as making too much noise and threatening people , that is unpleasant but not a crime
definitions.def_translation: 反社会行为（antisocial behaviour 的缩写，指制造噪音、威胁别人等令人不快的行为，但非犯罪行为）

examples.text: If you experience or witness ASB, help is available.
examples.translation: 如果你遭受了或目睹了反社会行为，有相关机构提供帮助。

examples.text: Studies of ASB have found two subgroups of behaviors.
examples.translation: 有关反社会行为的研究发现了两个行为亚类。

more_examples.text: How do I report ASB?
ASB can roughly be described as aggressive and nonaggressive ASB.

definitions.definition: a soft , greyish-white material that does not burn , used especially in the past in buildings , clothing , etc. as a protection against fire and as a form of insulation (= a way of stopping heat from escaping )
a serious medical condition caused by breathing threads of asbestos into the lungs

definitions.def_translation: 反社会行为禁令（anti-social behaviour order的缩写）

definitions.definition: abbreviation for autism spectrum condition
definitions.def_translation: [autism spectrum condition的缩写]孤独症谱系状况

examples.text: Women with ASC present in wide-ranging and subtle ways.
examples.translation: 患有自闭症的女性以形式各异且微妙的方式体现出来。

more_examples.text: Autism spectrum conditions (ASC) are "neurodevelopmental", meaning that the brain and central nervous system develop and function atypically.
The special interests of children with ASC may differ from their neurotypical peers, or may be similar but much more intense.
Females with ASC are more inclined towards sociability, emotionality and friendship than males with these conditions.

definitions.definition: to move up or climb something

examples.text: They slowly ascended the steep path up the mountain.
examples.translation: 他们沿着陡峭的山路缓缓向上攀登。

examples.text: There's a long flight of steps ascending (= leading up) to the cathedral doors.
examples.translation: 要往上走很长一段台阶才能到达大教堂的门前。

definitions.definition: to rise to a position of higher rank
definitions.def_translation: 登上高的职位;升级，晋级

examples.text: He eventually ascended to the position of chief executive.
examples.translation: 他最终登上了总裁的宝座。

definitions.definition: to become queen or king
a position of power , strength , or success
definitions.def_translation: 权势显赫，处尊居显；优势，支配地位

examples.text: They are in danger of losing their political ascendancy (= controlling power).
examples.translation: 他们的政治权位岌岌可危。

examples.text: Supporters of the proposal are currently in the ascendancy over its opponents (= are more powerful than them).
examples.translation: 提案的支持者目前占据上风（压倒了反对者）。

definitions.definition: increasingly successful or powerful
definitions.def_translation: 飞黄腾达；步步高升；日益受欢迎；占有优势

examples.text: He's very much in the ascendant in Hollywood.
examples.translation: 他在好莱坞的事业蒸蒸日上。

definitions.definition: part of a written or typed letter that reaches higher than the top of a letter "x", for example the upper part of the letters "b", "d", or "h"

examples.text: The point size of a font is measured from the top of the ascender to the bottom of the descender.
examples.translation: 字体的磅值是通过测量升部的顶端到降部的底端之间的距离而定的。

examples.text: His writing was large and flowing, with prominent ascenders and descenders.
examples.translation: 他的字大且（线条）流畅，升部和降部都很显眼。

more_examples.text: The child must be able to produce letters that are recognizably formed and have clear ascenders and descenders.
The lower case letters were 4 mm in height without ascenders.
Remember to leave space above and below the line for ascenders and descenders.

definitions.definition: a device that can be attached to a rope and used as a support to hold or stand on when climbing

examples.text: The final 20 metres to the top was extremely steep, requiring use of the ascender and ice axe to pull you up.
examples.translation: 通往山顶的最后20米非常陡峭，需要使用上升器和冰斧来拉着你往上爬。

more_examples.text: In the afternoon session we learned how to use ascenders when climbing.

definitions.definition: increasing in size or value

examples.text: I shall list my objections to the plan in ascending order of importance.
examples.translation: 我将会把我反对这个计划的理由按重要性从小到大一一列出。

definitions.definition: moving upwards or to higher levels , often used to refer to sensory pathways in the nervous system
definitions.def_translation: （尤指神经通路）上行的，上升的

definitions.definition: the process of rising to a position of higher importance , rank , or success

examples.text: After his time in the US Army, Ashe continued his ascension in the world of tennis.
examples.translation: 从美国陆军退役以后，阿什继续提升他在国际网坛的排名。

examples.text: His daughter's ascension to the speakership, a first for a woman, is a matter of great pride for him.
examples.translation: 他的女儿被提升成议长，女性中第一位，对他来说是非常值得骄傲的事。

definitions.definition: the action of climbing or moving upwards

examples.text: Fibrosis of the fallopian tube can prevent the ascension of sperm through the canal.
examples.translation: 输卵管纤维化可能阻止精子通过输卵管上升。

examples.text: He never managed to cross the Atlantic via balloon, but he made hundreds of ascensions.
examples.translation: 他从未成功乘坐气球穿越大西洋，但他进行了数百次升空尝试。

more_examples.text: With the ascension of Mary Tudor to the English throne in 1553, the 1552 Book of Common Prayer was abolished.
The Executive Committee put the brakes on Jones' ascension to the top job.
Krause said Cartwright possesses all the qualities he desires in a coach, which is why his ascension came so rapidly.

There have been a series of ascensions from the office of secretary of state in Arizona to the Governor's Office.
Reading about Petrarch's ascension of Mount Ventoux leaves me breathless.
The stairwell-like ascension of strips of coloured fabric in the quilt patterns are referred to as "courthouse steps."

definitions.definition: the process of going up from earth to heaven , especially the process of Jesus Christ going up to heaven after his death and resurrection (= return to life )
definitions.def_translation: 升天，尤指耶稣死后复活升天

examples.text: The Ascension of Christ is depicted in this stained-glass window.
examples.translation: 这扇彩绘玻璃窗画的是耶稣升天的事迹。

more_examples.text: Acts 13:33 cites the passage and applies it to Christ’s resurrection from the dead and His ascension into heaven.
The section concludes with the ascension of Basilissa's nuns to heaven.
He had a vision of his mother's resurrection and ascension and her welcome into the company of the saints.
There is no waiting period for those in the second harvest; their ascensions will occur at the very the same moment they discard their physical bodies.

definitions.definition: the sixth Thursday after Easter , when Christians celebrate Christ's journey from earth to heaven
definitions.def_translation: 耶稣升天节（复活节后的第六个星期四）

definitions.definition: the act of climbing or moving upwards

examples.text: She made her first successful ascent of Everest last year.
examples.translation: 她去年第一次成功攀登了珠穆朗玛峰。

examples.text: As the plane made its ascent, we saw thick smoke coming from one engine.
examples.translation: 飞机在上升时，我们看到一个引擎中冒出了浓烟。

definitions.definition: a slope , path , or road that goes up something
definitions.def_translation: 向上的斜坡；向上的小径；向上的道路

examples.text: We struggled up the slippery ascent.
examples.translation: 那段上坡路很滑，我们吃力地向上走。

definitions.definition: the fact of starting to become successful

examples.text: His ascent to power was rapid and unexpected.
examples.translation: 他出人意料地平步青云。

definitions.definition: to discover something

examples.text: The police have so far been unable to ascertain the cause of the explosion.
examples.translation: 警方到目前为止尚未查明爆炸原因。

examples.text: Have you ascertained whether she's coming or not?
examples.translation: 你问清楚了吗，她来还是不来？

definitions.definition: to make certain of something

examples.text: I ascertained that no one could overhear us before I told Otto the news.
examples.translation: 确信没有人能听到我们的谈话之后，我才把这个消息告诉了奥托。

definitions.definition: avoiding physical pleasures and living a simple life , often for religious reasons
definitions.def_translation: （常指因宗教原因）苦行的，禁欲的，过清苦生活的

examples.text: They live a very ascetic life.
examples.translation: 他们过着清心寡欲的生活。

definitions.definition: someone who lives an ascetic life , often for religious reasons

examples.text: He lived as an ascetic.
examples.translation: 他过着苦行者的日子。

definitions.definition: in a way that involves living a simple life without physical pleasures , often for religious reasons

examples.text: He lives purely and ascetically.
examples.translation: 他过着纯粹而苦行的生活。

examples.text: It is a story of living ascetically in a forest inhabited by Buddhist monks.
examples.translation: 这是一个在佛教僧侣居住的森林中苦行的故事。

more_examples.text: At their monastery, the women live as ascetically as their male counterparts.
Her home is ascetically furnished with just a desk and single bed.
As a young man he was ascetically thin.

definitions.definition: the practice of living a simple life without physical pleasures , often for religious reasons

examples.text: He believed a closer relationship with God could be found through strict asceticism.
examples.translation: 他相信通过严格的禁欲主义可以找到与上帝更亲密的关系。

examples.text: It seems unfair to judge her by the asceticism of the office that she moved into less than six months ago.
examples.translation: 以她不到六个月前搬进的办公室的简朴装潢来判断她似乎是不公平的。

more_examples.text: At one time he argued for a culture of asceticism and socialist revolutionary philosophy.
As a form of asceticism, celibacy is more at home with a hermit in the desert or a monk in a monastery.
For all the asceticism of his work, he’s a man who loves to be photographed and to wear good tweed and leather.
Her asceticism was assumed to carry with it supernatural ability, and eventually she became famous.

definitions.definition: abbreviation for American Standard Code for Information Interchange: a way of storing numbers , letters, or symbols for exchanging information between computer systems
definitions.def_translation: 美国信息交换用标准代码（American Standard Code for Information Interchange的缩写）

examples.text: a document in ASCII format
examples.translation: ASCII 格式文件

definitions.definition: → vitamin C
a wide , straight piece of material worn like a tie in the open neck of a shirt
to believe or say that something is caused by something else

examples.text: To what do you ascribe your phenomenal success?
examples.translation: 你认为你取得如此巨大成功的原因是什么？

definitions.definition: to believe or claim that something was said, written, or created by a particular person
definitions.def_translation: 把…归属于；认为是…所说（或写、创作等）

examples.text: After years of research, scholars have finally ascribed this anonymous play to Christopher Marlowe.
examples.translation: 经过多年研究，学者们终于认定这部佚名剧作出自克里斯托弗•马洛的手笔。

definitions.definition: to believe that a particular quality or feature belongs to or is typical of someone or something

examples.text: People like to ascribe human feelings to animals.
examples.translation: 人们愿意认为动物有像人一样的情感。

definitions.definition: a belief or decision that a particular quality or feature belongs to or is typical of someone or something
definitions.def_translation: 赋予某人或某物特定的性质或特质，归属

examples.text: Most teachers would reject the ascription of particular traits to whole groups of children on the basis of social class.
examples.translation: 大多数教师会拒绝根据社会阶层将某些特性赋予整个儿童群体。

more_examples.text: Animism is the ascription of a spiritual life to all of creation.
Her tendency to sweeping generalizations and ascription of motivation is clear.
We've learned something that might be relevant to the legal ascription of responsibility.
the ascription of traditional domestic and non-domestic roles to the female and male characters in the book
Ethnic descriptions such as "Spaniard" and "mestizo" were definitions of social and fiscal status rather than of genetic ascription.

definitions.definition: a belief or claim that something was said, written, or created by a particular person
definitions.def_translation: 对（作品、内容）归属权的认定

examples.text: The ascription of the text to Gerves du Bus is questionable.
examples.translation: 不能确认文稿是热尔维斯杜巴斯所写。

more_examples.text: The general likeness of this poem to Barbour's accepted work in verse-length, dialect and style made the ascription plausible.

definitions.definition: a belief or claim that something is caused by something else

examples.text: the ascription of our successes to our own merit
examples.translation: 将我们的成功归功于自身的优点

more_examples.text: the ascription of natural phenomena to a divine cause
In any scientific ascription of cause, we must carefully regard the facts.
the ascription of these acts to evil powers

definitions.definition: abbreviation for autism spectrum disorder
definitions.def_translation: 自闭症（为自闭症谱系障碍的简称）

examples.text: Many people with ASD have different ways of learning, paying attention, or reacting to things.
examples.translation: 许多自闭症患者在如何学习、集中注意力或应对事物上使用不同的模式。

more_examples.text: A diagnosis of ASD is based on core behaviours appearing in early development, usually before three years of age.

The research team developed a machine-learning program to predict which genes may contribute to autism spectrum disorder (ASD).
It's important to understand the healthcare needs of young adults with ASD.

definitions.definition: abbreviation for Association of Southeast Asian Nations
definitions.def_translation: 东南亚国家联盟（Association of Southeast Asian Nations的缩写）

definitions.definition: using lines and symbols that look like writing, but do not have any meaning
definitions.def_translation: （使用线条和符号进行书写，但内容并不包含任何意义的）非语义写作

examples.text: Asemic writing is left to the reader to interpret, almost like the way in which one would deduce meaning from abstract art.
examples.translation: 非语义写作作品任由读者诠释，这跟推测抽象艺术作品的含义类似。

more_examples.text: The key to asemic writing is that even though it is traditionally "unreadable" it still maintains a strong attractive appeal to the reader's eye.
In its most extreme form, this can lead to concrete poetry or asemic writing.
An asemic text is international, and may be "read" in a similar fashion regardless of the reader's natural language.
With the non specificity of asemic writing there comes a vacuum of meaning which is left for the reader to fill in and interpret.

definitions.definition: medically clean or without infection

examples.text: an aseptic wound/dressing/bandage
examples.translation: 经过消毒的伤口／无菌敷料／无菌绷带

definitions.definition: without sex or sexual organs

examples.text: Algae reproduce by both sexual and asexual reproduction.
At this stage in their development the ferns are asexual, producing no flowers.

more_examples.text: I found that the website was a good way of meeting other members of the asexual community.
They had a close but asexual relationship.

definitions.definition: not experiencing sexual attraction (= the feeling of liking someone sexually ) , or relating to people who do not experience sexual attraction

examples.text: The book's diverse cast of characters included an asexual protagonist.
An asexual individual may choose to engage in sexual activity even while not experiencing sexual attraction.

more_examples.text: I found that the website was a good way of meeting other members of the asexual community.

examples.translation: 我每星期省下一些钱，以后好买台新电视机。

examples.translation: 提供辅助看护的养老院跟护理养老院是不同的，因为住在这里的人需要的辅助相比较少。

definitions.definition: written abbreviation for association

definitions.def_translation: 协会，社团，联盟;朋友，同事，（生意）伙伴（association 或 associate的缩写）

definitions.definition: to connect someone or something in your mind with someone or something else
definitions.def_translation: 将…（与…）联系起来，把…联系在一起

examples.translation: 大多数人把这个品牌和优良品质联系在一起。

definitions.definition: someone who is closely connected to another person as a companion , friend , or business partner

examples.translation: 作者的一个密友否认了她患癌症的报道。

examples.text: Mr. Shelton had a meeting that afternoon with a business associate.

definitions.definition: someone who holds an associate's degree

examples.translation: 副导演／制片人

examples.text: I don't want my children associating with drug addicts and alcoholics.
examples.translation: 我不想让我的孩子们与吸毒成性以及酗酒的人交往。

definitions.def_translation: （美国两年制初级大学毕业被授予的）副学士学位，准学士学位

definitions.definition: connected

examples.translation: 她愿意接受这份工作，尽管其伴有各种各样的风险。

definitions.definition: a group of people who work together in a single organization for a particular purpose

examples.translation: 足球协会

examples.translation: 英国医学协会正发起一项全面禁止烟草广告的运动。

definitions.definition: the fact of being involved with or connected to someone or something

examples.translation: 她和这所大学的联系

examples.text: This event was organized in association with a local school.
examples.translation: 这场赛事由一家当地学校协办。

definitions.definition: a feeling or thought that relates to someone or something

examples.text: The beach has positive associations for me as I used to spend my holidays there.
examples.translation: 这片海滩给我一种美好的联想，因为我曾经常去那儿度假。

more_examples.text: His wife's association with a former criminal was a constant source of embarrassment for the prime minister.

examples.translation: 可以使用非常简单的组件构建关联存储器。

the similarity in sound between two syllables that are close together, created by the same vowels but different consonants (e.g. "back" and " hat "), or by the same consonants and different vowels (e.g. " hit " and " hat ")
definitions.def_translation: 准押韵，半谐音（挨得很近的单词辅音押韵而元音不押韵，或元音押韵而辅音不押韵）

definitions.definition: When genes assort, they spread among the cells of a living thing in a particular way.
definitions.def_translation: 基因在生物体内以特定方式组合

definitions.definition: consisting of various types mixed together
definitions.def_translation: 各种各样的；混杂的；什锦的

examples.text: a case of assorted wines
examples.translation: 混装于一箱的不同品牌的酒

definitions.definition: a group of different types of something

examples.translation: 什锦菜蔬

examples.text: An unlikely assortment of rock stars and politicians attended the charity concert.
examples.translation: 平常很少一起出现的摇滚歌星和政界人士共同参加了慈善义演。

definitions.definition: written abbreviation for assistant
to make unpleasant feelings less strong

examples.text: The government has tried to assuage the public's fears.
examples.translation: 政府努力消除公众的恐慌。

definitions.definition: to accept something to be true without question or proof
definitions.def_translation: 假定，假设;臆断，想当然地认为

examples.text: We mustn't assume the suspects' guilt.
examples.translation: 我们千万不能臆断犯罪嫌疑人有罪。

examples.text: I assumed (that) you knew each other because you went to the same school.
examples.translation: 你们不是上的同一所学校嘛？我还以为你们两个认识呢。

examples.text: Let's assume that they're coming and make plans on that basis.
examples.translation: 我们还是假定他们会来，并以此来作出计划。

examples.text: We can't assume the suspects to be guilty simply because they've decided to remain silent.
examples.translation: 我们不能仅仅因为疑犯选择保持沉默就断定他们有罪。

more_examples.text: If you haven't heard by Friday, assume I'm not coming.
She was young and she was wearing student-type clothes so I assumed she was studying here.
There was a knock at the door. Now Jan knew her mother had promised to visit, so she assumed it was her.
They were chatting quite amiably on the phone last night so I assumed everything was okay.
I assumed things had gone well for him as he had a big grin on his face.

definitions.definition: to pretend to have a different name or be someone you are not, or to express a feeling falsely

examples.text: Moving to a different town, he assumed a false name.
examples.translation: 搬家到了另外一个城镇后，他用了个假名字。

examples.text: He assumed a look of indifference but I knew how he felt.
examples.translation: 他装出一副无所谓的样子，但我明白他的内心感受。

examples.text: During the investigation, two detectives assumed the identities of antiques dealers.
examples.translation: 在案件调查中，两名侦探假装成古董商。

definitions.definition: to take or begin to have responsibility or control , sometimes without the right to do so, or to begin to have a characteristic
definitions.def_translation: 承担，担任；僭取，夺取；呈现，具有

examples.text: She is likely to assume the position of team captain next season.
I didn't want to assume the risk of trying to fix the car myself.
The new president assumes office at midnight tonight.
examples.translation: 新总统在今晚午夜就职。

examples.text: The issue has assumed considerable political proportions (= has become a big political problem).
examples.translation: 这已经成为一个很大的政治问题。

examples.text: The terrorists assumed control of the plane and forced it to land in the desert.
examples.translation: 恐怖分子控制了飞机，并使其迫降在沙漠中。

examples.text: If you leave your belongings here, we cannot assume responsibility for what happens to them.

definitions.definition: accepting as true without question or proof

examples.text: Even assuming that smokers do see the health warnings, I doubt they'll take any notice.
examples.translation: 即便假定抽烟者看到了烟盒上的健康警示，我觉得他们也会视而不见。

definitions.definition: something that you accept as true without question or proof

examples.text: People tend to make assumptions about you when you have a disability.
examples.translation: 如果你有残疾，人们往往就会对你妄加臆断。

examples.text: These calculations are based on the assumption that prices will continue to rise.
examples.translation: 这些计算是基于价格会继续上升这一假定之上的。

more_examples.text: They make the naive assumption that because it's popular it must be good.

definitions.definition: the act of taking a position of power , responsibility , etc.:

examples.translation: 革命者突然夺取政权，使军队措手不及。

definitions.definition: the act of taking a position of power , responsibility , etc.
definitions.def_translation: 夺取；获得（权力等）；承担（责任等）

examples.text: The revolutionaries' assumption of power took the army by surprise.
examples.translation: 革命者突然夺取政权，使军队措手不及。

examples.text: The assumption of responsibility for his wife and children shaped his character in a different way.
These measures were halted by Bush's assumption of the presidency.
They entered into a contract with the governor on his assumption of authority.
Many citizens supported the king's assumption of power at first.

definitions.definition: a promise

examples.text: She gave me her assurance (that) she would sign the contract immediately.
examples.translation: 她向我保证她会马上签署合同。

examples.text: Despite the government's repeated assurances to the contrary, taxation has risen over the past decade.
examples.translation: 尽管政府一再保证不会增税，可在过去10年中税收还是提高了。

more_examples.text: Despite repeated assurances that the product is safe, many people have stopped buying it.

examples.translation: 他说话时冷静而自信。

definitions.def_translation: （尤指为消除其忧虑而）确定地对…说，向…保证，使确信;让…放心

examples.text: The unions assured the new owners of the workers' loyalty to the company.
examples.translation: 工会向新企业主保证，工人们对公司是忠诚的。

examples.text: You can rest assured (= feel confident) that I shall be there as promised.
examples.translation: 你放心，我答应了就一定会到的。

examples.translation: “别担心，你的车明天就可以修好，”修理工向他保证。

examples.text: She assured him (that) the car would be ready the next day.
examples.translation: 她向他保证说他的车第二天就能修好。

examples.translation: 首相向选民保证选举后不会增税。

examples.text: The play's popularity has been assured by the critics' rave reviews.
examples.translation: 评论家们的赞誉确保了这部剧的走红。

more_examples.text: Journalists may enter the danger zone but unfortunately we cannot assure their safety.

Excellent exam results meant that she was assured of a place at university.

examples.text: an assured performance
examples.translation: 自信的表演

examples.translation: 既然资金已经落实，这部电影的制作也就有了保证。

examples.translation: 尽管第一局表现令人失望，纳达尔信心十足，稳扎稳打，最终反败为胜。

examples.translation: 仅仅靠钱或许解决不了这些问题，但是没有钱肯定不能解决。

examples.translation: 我已将本课程的必读书目标上了星号。

definitions.def_translation: 在船的尾部；向船的尾部

basalt from asthenospheric mantle
examples.translation: 来自地幔软流圈的玄武岩

definitions.definition: of, relating to, or suffering from asthma
definitions.def_translation: 哮喘病的;患哮喘病的;和哮喘病有关的

examples.translation: 哮喘病发作

examples.translation: 她自幼就患有哮喘病。

examples.translation: 这辆生锈的老车好不容易才呼哧呼哧地点着火。

examples.text: Nearly all eyes are slightly astigmatic.
examples.translation: 几乎所有人的眼睛都有轻微的散光。

examples.text: I’m severely myopic and have an astigmatic defect in my right eye.
examples.translation: 我有严重的近视，右眼有些散光。

definitions.definition: a fault in the lens of the eye that reduces the quality of sight , especially a fault that stops the eye from focusing

definitions.definition: a plant with very small white , pink , or red flowers
definitions.def_translation: 落新妇属植物，开白色、粉红或红色的小花

examples.text: Astilbes have these gorgeous long plumes of flowers that look very striking when in bloom.
examples.translation: 落新妇有这些华丽的长羽状花朵，在盛开时非常引人注目。

definitions.def_translation: 已经起床活动的;四处活动的

examples.text: She was rarely astir later than seven o'clock.
examples.translation: 她很少在7点以后起床。

examples.text: After the explosion, the hospital was astir with overworked nurses and doctors.
examples.translation: 爆炸之后，医院里工作过度的护士和医生都忙个不停。

definitions.definition: to surprise someone very much

examples.text: I was astonished by how much she'd grown.
examples.translation: 她竟然长那么高了，这让我很惊讶。

examples.text: What astonished me was that he didn't seem to mind.
examples.translation: 让我感到诧异的是他好像毫不在乎。

more_examples.text: Her writing shows astonishing depth.
His facility for languages is astonishing.
Ellen's familiarity with pop music is astonishing.

Old people often have astonishing powers of recall.

definitions.definition: very surprised
definitions.def_translation: 感到震惊的;觉得惊骇的

examples.text: I was astonished to see Miriam there.
examples.translation: 我很吃惊地发现米里亚姆竟然在那儿。

examples.text: They looked astonished when I announced I was pregnant.
examples.translation: 我宣布我怀孕的消息时，他们看上去很吃惊。

examples.text: The doctors were astonished at the speed of her recovery.
examples.translation: 她康复速度之快令医生们感到惊讶。

definitions.definition: very surprising

examples.text: Her first novel enjoyed an astonishing success.
examples.translation: 她的第一部小说取得了惊人的成功。

examples.text: It's astonishing to think that only a few years ago he was a completely unknown actor.
examples.translation: 仅仅几年前他还是一个默默无闻的演员，想想真让人觉得难以置信。

more_examples.text: Her writing shows astonishing depth.
His facility for languages is astonishing.
Ellen's familiarity with pop music is astonishing.
What other astonishing nuggets of wisdom do you have for us?
Old people often have astonishing powers of recall.

definitions.definition: in a way that is very surprising

examples.text: She did astonishingly well in her exams.
examples.translation: 她考试考得出奇地好。

examples.text: Astonishingly, I've never visited the British Museum in all the years I've lived here.
examples.translation: 令人惊讶的是，我在这里生活了这些年，却从来没有参观过大英博物馆。

more_examples.text: The cello sonata was astonishingly beautiful.
It’s been, astonishingly, five years since my last visit.
She has an astonishingly vivid memory.

definitions.definition: very great surprise

examples.translation: 她竟然辞职了，这让她的同事们大吃一惊。

examples.translation: 她吃惊得倒抽了一口气。

definitions.definition: to surprise or shock someone very much
