examples.translation: 听到这个消息，我非常震惊。

definitions.definition: very surprised or shocked
definitions.def_translation: 感到震惊的;觉得惊骇的

examples.text: I was astounded to hear that Tina had left.
examples.translation: 听到蒂娜离开的消息，我非常震惊。

definitions.definition: very surprising or shocking
definitions.def_translation: 令人震惊的；使人惊骇的

examples.text: an astounding fact/decision/revelation
examples.translation: 令人震惊的事实／决定／揭示

examples.text: an astounding (= very great) victory/achievement/success
examples.translation: 令人惊叹的胜利／成就／成功

definitions.definition: in a way that is very surprising or shocking

examples.text: We set up our tent by an astoundingly beautiful lake.
examples.translation: 我们在一个美得令人惊叹的湖畔支起了我们的帐篷。

examples.text: Astoundingly, not one single person died in the earthquake.
examples.translation: 令人惊喜的是在这次地震中没有任何一个人死亡。

more_examples.text: I thought he'd made an astoundingly bad decision, but I was wrong.
Space research took off with several astoundingly successful planetary probes.
He has had an astoundingly successful career.

definitions.definition: a bone in the foot of a person or animal that connects the two leg bones in the ankle joint

examples.text: The bones of the leg can move freely over the surface of the astragalus, which forms the roller of the hinge.
examples.translation: 腿骨可以在距骨表面自由移动，距骨就是铰链的滚轮部分。

more_examples.text: The medical name for the ankle-bone is the astragalus.
The astragalus is fused to the tibia in the two preserved specimens of Polacanthus.
The paper describes a method for predicting paleohabitats using measurements of bovid astragali.

definitions.definition: the skin of very young sheep from Astrakhan in southern Russia, or a cloth that looks like this skin . It is covered in tightly curled grey or black wool that looks like fur
definitions.def_translation: 阿斯特拉罕羔羊皮;仿阿斯特拉罕羔羊皮织物

definitions.definition: relating to the stars or outer space

examples.text: After the 1986 Challenger space shuttle crash, it took some time for the dream of astral travel to be revived.
His belief in astrology commits him to the idea that specific events can be predicted on the basis of astral causation.

more_examples.text: An ancient astral chart was discovered near Bethlehem that was thought to show the position of the stars at the time of Jesus's birth.
It was supposed to be space music, but it felt more earthbound than astral.

definitions.definition: relating to a non-physical universe with mysterious forces in it that some people believe to exist

examples.text: They claimed to be able to conjure spirits from the astral realms.
The stone is said to bring clear psychic vision, and to be excellent for meditation and astral travel.

more_examples.text: This energy will flow into your astral body.
Our ethereal soul travels to the astral world and returns with advice about why we are here.

definitions.definition: a place believed by some people to be where a person's spirit goes between dying and entering the spirit world
definitions.def_translation: 星光界，灵界，死后的世界

definitions.definition: away from the correct path or correct way of doing something
definitions.def_translation: 偏离正轨地；迷路地；离开正道地；误入歧途地

examples.text: The letter must have gone astray in the post.
examples.translation: 这封信一定是在邮递过程中丢失了。

examples.text: I was led astray by an out-of-date map.
examples.translation: 我被一张旧地图引入歧途。

examples.text: Her parents worried that she might be led astray (= encouraged to behave badly) by her unsuitable friends.
examples.translation: 她父母担心她会因为交友不当而走上歪路。

definitions.definition: with a leg on each side of something

examples.text: She sat proudly astride her new motorbike.
examples.translation: 她骄傲地骑在新买的摩托车上。

examples.text: The town lies astride (= on either side of) the River Havel.
examples.translation: 这座城镇横跨哈弗尔河。

definitions.definition: with legs wide apart
definitions.def_translation: 两腿分开着；跨骑着；跨坐着

examples.text: He stood there, legs astride.
examples.translation: 他两腿叉开着站在那儿。

definitions.definition: the quality of tasting or smelling dry , sour , and slightly bitter

examples.text: Seville oranges have an astringency that works well as an alternative to lemon.
examples.translation: 塞维利亚橙味道酸涩，完全可以作为柠檬的替代品。

examples.text: Tea has a natural astringency, which is why people often add milk or sugar.
examples.translation: 茶具有天然的涩味，所以大家经常添加牛奶或糖。

more_examples.text: I enjoy the yeasty astringency of a sourdough bread.
Astringency is common in young wines.
This cologne has a bright astringency.

definitions.definition: a quality that causes skin or other tissue to become tight

examples.text: He finds the astringency of an aftershave lotion is refreshing.
examples.translation: 他发现须后水的收敛性能提神。

examples.text: The astringency of the mouthwash is helpful for a sore mouth or laryngitis.
examples.translation: 漱口水的收敛作用有助于治疗口腔疼痛或喉炎。

more_examples.text: The herb is used in medicine for its astringency.
Its astringency makes it effective in stopping bleeding.

definitions.definition: a clever , original quality that expresses criticism that may be unkind

examples.text: He and his brother share the same quick-wittedness and astringency.
examples.translation: 他和他的兄弟都有同样敏捷的思维和尖锐的谈吐。

examples.text: The astringency of his satire is well known.
examples.translation: 他的讽刺之尖锐是众所周知的。

more_examples.text: Her writing lost its astringency and she began to be dismissed as a lightweight.
The film version maintains the satiric astringency of the novel.
She plays the part with savage astringency.

definitions.definition: An astringent substance causes the skin or other tissue to tighten .

examples.text: an astringent cream
examples.translation: 收敛膏

more_examples.text: Zinc sulphate is used as an astringent lotion for ulcers.
The cream combines the astringent actions of sage, lemon and witch hazel with the softening benefits of camomile.
The herb is known for its astringent properties.

definitions.definition: Astringent remarks are clever but unkind or criticize someone.

examples.text: astringent criticism
examples.translation: 尖刻的批评

examples.text: her astringent wit
examples.translation: 她那尖刻的诙谐

more_examples.text: Her writing is refreshingly astringent and provocative.
This smartly astringent drama explores the topic of political reform.
The movie is full of astringent aphorisms.

definitions.definition: a drug or cream that causes the skin or other tissue to tighten

examples.text: You can use an astringent to make your skin less oily.
examples.translation: 你可以用收敛水来减弱皮肤的油性。

more_examples.text: The plant's roots are used in medicine as an astringent.
I use the tea on my skin as an astringent.
After shaving, use after-shave as an astringent.
Peppermint oil is used in products such as mouthwashes, toothpaste, astringents or lip balms.

definitions.definition: in a way that tastes or smells dry , sour , and slightly bitter

examples.text: The salad was astringently bitter.
examples.translation: 这盘沙拉味道苦涩。

examples.text: We snacked on astringently sour discs of white radish.
examples.translation: 我们吃酸涩的白萝卜片小吃。

more_examples.text: Despite feeling the chocolate had an astringently "burnt" character, she found it pleasing.
Bowls of hazelnuts and chicken came dressed astringently with oil and lemon.
The drink is summmery, slightly sweet but still astringently punchy.
Everything smelled astringently clean.

definitions.definition: in a way that is clever and original , but expresses criticism in a way that may be unkind

examples.text: She is astringently amusing.
examples.translation: 她非常有趣。

examples.text: He has written an astringently unsentimental memoir.
examples.translation: 他写了一本冷酷无情的回忆录。

more_examples.text: The programme was a compelling, fast-moving, and astringently witty docudrama about rail privatization.
Bluntness accompanied by honesty can be astringently refreshing.
Weigh's piece paints an astringently satirical portrait of the tiny community of Eldon.
As an author, his power rests in his being astringently assertive.
He has a droll and astringently intelligent presence.

definitions.definition: relating to space , the planets , stars , or other objects in space , or to a structure in the shape of a star
definitions.def_translation: 星的；天体的；宇宙的；外层空间的；星形的

examples.text: astrology
examples.translation: 占星术

examples.text: astronaut
examples.translation: 宇航员

examples.text: astrophysics
examples.translation: 天体物理学

definitions.definition: a circular device used from ancient times until about the 18th century for measuring the position of stars , and on ships for calculating the ship's position
definitions.def_translation: 等高仪，星盘（古时用于测量天体高度等的仪器）

examples.text: The collection includes Islamic astrolabes made from the 11th through 16th centuries.
examples.translation: 这批藏品包括11世纪到16世纪制作的的伊斯兰星盘。

more_examples.text: The astrolabe is a heavy brass ring marked into 360 degrees with a pivoting sighting rule attached at the centre.
Merchant princes of the Renaissance collected ancient artifacts, hand-printed books, fine furniture and beautifully made scientific devices, like astrolabes.
The astrolabe was recovered in 1999 from an underwater archaeological site at Passa Pau, Santiago.
His calculation for the maximum elevation of a rainbow was probably done with an astrolabe.

definitions.definition: someone who studies astrology and uses it to tell people how they believe it will affect their lives
involving or relating to astrology (= the belief that the positions of the sun , moon , planets , and stars affect people's lives and character )

examples.text: an astrological chart/forecast
examples.translation: 占星图

examples.text: He likes to talk about his astrological sign, which is Leo, and reads his horoscope every day.
examples.translation: 他爱谈论自己的狮子星座，每天查阅自己的星座运势。

more_examples.text: People buy astrological paraphernalia, but most of them say they do not believe in astrology.
The lobby ceiling is painted with the astrological symbols of the zodiac.
He thinks astrological events are responsible for all his recent problems.

definitions.definition: the study of the movements and positions of the sun , moon , planets , and stars in the belief that they affect the character and lives of people

more_examples.text: Unlike astronomy, astrology cannot be described as an exact science.
In astrology, a person's personality is supposed to relate to which star sign they were born under.
He really believes that, through astrology, you can predict what will happen to you.
She's one of those people who believes in astrology and reads her horoscope every day.
The author uses astrology to show you how to exploit your potential in every area of life.

definitions.definition: a person who has been trained for travelling in space
the technology relating to space travel
someone who studies astronomy
connected with astronomy
definitions.def_translation: 天文学的；天文的，天体的

examples.text: the Royal Astronomical Society
examples.translation: 皇家天文学会

examples.text: astronomical observations/instruments
examples.translation: 天文观测／仪器

definitions.definition: An astronomical amount is extremely large .
definitions.def_translation: 极为巨大的；天文数字的

examples.text: an astronomical rent/bill/price/fee
examples.translation: 巨额租金／天文数字般的账单／天价／极高的收费

definitions.definition: in a way that is connected with astronomy

examples.text: The satellite will observe objects that are particularly interesting astronomically.
examples.translation: 这颗卫星将会观测从天文学角度来说特别有趣的物体。

definitions.definition: by a very large amount

examples.text: Oil prices have risen astronomically since the early 70s.
examples.translation: 自70年代初以来，石油价格飞涨。

definitions.definition: the scientific study of the universe and of objects that exist naturally in space , such as the moon , the sun , planets , and stars

more_examples.text: Unlike astronomy, astrology cannot be described as an exact science.
I've always had an interest in astronomy.
These ancient scholars were steeped in poetry and painting, as well as maths and astronomy.

definitions.definition: relating to the science of astrophysics (= the study of stars and other objects in space using physical laws )

examples.text: She is a professor of astrophysical and planetary sciences.
examples.translation: 她是天体物理学和行星科学的教授。

examples.text: Much astrophysical research requires very large telescopes.
examples.translation: 许多天体物理学研究需要非常大的望远镜。

examples.text: Scientists at the institute study astrophysical phenomena such as solar flares and supernovae.
examples.translation: 该研究所的科学家研究天体物理现象，如太阳耀斑和超新星。

more_examples.text: The formation of a black hole is fairly well understood in astrophysical terms.
Astrophysical events that occur on a human timescale attract a lot of public attention.
Space station crew conducted a series of Earth observation and astrophysical experiments.
The team’s research was accepted for publication by a prestigious astrophysical journal.

definitions.definition: someone who studies astrophysics (= the study of stars and other objects in space using physical laws )

examples.text: The director of the planetarium is a well-known and popular astrophysicist.
examples.translation: 天文馆的馆长是一位受欢迎的著名天体物理学家。

examples.text: Theoretical astrophysicists work with equations and computer simulations and don't usually get involved in spacecraft design.
examples.translation: 理论天体物理学家从事方程式和计算机模拟工作，通常不参与航天器设计。

more_examples.text: She is a distinguished astrophysicist known for her work on dark matter.
I was surprised to find myself face to face with renowned astrophysicist Stephen Hawking.
Most astrophysicists have accepted the idea that the cosmos was born from a kind of explosion.
He was regarded as one of the very best particle astrophysicists in the world.

definitions.definition: the type of astronomy that uses physical laws and ideas to explain the behaviour of the stars and other objects in space
a brand name for a type of artificial grass surface , used especially for sports fields
definitions.def_translation: （尤用于运动场地的）阿斯特罗人造草皮

definitions.definition: the practice of publishing opinions or comments on the internet , in the media , etc. that appear to come from ordinary members of the public but actually come from a particular company or political group , as a way to make it seem that a product , policy , opinion , etc. is very popular or has a lot of public support
definitions.def_translation: 伪草根营销，伪草根舆论（一种带欺骗性质的营销手法，通过雇用写手在网络上大肆宣传旗下产品，试图营造普通消费者热爱某种产品的虚假印象）

examples.text: They were caught astroturfing—promoting the company by using fake online handles and others' email addresses.
He criticized rivals for trying to discredit the results of the poll and denied running an astroturfing campaign.

more_examples.text: While there are laws in the US against astroturfing in commercial advertising, they do not apply to political advertising.
He accused the company of engaging in what he called a massive campaign of "astroturfing" - planting positive comments about a service on blogs.
Astroturfing campaigns attempt to mislead the public into believing that their opinion or position is shared by most people.
It was revealed that what was claimed to be a grass-roots movement against the city's "diversity education" was in fact an astroturfing campaign by a lobbyist organization.

definitions.definition: able to understand a situation quickly and see how to take advantage of it

examples.text: an astute investor/businesswoman
examples.translation: 精明的投资者／女商人

examples.text: his astute handling of the situation
examples.translation: 他对局势的巧妙处理

examples.text: an astute observer of human behaviour
examples.translation: 人类行为的敏锐观察者

definitions.definition: in a way that shows someone is able to quickly understand a situation and see how to get an advantage from it

examples.text: They took over the company and astutely transformed it into a tech giant.
examples.translation: 他们接管了公司，并巧妙地将其转变为科技巨头。

examples.text: She astutely observed that invisible black ice on a paved surface is not, by its nature, obvious or easy to see.
examples.translation: 她敏锐地观察到，筑好的路面上的隐形黑冰，本身并不明显，也不容易察觉。

more_examples.text: The couple astutely chooses houses to buy, renovate, then resell at a profit.
The business is successful because the managers astutely select medium-priced, high-quality merchandise.
He very astutely understood that many people planning to vote for him would not if he was more well-spoken.

definitions.definition: the quality of being able to quickly understand a situation and see how to get an advantage from it

examples.text: The duo surprised everyone with their astuteness in negotiating the pop music world.
examples.translation: 两人在与流行音乐界谈判时的机敏让所有人都感到惊讶。

examples.text: She is admired for her political astuteness.
examples.translation: 她因其政治敏锐度而受到钦佩。

more_examples.text: Commercial astuteness and an ability to attract talented designers and engineers have made the company a success.
Astuteness is what made him successful at negotiating foreign cultures.
His astuteness is his greatest asset on the tennis court.

definitions.definition: the capital city of Paraguay, in the southwestern part of the country

examples.text: He spent three years in Havana before moving to Asunción.
examples.translation: 在搬去亚松森之前他在哈瓦那住了三年。

examples.text: The treaty was signed in Asunción in 1991.
examples.translation: 这个条约是1991年在亚松森签订的。

more_examples.text: We arrived in Asunción the following morning.
He lives in a small town 20 miles from Asunción.
US economic aid helped construct a 200-mile highway connecting the Paraguayan capital Asunción to the Brazilian border.
The station at Asunción in Paraguay was one of the most remarkable in Latin America.

definitions.definition: into forcefully separated pieces
definitions.def_translation: 破成碎块，散成碎片；分开，离散

examples.text: Their lives were torn asunder by the tragedy.
examples.translation: 这次不幸使得他们的生活支离破碎。

definitions.definition: protection or safety , especially that given by a government to people who have been forced to leave their own countries for their safety or because of war

examples.text: to seek/apply for political asylum
examples.translation: 寻求／申请政治避难

definitions.definition: a hospital for people with mental illnesses

examples.text: a lunatic asylum
examples.translation: 精神病院

definitions.definition: someone who leaves their own country , often for political reasons or because of war , and who travels to another country hoping that the government will protect them and allow them to live there

examples.text: genuine/bogus asylum seekers
examples.translation: 真正／假称受到迫害而寻求政治避难的人

examples.text: A record number of asylum seekers arrived in the UK last month.
examples.translation: 上个月，到英国来寻求政治庇护的人数突破了历史纪录。

definitions.definition: with two halves , sides , or parts that are not exactly the same in shape and size

examples.text: Lisette came back from New York with a trendy asymmetric haircut.
examples.translation: 莉塞特从纽约归来，理了一个两边不对称的新潮发型。

examples.text: Some of the rugs have regular geometric designs and others are decorated with asymmetric shapes.
His slightly asymmetrical features make his face more interesting.

more_examples.text: The craze for asymmetric styles has produced a lot of one-shoulder tops this summer.
Some patients develop back problems due to asymmetric weakness.
The shape of the curve is asymmetric.
Asymmetric information is when each side in the negotation is in possession of a slightly different set of facts.
Economic development and political development in the country proved to be asymmetrical.

definitions.definition: two horizontal bars of different height that are used in an event in women's gymnastics , or the event itself

war between forces that are very different in size and in the weapons and abilities that they have, especially war between a large conventional (= traditional ) army and a smaller group that has to use unusual methods

examples.text: Asymmetric warfare has revealed the limitations of large, immobile armies.
examples.translation: 不对称战争揭示了庞大的非机动军队的局限性。

examples.text: This was a new era of asymmetric war against terrorism.
It can be very difficult to fight an asymmetric war.

more_examples.text: He declared the bombing "an act of asymmetric warfare."
The most valuable weapon in this sort of asymmetrical warfare is intelligence.
National armies must evolve to counter the threats of terrorism and asymmetric warfare.
It was expected that there would be a period of asymmetric war, with suicide bombings and surprise attacks.
The country risks being drawn into an asymmetric war it cannot win.
We are fighting an asymmetrical war against terrorists.

definitions.definition: a genetic disease of the heart muscle in which the wall of the left ventricle (= the hollow space in the heart ) is thicker than normal , so that the size of the left ventricle is reduced and blood flow is blocked or reduced
in such a way that two halves , sides , or parts of something are not exactly the same in shape or size

examples.text: Her hair is cut asymmetrically so it hangs longer on the right side of her face.
examples.translation: 她剪的是不对称的发型，脸颊右侧的头发更长。

examples.text: Chairs were arranged asymmetrically in rows to each side of an off-centre aisle.
examples.translation: 椅子被不对称地摆放在非中心过道的两侧。

more_examples.text: I like the look of the building and its asymmetrically placed windows.
The car’s rear seat is split in two asymmetrically and one or both sides can be folded down.
My understanding is that the two halves of the brain asymmetrically process both music and language.

definitions.definition: the state of two halves , sides , or parts that are not exactly the same in shape or size

examples.text: The brain scan showed a hemispheric asymmetry.
examples.translation: 脑部扫描显示大脑半球的不对称。

examples.text: Physicists are investigating the apparent asymmetry in the amounts of matter and antimatter in the universe.
examples.translation: 物理学家正在研究宇宙中物质和反物质数量的明显不对称性。

more_examples.text: Some people find the asymmetry of the building disorientating.
Asymmetry has been used in the stadium design to customize parts of the building for specific purposes.
Nuclear asymmetry has made some nations fearful and suspicious.
Pockets of economic, educational, and demographic asymmetries need to be addressed on both the local and the national level.

definitions.definition: the condition of not being equal or equally available between two people or groups

examples.text: power/information asymmetries
examples.translation: 权力/信息的不对等

examples.text: Economic asymmetry between the rich and the poor has worsened in recent years.
examples.translation: 近年来，贫富之间的经济不均衡现象更加严重。

more_examples.text: Some people find the asymmetry of the building disorientating.
Asymmetry has been used in the stadium design to customize parts of the building for specific purposes.
Nuclear asymmetry has made some nations fearful and suspicious.
Pockets of economic, educational, and demographic asymmetries need to be addressed on both the local and the national level.

definitions.definition: showing no symptoms of a particular disease

examples.text: asymptomatic HIV infection
examples.translation: 无症状HIV感染

examples.text: Evidence suggests that many Ebola infections are asymptomatic.
examples.translation: 证据显示许多伊波拉病毒感染是无症状的。

examples.text: Most people with chlamydia are asymptomatic and do not seek testing.
examples.translation: 大部分衣原体携带者无症状并且不会主动寻求检测。

definitions.definition: a line that a graph (= a drawing that shows two sets of related amounts ) approaches but does not intersect (= cross )
An asymptotic line is a line that gets closer and closer to a curve as the distance gets closer to infinity .
not happening or done at the same time or speed
definitions.def_translation: 不同时存在；不同时发生的

examples.text: This finding suggests asynchronous climate changes in the Northern and Southern hemispheres.

more_examples.text: We have become used to texting and the idea of asynchronous communication.
This is a multi-disciplinary program, combining on-campus classes, and asynchronous online learning, teaching students how to gather, model, and analyze data.
an asynchronous online course that can be followed from anywhere in the world

definitions.definition: used to show an exact position or particular place
definitions.def_translation: （表示地点或位置）在…里;在…上;在…旁

examples.text: We'll meet you at the entrance.
examples.translation: 我们会在入口处跟你碰头。

examples.text: That bit at the beginning of the film was brilliant.
examples.translation: 电影开头的那一段精彩极了。

examples.text: She's sitting at the table in the corner.
examples.translation: 她坐在角落的一张桌子旁。

examples.text: She was standing at the top of the stairs.
examples.translation: 她在楼梯顶端站着。

examples.text: The dog came and lay down at (= next to) my feet.
examples.translation: 这只狗过来趴在我的脚边。

examples.text: There's someone at the door (= someone is outside and wants to come in).
examples.translation: 有人敲门。

examples.translation: 我们下午去看了场足球比赛。

examples.translation: 我在大学度过了3年美好的时光。

examples.translation: 我打电话给她，但是她出去吃午饭了。

more_examples.text: Security checks have become really strict at the airport.

definitions.definition: used to show an exact or a particular time
definitions.def_translation: （表示确切或某一时间）在…时刻;在…期间;在…岁时

examples.text: There's a meeting at 2.30 this afternoon.
examples.translation: 今天下午两点半有个会。

examples.text: Are you free at lunchtime?
examples.translation: 吃午饭的时候你有空吗？

examples.translation: 理论上说，妇女到了50岁仍可以生育。

examples.translation: 在一天中，这些钟每隔一段时间就会准时鸣响。

examples.text: At no time/point did the company do anything illegal.
examples.translation: 这家公司从未做过任何违法的事情。

examples.text: I'm busy at the moment (= now) - can you call back later?
examples.translation: 我现在很忙，你过一会儿再打回来行吗？

examples.text: It's a shame I wasn't here to meet you - I was overseas at the time (= then).
examples.translation: 真可惜那次我不在，没有见到你——那时我在国外呢。

more_examples.text: People in Britain legally reach adulthood at 18.

definitions.definition: in the direction of

examples.text: She smiled at me.
examples.translation: 她对我微笑了一下。

examples.text: They waved at us as we drove by.
examples.translation: 我们驱车经过时，他们朝我们挥手。

examples.text: She aimed at the target.
examples.translation: 她瞄准目标。

examples.text: "Look at me! Look at me!" called the little girl.
examples.translation: “看看我！看看我！”那个小女孩叫道。

examples.text: He's always shouting at the children.
examples.translation: 他老是冲着孩子们大喊大叫。

more_examples.text: The old man clenched his fist and waved it angrily at us.
She could no longer contain her anger and shouted at him uncontrollably.
The talks are aimed at finding a mutually agreeable solution.
She darted an angry look at me and I shut up.
He fired six shots at the target, but his aim was terrible, and he missed all of them.

definitions.definition: used to show the cause of something, especially a feeling
definitions.def_translation: （尤指感觉是）由于，因为，作为对…的反应

examples.text: We were surprised at the news.
examples.translation: 我们听到这个消息很吃惊。

examples.text: I was quite excited at the prospect.
examples.translation: 想到这种前景，我激动不已。

examples.text: Why does no one ever laugh at my jokes?
examples.translation: 为什么我讲了笑话，从来就没人笑呢？

more_examples.text: There was a chorus of disapproval at his words.
It was a courageous decision to resign in protest at the company's pollution record.
He looked very disappointed at their decision, but did not argue.
I cringed at the sight of my dad dancing.
We were all delighted at the news.

definitions.definition: used to show the activity in which someone's ability is being judged

examples.text: I was never very good at sports.
examples.translation: 我从来都不太擅长体育运动。

examples.text: He's very good at getting on with people.
examples.translation: 他很善于跟人打交道。

examples.text: She's hopeless at organizing things.
examples.translation: 她办什么事情都没有条理，简直不可救药。

more_examples.text: I'm not much good at knitting .
Dave is normally very bad at remembering birthdays.
I expected her to be better at French after studying it for so many years.
Your mother's really brilliant at Scrabble.
You're even worse at maths than I am!

definitions.definition: the @ symbol that joins the name of a person or a department in an organization to a domain name to make an email address

examples.text: "What's your email address?" "It's dictionary at cambridge dot org."
examples.translation: “你的电邮地址是什么？”“是 dictionary@cambridge.org。”

more_examples.text: Granddad wrote 'at' in the address instead of the @ symbol - that's why it didn't work.
Where is the key for 'at' on this keyboard?
You missed out the @ in your email address.
Hold down the shift key, otherwise you will type an inverted comma instead of an 'at' sign.
Alternatively, you can email your order to directcustserve@cambridge.org.

definitions.definition: used to show a price , temperature , rate , speed , etc.
definitions.def_translation: （表示价格、温度、比率、速度等）以，达

examples.text: I'm not going to buy those shoes at $150!
examples.translation: 那么一双鞋要150美元，我才不会买！

examples.text: Inflation is running at 5 percent.
examples.translation: 通货膨胀率达到5%。

examples.text: He was driving at 120 mph when the police spotted him.
examples.translation: 当警察发现他时，他正以120英里的时速行驶。

definitions.definition: used in financial records to show the price , rate , etc. of a particular thing or of each of a number of things on a list
definitions.def_translation: （用于财务记录中表示某一项目的价格、比率等的）符号@

examples.translation: 50件，每件4.75英镑

more_examples.text: The costs of cleaning up the bay are estimated at $1 billion.
We sell a wide range of cosmetics and toiletries at a very reasonable price.
When you buy a new computer, you usually get software included at no extra cost .
With inflation at 500%, the country faces a crisis of confidence.
Water boils at 212° Fahrenheit and 100° Celsius/Centigrade.

definitions.definition: used to show a state , condition , or continuous activity
definitions.def_translation: （表示状态、状况或连续的活动）处于;从事于;忙于

examples.text: a country at war
examples.translation: 处于战争状态的国家

examples.text: children at play
examples.translation: 玩耍的孩子们

more_examples.text: He felt completely at ease.
He says he's at peace when he's walking in the mountains.
Your father is hard at work in his study.
They've been at war for the last five years.
Of the ten men who escaped this morning from Dartmoor Prison, only two are still at liberty .

definitions.definition: finally

examples.text: I've finished my essay at last!
examples.translation: 我终于把论文写完了！

examples.text: At long last the government is starting to listen to our problems.
examples.translation: 政府最后终于开始关注我们的问题了。

examples.text: At last we arrived at the hotel and were taken to our rooms.
In the countryside she found herself freed at last from the anxiety that had plagued her in the city.
He has agreed, at long last, to give his version of events.

definitions.definition: used when saying what is the largest possible amount or number

examples.text: At most, the work will take a week.
examples.translation: 这项工作最多要花一星期时间。

examples.text: It should cost around $20, or $30 at the most.
examples.translation: 应该是20美元左右，最多30美元。

examples.text: They weigh a few ounces at most.
She must have been five or six years of age at most.
This costs most companies a few thousand pounds at the most.
Food accounts for 15 percent of their revenue at the very most.

definitions.definition: relaxed

examples.text: He felt completely at ease.
examples.translation: 他感到全身放松。

examples.text: She soon put/set me at my ease.
examples.translation: 她很快消除了我的紧张情绪。

examples.text: The president seemed at ease during the press conference, and even cracked a few jokes.
He was a seasoned performer, completely at his ease on the stage.
A good interviewer will know how to put you at your ease.

more_examples.text: She has a carefree attitude, a sense of ease.
His life of ease had not prepared him to deal with such hardships.
The balm seemed to give her ease.

definitions.definition: (of a soldier ) standing with feet apart and hands behind the back

examples.text: The soldiers come to attention when an officer enters the room and stand at ease when the officer allows it.
The officers were at ease until the White House doors opened, and then they all stood at attention for the President's arrival.
You must stand at attention until the commanding officer issues the command, "At ease".
He ordered his troops to stand at ease.
The sentries were given permission to hold their rifles with both hands while standing at ease.

definitions.definition: when you want to and when you have time to

examples.text: You can take the documents home and study them at (your) leisure.
examples.translation: 你可以把这些文件带回家，有空时再好好看一看。

definitions.definition: in a situation in which you are less likely to succeed than others
definitions.def_translation: 处于劣势，处于不利地位

examples.text: He's at a disadvantage being so shy.
examples.translation: 过于害羞使他处于劣势。

examples.text: This new law places/puts poorer families at a distinct disadvantage.
examples.translation: 这项新法律使比较贫困的家庭处于明显不利的境地。

examples.text: Critics of the proposed system say that it puts students from low-income families at a disadvantage.
Insistence on full-time contracts inevitably places a lot of women at a disadvantage.
We aim to provide assistance to social groups who, historically, have been at a disadvantage in the housing market.

data.word: at a fair, great, etc. lick

definitions.definition: at a fast speed

examples.text: The trains go by at a hell of a lick.
examples.translation: 火车疾驰而过。

examples.text: He ran up the hill at a fair lick.
The economy is growing at a healthy lick now.
The conductor took Puccini's score at a terrific lick.
He shot out of the starting blocks at a tremendous lick.

definitions.definition: fast

examples.text: We set off at a good clip, but we gradually slowed down.
examples.translation: 我们出发时速度很快，可是后来渐渐慢了下来。

examples.text: Government investment in research has been increasing at a fast clip.
The action proceeds at a fast clip, with all the main characters introduced in the first five minutes.
Even the commuter trains move at a good clip.
The cattle headed up the hill at a good clip.

definitions.definition: immediately

examples.text: He could tell at a glance that something was wrong.
examples.translation: 他一眼就看出问题了。

examples.text: The rating system shows prospective buyers at a glance how people feel about the product.
She knew, at a glance, that her mother was upset with her.
I like being able to see at a glance how many steps I've taken so far today.
I could tell at a glance that it wasn't an original.

definitions.definition: in a bad or weak state
definitions.def_translation: 处于低潮；处于衰退状态

examples.text: Consumer confidence is currently at a low ebb.
examples.translation: 目前人们对消费的信心降到了低谷。

examples.text: I was recently divorced and feeling at a very low ebb.
examples.translation: 我刚离了婚，情绪非常低落。

data.word: at a moment's/two hours'/three weeks', etc. notice

definitions.definition: used to emphasize how little time someone has to do something or how little warning is given
definitions.def_translation: （用于强调只有极少时间完成某事）提前一会儿/两个小时/三个星期（等等）通知

examples.text: We can't be expected to just drop everything and leave at a moment's notice.
examples.translation: 不可要求我们能在接到通知后放下所有的事情立即离开。

definitions.definition: Something that you can do at a pinch can be done if it is really necessary , but it will be difficult , not perfect , or not what you would really like

examples.text: I need £2,000 to set up the business, but I suppose £1,500 would do at a pinch.
examples.translation: 我需要2000英镑来创办这个公司，不过实在凑不够，1500英镑也可以。

definitions.definition: If you can do something at a push , you can do it but it will be difficult .

examples.text: At a push I could be there by eight o'clock.
examples.translation: 我勉强能在8点之前赶到。

definitions.definition: If someone does something at a rate of knots , they do it very quickly .

examples.text: She got through her work at a rate of knots.
examples.translation: 她很快做完了工作。

definitions.definition: extremely slowly

examples.text: The roads were full of traffic and we were travelling at a snail's pace for two hours.
examples.translation: 路上全是车，我们如蜗牛爬行般行驶了两个小时。

definitions.definition: (used to make negatives and questions stronger ) in any way or of any type
definitions.def_translation: （用于否定句和疑问句，表示强调）根本，无论如何，丝毫，一点儿

examples.text: He's had no food at all.
examples.translation: 他一点儿东西都没吃。

examples.text: I haven't been at all well recently.
examples.translation: 最近我身体糟透了。

examples.text: I'm afraid I have nothing at all to say.
examples.translation: 抱歉，我没有任何可说的。

examples.text: Is there any uncertainty at all about the way she died?
examples.translation: 对于她的死因，有任何疑点没有？

examples.text: Why bother getting up at all when you don't have a job to go to?
examples.translation: 你没工作，不用去上班，还起床干什么呢？

more_examples.text: There was no food left at all by the time we arrived.
You haven't been listening at all, have you?
She said if she couldn't have a glass of wine at the party, she'd rather not go at all.
No, I don't mind at all - honestly, it doesn't matter.
His argument wasn't at all convincing - in fact it was nonsense.

definitions.definition: If something must be done or avoided at all costs , it must be done or avoided whatever happens .
definitions.def_translation: 不惜任何代价；无论如何

examples.text: Security during the president's visit must be maintained at all costs.
examples.translation: 要不惜一切代价确保总统在访问期间的安全。

examples.text: He wanted her at any cost, even if it meant giving up everything he had.
examples.translation: 他不惜一切代价要得到她，即使这意味着放弃他自己所拥有的一切。

data.word: at all hours (of the day and night)

definitions.definition: repeatedly during the day and the night
definitions.def_translation: 整天不断地;昼夜不停地

examples.text: They keep calling me at all hours (of the day and night).
examples.translation: 他们整天不停地给我打电话。

examples.text: Their poor dog barked at all hours.
They played loud music at all hours of the day and night.
We noticed cars coming at going at all hours.
The house was occupied by students, who came and went at all hours.

definitions.definition: not horizontal or vertical , but sloping in one direction

examples.text: The picture was hanging at an angle.
examples.translation: 画斜挂着。

examples.text: He wore his hat at a jaunty angle.
examples.translation: 他歪戴着帽子。

examples.text: She held her pencil at an angle when she wrote.
Posts were driven at an angle into the ground.
His arm was twisted at an awkward angle.

definitions.definition: If you want something at any price , you are willing to do anything in order to get it.
definitions.def_translation: 不惜任何代价，无论如何

examples.text: He wanted success at any price.
examples.translation: 为了成功他不惜任何代价。

definitions.definition: whatever happens

examples.text: Well, I'm not going home on foot, at any rate.
examples.translation: 哼，无论如何我都不会步行回家。

definitions.definition: something you say to show that you are going to say something more exactly
definitions.def_translation: （表示更确切地说明）不管怎样，至少

examples.text: I don't think they liked my idea. At any rate, they weren't very enthusiastic about it.
examples.translation: 我觉得他们不喜欢我的主意，至少他们不是很热心。

definitions.definition: If an animal is at bay , it is about to be caught or attacked .
even when considered in the most positive way

examples.text: The food was bland at best, and at worst completely inedible.
examples.translation: 这种食品往好了说，是清淡无味，往差了说，则根本不能吃。

examples.text: These treatments will bring only moderate pain relief at best.
Her novels were considered lowbrow at best, positively tacky at worst.
The idea that people will accept these proposals is naive at best.
Investing in these shares will give you a minimal return at best.

definitions.definition: at the highest standard that can be achieved

examples.text: The documentary was an example of investigative journalism at its best.
examples.translation: 这部纪录片是调查性新闻报道的最佳范例。

examples.text: To watch these films is to see animation at its best.
At its best, architecture can transform lives.
To me, his two terms in office represented conservative politics at its best.
His performance of Rachmaninov's third piano concerto was virtuosity at its best.

definitions.definition: in a basic way

examples.text: Jealousy is, at bottom, a lack of self-confidence.
examples.translation: 嫉妒本质上是缺乏自信。

definitions.definition: (from) a short distance away

examples.text: When you see famous people at close quarters, they always appear much smaller than you imagined them.
examples.translation: 近距离看名人时，他们看起来往往比你想象的要平凡得多。

examples.text: He was shot at close range.
examples.translation: 他是被近距离枪杀的。

definitions.definition: If two people are at each other's throats , they are arguing angrily .

examples.text: Those two are always at each other's throats.
examples.translation: 那俩人总是吵个没完。

definitions.definition: If something unpleasant happens at every turn , it happens every time you try to do something.

examples.text: They do their best to frustrate my efforts at every turn.
examples.translation: 他们每次都竭力挫败我的努力。

definitions.definition: when you first see or experience something

examples.text: It looks at first blush like a standard smartphone.
examples.translation: 乍一看，它就像部标准的智能手机。

definitions.definition: when first looking

examples.text: At first glance I thought it was a dog (but I was mistaken).
examples.translation: 乍一看我还以为是一条狗呢（但是我看走眼了）。

examples.text: At first glance, they make an unlikely couple.
That looks like the house I grew up in, at first glance. But it's certainly bigger than mine, and has a different door now that I look more closely.
He appears, at first glance, like any other little boy running around the park.
At first glance, he could pass for a teenager, but then you look a bit closer.

definitions.definition: in or at the beginning

examples.text: At first, I thought he was joking but then I realized he meant it.
examples.translation: 起初我以为他在开玩笑，后来才意识到他是认真的。

definitions.definition: running as fast as possible

examples.text: We ran at full pelt along a rough track.
Suddenly, his horse galloped forward at full pelt.
Tommy chased the man at full pelt and tackled him to the ground.
He was charging at full pelttowards the goal.
The boys were running at full pelt in our direction.

definitions.definition: as fast as possible

examples.text: The plant is operating at full tilt to cope with demand.
examples.translation: 为应付需求，这家工厂全速生产。

definitions.definition: at full / half speed or power
definitions.def_translation: 以全速／半速;尽全力／以一半的力量

examples.text: He's working at full throttle (= as hard as he can) to get the job finished.
examples.translation: 他正全力以赴完成工作。

examples.text: The captain of the boat had his engines at full throttle.
examples.translation: 船长让船开足马力全速行驶。

definitions.definition: near in time or position

examples.text: We want to ensure that help is at hand (= easily available) for all children suffering abuse.
examples.translation: 我们想确保所有遭受虐待的儿童都能随时得到帮助。

definitions.definition: used to say what someone is really like

examples.text: He had dozens of friends, but he was a private person at heart.
examples.translation: 他有几十个朋友，但其实是一个很私密的人。

definitions.definition: used to describe a prison sentence (= time in prison ) that does not have a fixed length

examples.text: She was sentenced to be detained at Her Majesty's pleasure.
examples.translation: 她被判监禁。

examples.text: Children convicted of murder receive a sentence of detention at Her Majesty's pleasure.
He has been detained at Her Majesty's pleasure in the past.
He was sentenced to be detained at Her Majesty's pleasure for the brutal killing of a haridresser.
They face being detained at Her Majesty's pleasure.

definitions.definition: used to mean "in prison "

examples.text: He has had several spells at Her Majesty's pleasure.
examples.translation: 他曾入狱好几次。

examples.text: He's currently languishing at Her Majesty's pleasure.
If she gets caught, she can expect another spell at Her Majesty's pleasure.
He spent a couple of years at Her Majesty's pleasure following a burglary spree.
He's already done time at Her Majesty's pleasure.

definitions.definition: Someone who is put in prison at His/Her Majesty's pleasure is kept there until it is officially decided that it is safe to release them

examples.text: He was declared insane and ordered to be detained in a mental hospital at Her Majesty's pleasure.
examples.translation: 他被指患精神病，被拘禁在一个精神医院。

definitions.definition: repeated after a particular period of time or a particular distance

examples.text: In the event of fire, the alarm will sound at 15-second intervals/at intervals of 15 seconds.
examples.translation: 发生火灾时，警报每隔15秒就会响一次。

examples.text: Old family photos are featured at intervals throughout the book.
The lights flash at intervals of exactly 5.3 seconds.
Markers were placed at intervals along the route.
Gas firms have produced plans to drill at intervals of 10 acres.

definitions.definition: most important in what is being discussed
definitions.def_translation: （所讨论问题中）最重要的，关键的

examples.text: The point at issue is what is best for the child.
examples.translation: 问题的关键在于什么样的东西对孩子最好。

examples.text: At issue is whether whistleblowers are sufficiently protected by law.
She insisted that that comments at issue had been taken out of context.
These schools didn't meet official standards and therefore weren't eligible to receive the money at issue.
What's not at issue is her close family ties to the minister.

definitions.definition: generally

examples.text: This group is not representative of the population at large.
examples.translation: 这个团体不是全体人民的代表。

definitions.definition: as much as, or more than, a number or amount

examples.text: It will cost at least $100.
examples.translation: 那个东西至少要花100美元。

examples.text: It will be £200 at the very least.
examples.translation: 那东西最少也要200镑。

examples.text: You'll have to wait at least an hour.
examples.translation: 你至少要等一个小时。

definitions.definition: used to reduce the effect of a statement

examples.text: I've met the president - at least, he shook my hand once.
examples.translation: 我见到总统了——不管怎样他和我握了一下手。

definitions.definition: used to emphasize that something is good in a bad situation

examples.text: It's a small house but at least there's a garden.
examples.translation: 那是一座小房子，但不管怎么说还有一个花园呢。

definitions.definition: used to say that someone should do something small , even if they do nothing else

examples.text: Even if she didn't want to send a present, she could at least have sent a card.
examples.translation: 即使不想送礼物，她起码也应该寄一张贺卡。

definitions.definition: for a long time

examples.text: George went on at great length about his various illnesses.
examples.translation: 乔治滔滔不绝地讲起他身患的各种疾病。

examples.text: He talked at length about his visits to various Roman sites.
The article deals at length with how to evaluate different sources of information.
She'll call her interior designer to discuss at length which lampshade to buy.
I'm a huge jazz fan and can go on about it at some length, given the chance.

definitions.definition: If something happens at length , it happens after a long period of time .

examples.text: At length, the authorities allowed her to go home.
examples.translation: 当局终于允许她回家了。

examples.text: At length, the suspect replied.
At length, all the obstacles were overcome and we were able to set off.
He waited anxiously until at length he spotted her entering the room.
At length, the two sides reached an agreement.

definitions.definition: relating to a particular area of the country /the whole of the country

examples.text: These sorts of policies are made at local level.
examples.translation: 这些政策由当地部门制定。

examples.text: There's a lot of good work being done at local level to help vulnerable people.
At local level, health authorities can use their budgets with a degree of discretion.
The party still doesn't have much support at national level.
We need to review our road and rail networks at national level.

definitions.definition: happy because you feel that you belong in the world and generally agree with what happens
definitions.def_translation: 与世界融为一体;与世界和谐相处

definitions.definition: separated from something such as an event by an amount of time , by your feelings , or by other events

examples.text: Charlotte felt she was at one remove from reality.
examples.translation: 夏洛特觉得她与现实隔了一步。

examples.text: At this remove it is difficult to estimate what the total value of the estate was.
examples.translation: 隔了这么久，很难估计这些地产的总价值。

examples.text: This kind of artistic representation is at many removes from the subject.
examples.translation: 这样的艺术再现与主题相差甚远。

definitions.definition: a gentle way of saying that someone is dead

examples.text: Now she is at peace and her suffering is over.
examples.translation: 现在她安息了，痛苦也结束了。

definitions.definition: now

examples.text: "Are you busy?" "Not at present."
examples.translation: “你忙吗？”“这会儿不忙。”

examples.text: At present she's working abroad.
examples.translation: 她目前在国外工作。

examples.text: There is no fighting in the area at present.
At present, the organization has around 5,000 members.
Unfortunately, we cannot see a solution to this problem at present.
There is no access to clean water at present.

definitions.definition: by chance , or without being chosen intentionally

examples.text: The winning entry will be the first correct answer drawn at random.
examples.translation: 从所有给出正确答案的参赛者中，随意抽出的第一个将获得大奖。

examples.text: Participants were selected at random.
Ten more horses from the races were chosen at random for testing.
The first five correct answers picked at random will be the winners.
Vehicles were pulled over seemingly at random.
The answers seemed to be plucked at random.

definitions.definition: confused

examples.text: I'm all/completely at sea with the new computer system.
examples.translation: 新的计算机系统完全把我搞糊涂了。

definitions.definition: only a short time before something happens
definitions.def_translation: 在短时间内;一经通知立即

examples.text: I can't cancel my plans at such short notice.
examples.translation: 我无法在这么短的时间内取消我的安排。

definitions.definition: the sign @, used for example in email and social media addresses
definitions.def_translation: 艾特（用于电子邮件和社交媒体网址）

examples.text: The host name is contained in the part of an internet email address that comes after the at sign (@).
examples.translation: 主机名包含在互联网电子邮件地址中艾特符号 (@) 之后的部分中。

examples.text: The at symbol is normally read aloud as "at".
examples.translation: “@”符号通常读作“艾特”。

examples.text: In Swedish, the letter à is used to refer to unit cost, equivalent to the at sign (@) in English.
examples.translation: 在瑞典语中，字母à用于表示单位成本，相当于英语中的艾特符号 (@)。

more_examples.text: "What the heck do you call that @ thingy in the middle?" "We mostly call it the at sign."
Your Twitter username, also known as your handle, begins with the at sign.

definitions.definition: in a confused , badly organized , or difficult situation

examples.text: We've been at sixes and sevens in the office this week.
examples.translation: 我们办公室这一周忙得不可开交。

definitions.definition: always willing and able to do whatever someone asks

examples.text: Go and get it yourself! I'm not at your beck and call, you know.
examples.translation: 自己去拿！我才不听你使唤呢。

definitions.definition: You do something at someone's bidding if they have asked or told you to do it.

examples.text: At my grandmother's bidding, I wore my best dress.
examples.translation: 按照祖母的要求，我穿上了最漂亮的衣服。

definitions.definition: available to be used by someone

examples.text: I would take you if I could, but I don't have a car at my disposal this week.
examples.translation: 我会尽可能带上你，但是这周我没汽车可用。

examples.text: Having sold the house she had a large sum of money at her disposal (= to spend as she wanted).
examples.translation: 卖掉房子后，她手头有一大笔钱可用。

examples.text: The government will use every tool at its disposal to provide relief for the affected area.
We're currently using all the resources at our disposal to deal with the crisis.

definitions.definition: close to and a little behind someone
definitions.def_translation: 在…近旁;紧随…之后;紧紧伴随…

examples.text: During the visit, the interpreter was always at her elbow.
examples.translation: 在她参观的过程中，翻译始终紧随其后。

definitions.definition: If something that is valuable is at stake , it is in a situation where it might be lost .

examples.text: Thousands of lives will be at stake if emergency aid does not arrive in the city soon.
examples.translation: 如果紧急救援物资不能很快运到城中，数千人的生命就会有危险。

definitions.definition: in addition to that

examples.text: It's too expensive, and probably out-of-date at that.
examples.translation: 它太贵了，而且可能已过时了。

definitions.definition: when everything is going well

examples.translation: 我们的车即使在最佳状态下也开不快。

definitions.definition: doing the work involved in a job , in real working conditions , rather than planning or talking about it
definitions.def_translation: 在实际工作岗位;在工作现场;在工作第一线

examples.text: At the coalface with a deadline looming, you sometimes feel under a lot of pressure.
examples.translation: 在工作第一线切身面对最后期限的逼近，你有时会感觉压力很大。

definitions.definition: very early in the morning , especially at the time when the sun first appears

examples.text: We'll have to leave at the crack of dawn.
examples.translation: 我们天一亮就得动身。

data.word: at the drop of a hat

definitions.definition: If you do something at the drop of a hat , you do it immediately without stopping to think about it.
definitions.def_translation: 不加思索地，毫不犹豫地

examples.translation: 现在人们动不动就打官司。

definitions.definition: used after a date or time to show that something will not happen before then

examples.text: I'm very busy, so I won't be with you till four o'clock at the earliest.
examples.translation: 我太忙了，最早也得到4点才能见你。

examples.text: His sentencing won't happen until May 16th at the earliest, based on all the filings.

The technology won't be commercially available till 2030 at the earliest.

data.word: at the end of the day

definitions.definition: something that you say before you give the most important fact of a situation
definitions.def_translation: 最终;到头来;不管怎么说

examples.translation: 当然她要说什么我也会听，但最终还是我来作决定。

definitions.def_translation: 以…为代价，在…受损的情况下

examples.translation: 他没有必要为了保护他们的名誉而牺牲自己的。

examples.translation: 有多少人死在恐怖组织手中？

examples.translation: 由史蒂夫‧刘易斯负责，我们肯定会成功。

definitions.definition: now

examples.translation: 对不起，她现在不在这儿。

data.word: at the push of a button

definitions.definition: very easily

examples.translation: 你不能指望轻松地得到自己需要的一切。

examples.translation: 他准备好了铅笔，站在电话旁。

data.word: at the risk of doing something

examples.translation: 恕我失礼，恐怕我现在必须得走了。

examples.translation: 问一个傻问题，我怎么发电子邮件呢？

examples.translation: 没人喜欢冲突，但尽管如此，我们不得不处理这个问题。

examples.translation: 政治家们知道，他们无法轻而易举地创建一个法制社会。

examples.translation: 照这样下去，我们得半夜才能到家。

examples.translation: 他想哭就能哭出来。

definitions.def_translation: 娴熟，得心应手，运用自如

examples.translation: 作为一名作家，她对文体和幽默都能运用自如。

examples.translation: 货物随要随到。

examples.translation: 请将填好的表格尽快交回。

examples.translation: 他手边有所有最新的数据。

examples.translation: 所有离海岸不足100米的房子都有被洪水袭击的危险。
