examples.translation: 很高兴认识另一个亚特兰大人！

examples.text: The restaurant was popular among young Atlantans.
examples.translation: 这家餐厅在年轻的亚特兰大人中很受欢迎。

more_examples.text: Every metro Atlantan uses about 70 gallons of water per day.
Sheis a fourth generation Atlantan.
The young Atlantan joined a law firm in the city in 1972.
He was introduced to the Southeast's largest city by his boyfriend, a native Atlantan.
The soft-spoken Atlantan is one of the nation's best intellectual property attorneys.

definitions.definition: belonging to or relating to the Atlantic Ocean
the ocean that is to the west of Europe and Africa and to the east of North and South America
a book containing maps

examples.text: a road atlas
examples.translation: 道路交通图册

examples.text: an atlas of the world
examples.translation: 世界地图册

definitions.definition: a book containing maps showing where particular things are made, found , etc.

examples.text: a wine atlas
examples.translation: 葡萄酒分布图册

examples.text: an atlas of British plants
examples.translation: 英国植物分布图册

more_examples.text: For those of you who don't have an atlas to hand, Newcastle is a city in the northeaeast of England.
Are you through with that atlas?

definitions.definition: the first vertebra (= bone ) of the spine , that supports the skull

examples.text: atlas bone neck pain
examples.translation: 寰椎疼痛

definitions.definition: abbreviation for at the moment : used for example on social media and in text messages
definitions.def_translation: 现在（at the moment的缩写，多用于社交媒体或手机短信等）

examples.text: I'm busy atm.
examples.translation: 我现在忙。

definitions.definition: abbreviation for automated teller machine : a machine , usually in a wall outside a bank , shop , etc. from which you can take money out of your bank account using a special card
definitions.def_translation: 自动柜员机;自动取款机（automated teller machine的缩写）

examples.text: Is there an ATM near here? I need to get some money out.
examples.translation: 这条街上有自动取款机吗？我需要取些钱。

definitions.definition: a special plastic card given to you by a bank that allows you to take money out of your bank account using a cash machine
definitions.def_translation: （用于自动提款机的）自动提款卡

definitions.definition: the mixture of gases around the earth
definitions.def_translation: （包围地球的）大气，大气层，大气圈

examples.text: These factories are releasing toxic gases into the atmosphere.
examples.translation: 这些工厂向大气中排放有毒气体。

definitions.definition: a mixture of gases that surrounds any planet

examples.text: the search for planets with a breathable atmosphere
examples.translation: 寻找有可呼吸气体的星球

definitions.definition: the air that you breathe in a place

examples.text: The atmosphere in the room was so stuffy I could hardly breathe.
examples.translation: 房间里空气污浊，我都快喘不过气来了。

examples.text: A few plants in an office will improve the atmosphere.
examples.translation: 在办公室里摆些植物可以改善空气。

definitions.definition: the character , feeling , or mood of a place or situation

examples.text: There's a very relaxed atmosphere in our office.
examples.translation: 我们办公室的气氛非常轻松。

examples.text: There has been an atmosphere of gloom in the factory since it was announced that it would be closing.
examples.translation: 自从宣布工厂要关闭的消息后，厂子就笼罩在一片沮丧的气氛中。

definitions.definition: a feeling that a place has of being pleasant and interesting or exciting

examples.text: You want a restaurant that serves good food but has a little atmosphere too.
examples.translation: 谁都想去家饭菜可口又有点情调的饭店吃饭。

examples.text: He put on some soft music and turned the lights down in order to give the room a little more atmosphere.
examples.translation: 为了使房间更富情调，他放起了轻柔的音乐，调暗了灯光。

more_examples.text: This is a more conducive atmosphere for studying.
The mansion had an atmosphere of genteel elegance and decay.
He tried to lighten the atmosphere by telling a joke.
The classroom presented a cheerful busy atmosphere to the visitors.
There's a real carnival atmosphere in the streets.

definitions.definition: relating to the air or to the atmosphere

examples.text: Plants are the main source of atmospheric oxygen.
examples.translation: 大气中的氧气主要是植物产生的。

examples.text: If atmospheric conditions are right, it may be possible to see this group of stars tonight.
examples.translation: 如果大气条件好，今晚或许能看到这一组星星。

definitions.definition: creating a special feeling , especially a mysterious or romantic feeling
definitions.def_translation: 制造独特氛围的；有神秘美感的；富有情调的

examples.text: atmospheric lighting/music
examples.translation: 富有情调的灯光／音乐

examples.text: I quite like fog because it's atmospheric.
examples.translation: 我喜欢雾，因为它能营造独特氛围。

definitions.definition: the force with which the atmosphere presses down on the surface of the earth
unusual conditions in the atmosphere , such as those caused by lightning , or the continuous short , sharp noises produced by a radio during these conditions
a ring-shaped island formed of coral (= rock-like natural substance ) that surrounds a lagoon (= area of sea water )

examples.text: the Bikini Atoll
examples.translation: 比基尼岛环礁

definitions.definition: the smallest unit of any chemical element , consisting of a positive nucleus surrounded by negative electrons . Atoms can combine to form a molecule

examples.text: A molecule of carbon dioxide (CO2) has one carbon atom and two oxygen atoms.
examples.translation: 二氧化碳（CO2）分子是由一个碳原子和两个氧原子构成的。

examples.text: He hasn't an atom of sense (= he has no sense), that boy.
examples.translation: 那个孩子啊，一点头脑也没有。

more_examples.text: The nucleus of a deuterium atom contains a proton and a neutron.
Scientists are working to harness the power of the atom.

definitions.definition: an extremely powerful bomb that uses the explosive power resulting from splitting the atom
relating to atoms

examples.text: atomic structure/nuclei
examples.translation: 原子结构／核

more_examples.text: At the nuclear reprocessing plant they extract plutonium from spent atomic fuel rods.
Electrons and protons are atomic particles.
Many servicemen suffered radiation sickness after the early atomic tests.
He read about the atomic bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
They researched cancer-mortality rates for survivors of atomic blasts.

definitions.definition: using the energy that is created when an atom is divided
definitions.def_translation: 原子能的；利用原子能的

examples.text: atomic energy/power
examples.translation: 原子能

more_examples.text: At the nuclear reprocessing plant they extract plutonium from spent atomic fuel rods.
Electrons and protons are atomic particles.
Many servicemen suffered radiation sickness after the early atomic tests.
He read about the atomic bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
They researched cancer-mortality rates for survivors of atomic blasts.

definitions.definition: a device that measures time extremely accurately using the vibrations (= fast , regular small movements ) of atoms

examples.text: The atomic clock is so precise it shouldn't lose or gain a second in 20 to 30 billion years.
examples.translation: 原子钟非常精确，在200到300亿年内不会丢失或增加一秒。

examples.text: His discovery of the magnetic properties of atoms gave rise to superaccurate atomic clocks.
examples.translation: 他对原子磁性的发现催生了超精确原子钟的发明。

more_examples.text: The most accurate type of timekeeping device is currently the atomic clock.
In 1967, when the first atomic clock was installed, nobody had in mind to launch a whole bunch of global positioning satellites that have atomic clocks.
As high-end time-keeping technologies, including atomic clocks, become cheaper, their application in sports and many other areas will grow.
Boulder, Colorado is home of the atomic clock, the country's official time source.

definitions.definition: the mass of a specific isotope of a particular chemical element , usually expressed in atomic mass units
definitions.def_translation: 原子质量（某化学元素同位素的质量，通常以原子质量单位的形式表达）

definitions.definition: a unit used for measuring atomic mass , equal to one twelfth of the mass of an atom of carbon in its commonest form , carbon-12
definitions.def_translation: 原子质量单位（等于碳－12原子质量的十二分之一）

definitions.definition: the number of protons found in the nucleus of an atom of a particular chemical , used as a way of listing the chemical elements in order in the periodic table
definitions.def_translation: 原子数（某种化学物质的原子核中质子的数量，用于化学元素周期表中的排序）

definitions.definition: another term for relative atomic mass specialized
in a way that involves or relates to atoms

examples.text: Prehistoric materials are dated by measuring the atomically unstable isotope carbon 14.
examples.translation: 史前物质的年代是通过测量原子上不稳定的同位素碳14来确定的。

examples.text: Elements grouped in the same area of the periodic table are related atomically and chemically.
examples.translation: 分布在元素周期表同一区域的元素在原子上和化学上是相互关联的。

more_examples.text: Viruses and proteins have an atomically precise structure.
Advances in nanotechnology lead to the need for atomically thin circuitry.
New synthetic diamonds are atomically identical to diamonds from a mine.

definitions.definition: the number of atoms in one molecule of an element
in an electronic transaction (= an operation that changes data ) , the fact of occurring either completely or not at all
definitions.def_translation: 原子性（一个原子事务要么完整执行，要么不执行）

examples.text: database updates that require atomicity
examples.translation: 要求原子性的数据库更新

definitions.definition: existing or operating separately from other similar things or people
definitions.def_translation: （人或事物与同类完全分离的）原子式的，分开的，分裂的

examples.text: Without human society we remain atomistic individuals, isolated and alone.
examples.translation: 如若没有人类社会，我们每个人将会是原子式的存在，彼此隔绝且孤独无援。

examples.text: Instead of holistic concepts of healing, modern medicine took an atomistic approach that reduced patients to no more than their dysfunctioning parts.

definitions.definition: to change a liquid , or to be changed , into very small drops
definitions.def_translation: （使）变成微小水滴；（使）（液体）雾化

examples.text: Traditional snow guns use compressed air to atomize the water into droplets.
examples.translation: 传统造雪机利用压缩空气将液体雾化形成微小水滴。

examples.text: The substance atomizes, like mist from a perfume bottle.
examples.translation: 这种物质发生雾化，就像是香水瓶的喷雾。

definitions.definition: to divide something or to be divided into small separate parts
definitions.def_translation: （使）分开成为单独的小部分；（使）粉碎化

examples.text: His lawyers will try to pick the case apart, to atomize it and reduce it to merely a series of small technicalities.
examples.translation: 他的律师试图将这个案子拆分开来，将其细化弱化成为一系列技术方面的小问题。

examples.text: If this trend continues, there is a risk that the whole sector will atomize.
examples.translation: 如果这种趋势继续下去，整个行业将会面临粉碎化的危险。

definitions.definition: consisting of separate parts that do not have much contact with each other
definitions.def_translation: 分裂的，孤立的，（互不关联而呈）原子化的

examples.text: In our increasingly atomized society, more and more people live alone.
examples.translation: 在我们这个日渐原子化的社会里，越来越多的人独自居住。

definitions.definition: (of a liquid ) in the form of very small drops

examples.text: The canisters were found to contain atomized sarin, a deadly poison.
examples.translation: 霰弹筒里发现了雾化沙林，一种致命的毒气。

definitions.definition: a device that changes a liquid into small drops by forcing it out through a very small hole

examples.text: This perfume is available in both a normal bottle and an atomizer.
examples.translation: 这种香水有普通瓶装的，也有喷雾瓶装的。

definitions.definition: Atonal music is written in a way that is not based on any particular key .
to do something that shows that you are sorry for something bad that you did

examples.text: The country's leader has expressed a wish to atone for his actions in the past.
examples.translation: 该国领导人表示愿意为其以前的行为向世人谢罪。

definitions.definition: something that you do to show that you are sorry for something bad that you did

examples.text: He said that young hooligans should do community service as atonement for their crimes.
examples.translation: 他说，小流氓应该通过参加社区服务的方式赎过。

definitions.definition: on or at the top of

examples.text: She sat atop a two-metre wall.
examples.translation: 她坐在一堵两米高的墙上。

definitions.definition: caused by an allergy that can affect any part of the body , not just the part that touches the thing that causes the allergy
definitions.def_translation: （过敏引起的）异位的，异位性的

examples.text: Eczema is also known as atopic dermatitis.
examples.translation: 湿疹又被称作异位性皮炎。

examples.text: An increase in house mites can trigger atopic asthma.
examples.translation: 室内螨虫数量的增长可能引起异位性哮喘。

more_examples.text: There has been an alarming rise in atopic eczema.
Her family had a history of atopic disease and was prone to asthma.
A child with one parent who has an atopic condition has a one-in-four chance of having some form of atopic disease.

definitions.definition: abbreviation for adenosine triphosphate: an important chemical in the cells of living organisms that stores energy and releases it when it is needed
definitions.def_translation: 三磷酸腺苷（细胞内储存和传递能量的化学物质，adenosine triphosphate的缩写）

definitions.definition: relating to or happening in an atrium of the heart

examples.text: Premature beats that occur in the atria are called premature atrial contractions.
examples.translation: 出现在前房的期外搏动被称为早发性心房收缩。

definitions.definition: a problem in which the heart beats faster than normal and in a way that is not regular , resulting in the atria (= the top spaces ) of the heart not emptying properly

examples.text: Patients with atrial fibrillation may be fitted with pacemakers.
examples.translation: 罹患心房颤动的病人可能适合置入起搏器。

definitions.definition: a problem in which the heart beats very fast and often in a way that is not regular , so that it does not send out blood effectively . Atrial flutter is often found with other types of heart disease and frequently develops into atrial fibrillation.

examples.text: Her ECG showed atrial flutter.
examples.translation: 电图显示出她有心房扑动的症状。

definitions.definition: a problem , present from birth , in which blood from the left atrium (= one of the top spaces ) of the heart passes directly into the right atrium resulting in too much fluid in the right side of the heart and possible heart failure
definitions.def_translation: 房间隔缺损，心房间隔缺损

definitions.definition: relating to the connection between the atrium (= upper space ) and ventricle (= lower space ) of the heart
relating to the heart's AV node (= area of the heart that transmits electrical impulses )
an unusually fast heart rate caused by an extra electrical connection that forms through the AV node (= area of the heart that transmits electrical impulses )
definitions.def_translation: 房室结折返性心动过速

definitions.definition: a very large room , often with glass walls or roof , especially in the middle of a large shop or office building
definitions.def_translation: （尤指大商店或办公楼的）中庭，天井

definitions.definition: one of the two spaces at the top part of the heart that receive blood from the veins and push it down into the ventricles (= lower spaces )
of very bad quality

examples.text: an atrocious film/piece of acting
examples.translation: 糟糕透顶的电影／表演

examples.text: The weather has been atrocious all week.
examples.translation: 整整一星期天气都很糟糕。

examples.text: Conditions in the prison were atrocious.
examples.translation: 监狱中条件极其恶劣。

definitions.definition: violent and shocking

examples.text: an atrocious crime
examples.translation: 残暴的罪行

definitions.definition: in a way that is very bad or unpleasant

examples.text: The children have been behaving absolutely atrociously.
examples.translation: 孩子们的行为非常恶劣。

examples.text: The pastry was atrociously soggy.
examples.translation: 面团湿漉漉的，非常糟糕。

more_examples.text: He writes atrociously.
It's atrociously cold outside.
He was performing the atrociously difficult Second Piano Concerto.

definitions.definition: in a very cruel , violent , and shocking way

examples.text: Troops are accused of behaving atrociously.
examples.translation: 军队被指控犯下了暴行。

more_examples.text: Activists say horses shipped across the border are treated "atrociously" before they are killed.
Reservist soldiers had behaved atrociously towards civilians.

definitions.definition: an extremely cruel , violent , or shocking act
definitions.def_translation: 凶恶的行为，残暴的行为

examples.text: They are on trial for committing atrocities against the civilian population.
examples.translation: 他们因残害平民的暴行而受到审判。

definitions.definition: the fact of something being extremely cruel , violent , or shocking

examples.text: These people are guilty of acts of appalling atrocity (= cruelty).
examples.translation: 这些人犯下了令人发指的残忍罪行。

definitions.definition: (of tissue or an organ in the body ) having atrophied (= become smaller or thinner and weaker )

examples.text: These changes were more noticeable in the atrophic right kidney than in the left kidney.
examples.translation: 这些变化在萎缩的右肾中比在左肾中更为明显。

examples.text: The mucosa of the stomach was atrophic.
examples.translation: 胃黏膜萎缩。

more_examples.text: The other glands will tend to be atrophic when one gland is hyperactive.
Examination under anaesthesia revealed significant benign stenosis of the atrophic cervix.
Atrophic vaginitis is typically caused by a decrease in oestrogen levels after menopause.
The most common form of macular degeneration is the atrophic form.

definitions.definition: (of a disease or condition ) relating to tissue or an organ in the body that becomes smaller or thinner and weaker

examples.text: High salt intake can induce atrophic gastritis, a chronic inflammation and thinning of the stomach lining.
examples.translation: 高盐摄入会诱发萎缩性胃炎，这是一种慢性炎症，会使胃黏膜变薄。

examples.text: Atrophic rhinitis is nasal dryness that occurs when tissue inside of your nose thins or atrophies.

more_examples.text: The other glands will tend to be atrophic when one gland is hyperactive.
Examination under anaesthesia revealed significant benign stenosis of the atrophic cervix.
Atrophic vaginitis is typically caused by a decrease in oestrogen levels after menopause.
The most common form of macular degeneration is the atrophic form.

definitions.definition: (of a part of the body ) to be reduced in size and therefore strength , or, more generally , to become weaker

examples.text: After several months in a hospital bed, my leg muscles had atrophied.
examples.translation: 我在医院病床上呆了几个月后，腿部肌肉已经萎缩了。

examples.text: In the 1980s, their political power gradually atrophied (= became weaker).
examples.translation: 20世纪80年代他们的政治权力逐渐衰落。

definitions.definition: a drug used to relax muscles , made from a poisonous substance taken from the deadly nightshade plant

examples.text: Atropine can be used to increase the heart rate.
examples.translation: 阿托品可以用来加快心率。

more_examples.text: Today, doctors use the drug atropine, a purified extract of the plant Atropa belladonna, to dilate pupils before eye examinations.
Nerve gas victims get atropine, a drug often used to treat heart attacks.
You'll need to visit a vet, who will treat the dog with atropine, an antidote for the toxin.
Many modern drugs, such as atropine, digitalis and reserpine, have been derived from folk remedies.

definitions.definition: to fasten , join , or connect something
definitions.def_translation: 系，绑；连接；使附着；附上；固定

examples.text: I attached a photo to my application form.
examples.translation: 我在我的申请表上贴了一张照片。

examples.text: Use this cable to attach the printer to the computer.
examples.translation: 用这根数据线连接打印机和电脑。

examples.text: In the UK , packets of cigarettes come with a government health warning attached to them (= on them).
examples.translation: 在英国，香烟的包装盒上都印有政府的健康警示。

examples.text: I attach (= am sending, usually with a letter) a copy of our latest report.
examples.translation: 兹附上我们的最新报告一份。

more_examples.text: Make sure the rope is firmly attached before attempting to climb down it.
The babies in this unit have various devices attached to them which monitor the vital signs.
Did you remember to attach a label to the present?
I bought some special glue you can use for attaching sequins to fabric.
Attach the long nozzle to the vacuum cleaner if you want to clean in awkward places.

definitions.definition: to join a file such as a document , picture , or computer program , to an email
definitions.def_translation: 把…作为电子邮件的附件

more_examples.text: The email had a very long file attached which took ages to download.
I will email you when I've finished, attaching the edited files.
When you get an email, there'll be a paperclip symbol next to it if there is something attached to it.
There may be a virus in the file that is attached, so don't open it.
It's easy to attach documents - you just click on the 'insert' button here.

definitions.definition: to officially take someone's money or the things that they own, or to arrest someone, usually because that person has failed to pay money that is owed
definitions.def_translation: （通常因为债务人不能偿付债务而）扣押（债务人或其财产）

definitions.definition: To attach a particular quality to something is to consider it to have that quality .
definitions.def_translation: 认为…有（重要性、价值、意义等）

examples.text: I don't attach any importance/significance to these rumours.
examples.translation: 我不把这些谣传当回事儿。

examples.text: She attaches great value to being financially independent.
examples.translation: 她特别看重经济独立。

definitions.definition: If you say that a particular quality attaches to someone or something, you mean that they have that quality .

examples.text: Don't worry - it was an accident and no blame attaches to either of you.
examples.translation: 别担心——这纯属意外，谁也不会怪罪你们俩。

examples.text: Great honour attaches to winning this award.
examples.translation: 获得该奖是莫大的荣誉。

definitions.definition: If you attach yourself to a person or group , you join him, her, or it, usually for a limited period of time .
definitions.def_translation: （通常在有限的时间段内）与…在一起；成为…的成员；参加

examples.text: Being on his own, he attached himself to a noisy group at the bar.
examples.translation: 因为就一个人，他跟酒吧里一群闹哄哄的人搭上了话。

definitions.definition: a person who works in an embassy and has a particular area of responsibility in which they have special knowledge

examples.text: a naval/military/press/cultural attaché
examples.translation: 海军武官／陆军武官／新闻专员／文化专员

definitions.definition: a rectangular case with hard sides , used especially for carrying business documents
to like someone or something very much

examples.text: The children are very attached to their grandparents.
examples.translation: 孩子们非常依恋他们的祖父母。

examples.text: I'm very attached to my old guitar.
examples.translation: 我很喜欢我的旧吉他。

definitions.definition: an extra piece of equipment that can be added to a machine

examples.text: This food processor has a special attachment for grinding coffee.
examples.translation: 这个食品加工器附有一个专门用来研磨咖啡的装置。

more_examples.text: Many British homes have a shower attachment fixed to the bath taps.
This little attachment allows you take photographs using your mobile phone.
The hairdryer comes with a special attachment which enables you to dry your hair gently.
This attachment makes it easier to vacuum stairs.
You can buy an attachment that turns your drill into a screwdriver.

definitions.definition: a computer file that is sent together with an email message

examples.text: I'll email my report to you as an attachment.
examples.translation: 我将把我的报告作为附件发给你。

examples.text: I wasn't able to open that attachment.
examples.translation: 我打不开那个附件。

more_examples.text: The paperclip symbol next to the email's subject line shows that there is an attachment.
If it's possible that the attachment might be infected, don't open it, just delete it.
I'll send you the full document as an attachment.
Her email has several attachments that you should look at.
Clicking on this button allows you to make attachments to your email.

definitions.definition: a feeling of love or strong connection to someone or something

examples.text: At university I formed a strong attachment to one of my tutors.
examples.translation: 上大学时，我和一位导师建立了很深厚的感情。

examples.text: She is unlikely to give up her lifelong attachment to feminist ideas.
examples.translation: 她不大可能放弃她终生信仰的女权主义思想。

definitions.definition: a feeling of love and need for another person , for example for a mother by her child

examples.text: Secure attachment is believed to be important for healthy development.
examples.translation: 安全感据信是改善健康的重要因素。

examples.text: Infants can form attachments to any caregiver.
examples.translation: 幼儿可能对照看他们的任何人产生依恋。

definitions.definition: the act of arresting a person for failing to obey the order of a court , or of officially taking their property because they have failed to pay money that they owe

problems with behaviour and relationships that result from a person not having formed good attachments (= strong feelings of love or connection ) with parents or other people who cared for them as a small child
a way of caring for children that gives a lot of importance to parents and their baby or small child being physically and emotionally close

examples.text: In attachment parenting, parents are advised to carry their baby on the body as much as possible.
examples.translation: 根据亲密育儿法，父母应该尽可能多地把宝宝抱在怀里。

definitions.definition: to try to hurt or defeat using violence

examples.text: He was attacked and seriously injured by a gang of youths.
examples.translation: 他被一帮年轻人打成重伤。

examples.text: Army forces have been attacking the town since dawn.
examples.translation: 从拂晓开始，军队就对这个城市展开了进攻。

examples.text: Most wild animals won't attack unless they are provoked.
examples.translation: 大多数野生动物若非被激怒，是不会主动攻击的。

more_examples.text: Her voice shook as she spoke about the person who attacked her.
He attacked the man with a broken bottle.
She used to love cats but one attacked her and she doesn't like them anymore.
The army has been criticized for attacking the unarmed civilian population.
Earlier today a man was arrested for attacking a motorist in a road rage incident.

definitions.definition: to criticize someone strongly

examples.text: She wrote an article attacking the judges and their conduct of the trial.
examples.translation: 她写了一篇文章抨击法官以及他们的审案方式。

examples.text: The report attacks the idea of exams for seven and eight-year-olds.
examples.translation: 这篇报道抨击了对七八岁的孩子进行考试的计划。

definitions.definition: If something, such as a disease or a chemical , attacks something, it damages it.
definitions.def_translation: （疾病、化学品等）侵袭；侵害；侵蚀

examples.text: AIDS attacks the body's immune system.
examples.translation: 艾滋病破坏人体的免疫系统。

examples.text: My rose bushes are being attacked by aphids.
examples.translation: 我的蔷薇花丛正在遭受蚜虫的侵害。

definitions.definition: If players in a team attack, they move forward to try to score points , goals , etc.
to deal with something quickly and in an effective way
definitions.def_translation: 迅速处理；高效解决；全力应付

examples.text: We have to attack these problems now and find some solutions.
examples.translation: 我们必须现在就处理这些问题并拿出解决方案。

examples.text: The children rushed in and eagerly attacked the food (= quickly started to eat it).
examples.translation: 孩子们冲进屋里狼吞虎咽地大吃起来。

definitions.definition: a violent act intended to hurt or damage someone or something

examples.text: a racist attack
examples.translation: 种族主义袭击

examples.text: Enemy forces have made an attack on the city.
examples.translation: 敌军已经对这座城市发起了进攻。

examples.text: These bomb blasts suggest that the terrorists are (going) on the attack (= trying to defeat or hurt other people) again.
examples.translation: 这些爆炸事件表明，恐怖主义分子又发起了进攻。

examples.text: The town was once again under attack (= being attacked).
examples.translation: 这座城市再次遭受攻击。

more_examples.text: The terrorist attack on the UN building has shocked the civilized world.
The submarine dived just in time to avoid the enemy attack.
The police have to arm themselves against attack.
An 80-year-old woman was badly hurt in what the police describe as an apparently motiveless attack .
The rebel headquarters took a direct hit from a bomb during the attack.

definitions.definition: a strong criticism of someone or something

examples.text: a scathing attack on the president
examples.translation: 对总统的严厉抨击

examples.text: The government has come under attack from all sides for cutting education spending.
examples.translation: 政府因为削减教育开支而受到各方面的强烈批评。

definitions.definition: a sudden and short period of illness

examples.text: an attack of asthma/flu/malaria
examples.translation: 哮喘／流感／疟疾的突然发作

examples.text: an attack of the giggles
examples.translation: 突然一阵咯咯傻笑

definitions.definition: the part of a team in some sports that tries to score points

examples.text: The team has a strong attack, but its defence is weak.
examples.translation: 这支球队攻击力强大，但防守很薄弱。

examples.text: The team is strong inattack but useless in defence.
examples.translation: 这支球队攻势凶猛，但防守不堪一击。

definitions.definition: determination in the way you play a sport , trying hard to score points

examples.text: The team needs to put some more attack into its game.
examples.translation: 这支球队在比赛中需要加强攻势。

definitions.definition: a person who uses violence to hurt someone

examples.text: The police think she must have known her attacker.
examples.translation: 警方认为她肯定认识袭击她的人。

definitions.definition: to reach or succeed in getting something

examples.text: He has attained the highest grade in his music exams.
examples.translation: 他在音乐考试中得了最高分。

examples.text: We need to identify the best ways of attaining our objectives/goals.
examples.translation: 我们需要确定达到目标的最佳办法。

examples.text: India attained independence in 1947, after decades of struggle.
examples.translation: 经过几十年的斗争，印度于1947年获得独立。

definitions.definition: possible to achieve
definitions.def_translation: 可以达到的;可以获得的

examples.text: We must ensure that we do not set ourselves goals that are not attainable.
examples.translation: 我们切不可给自己定下一些无法实现的目标。

definitions.definition: the act of achieving something

examples.text: the attainment of a goal
examples.translation: 目标的实现

examples.text: attainment targets
examples.translation: 要实现的目标

definitions.definition: Someone's attainments are the things they have done and the skills they have learned .
to try to do something, especially something difficult
definitions.def_translation: （尤指为完成难事而进行）努力，尝试

examples.text: He attempted to escape through a window.
examples.translation: 他企图跳窗逃跑。

examples.text: He attempted a joke, but no one laughed.
examples.translation: 他开了个玩笑，试图调节气氛，但没有一个人笑。

examples.text: There's no point in even attempting an explanation - he'll never listen.
examples.translation: 试图去解释是毫无意义的——他根本不会听。

more_examples.text: Study the examples first of all, then attempt the exercises on the next page.
"It would be stupid to attempt the journey in the dark." "Precisely, " he answered.
The pilot attempted a crash-landing on the beach.
The two explorers attempted an unaided walk across the South Pole.
Make sure the rope is firmly attached before attempting to climb down it.

definitions.definition: the act of trying to do something, especially something difficult
definitions.def_translation: （尤指为完成难事而进行的）努力，尝试

examples.text: She made a few half-hearted attempts to join in their conversation.
examples.translation: 他们谈话时，她半心半意地插了几句话。

examples.text: He made no attempt to be sociable.
examples.translation: 他不合群，也不试图去改变这一点。

examples.text: This is my second attempt at the exam.
examples.translation: 这是我第二次去参加那个考试。

examples.text: None of our attempts at contacting Dr James was successful.
examples.translation: 我们多次试图和詹姆斯博士取得联系，但都没有成功。

examples.text: They closed the road in an attempt (= to try to) to reduce traffic in the city.
examples.translation: 他们封闭了道路，试图减少城里的交通流量。

definitions.definition: an act of trying to kill someone:

examples.text: This is the third attempt on the President's life.
examples.translation: 这是今年第三次有人企图刺杀总统。

more_examples.text: The government has launched a new road safety campaign in an attempt to reduce the number of road accidents.
My second attempt at making flaky pastry was a bit more successful.
They had to abandon their attempt to climb the mountain.
They have begun to vaccinate children in an attempt to check the spread of the disease.
The doctors made one last desperate attempt to save the boy's life.

definitions.definition: an act of trying to score a goal in a game of football or move the ball forwards in American football

examples.text: Chelsea had several attempts on goal in the first 15 minutes.
examples.translation: 切尔西队在开场15分钟内就有好几次射门。

examples.text: Washington is averaging under six yards per passing attempt.

definitions.definition: (of a crime ) that someone has tried to commit without success

examples.text: A man is being questioned in relation to the attempted murder/robbery last night.
examples.translation: 一名男子因涉嫌昨晚的谋杀／抢劫未遂案受到盘问。

definitions.definition: to go to an event , place , etc.

examples.text: Over two hundred people attended the funeral.
examples.translation: 两百多人参加了葬礼。

examples.text: The meeting is on the fifth and we're hoping everyone will attend.
examples.translation: 会议将在5号举行，我们希望大家都能出席。

definitions.definition: to go officially and usually regularly to a place

examples.text: Which school do your children attend?
examples.translation: 你们家孩子就读哪所学校？

examples.text: I attended the classes/seminars/lectures for a month or two.
examples.translation: 这些课程／研讨会／讲座我去听了一两个月。

more_examples.text: Are you confident that enough people will attend the event?
You are cordially invited to attend our annual wine-tasting evening.
Would everyone who wishes to attend the dinner let me know by Friday afternoon?
All pupils are expected to attend school assembly.
I don't think there's any need for all of us to attend the meeting.

definitions.definition: to give attention to what someone is saying

examples.text: I'm afraid I wasn't attending to what was being said.
examples.translation: 恐怕我没注意听说了些什么。

definitions.definition: to provide a service to someone, especially as part of your job
definitions.def_translation: （尤指作为工作）服侍；陪同；看护，照料

examples.text: The queen was attended by her ladies-in-waiting.
examples.translation: 公主由其女侍臣随从侍候。

definitions.definition: to happen as a result of, and at the same time as
definitions.def_translation: 伴随…而至；（作为结果）伴随

examples.text: the publicity that attends a career in television
examples.translation: 从事电视行业必然带来的抛头露面

definitions.definition: to help someone or deal with something

examples.text: Doctors tried to attend to the worst injured soldiers first.
examples.translation: 医生们首先努力救治受伤最严重的士兵。

examples.text: I always have so many things to attend to when I come into the office after a trip abroad.
examples.translation: 我每次从国外旅行回来，一到办公室就会有一大堆的事情需要处理。

definitions.definition: the fact of going somewhere such as a church , school , etc. regularly
definitions.def_translation: （有规律地）出席，参加;到场（如去教堂，学校等）

examples.text: Attendance at lectures is compulsory.
examples.translation: 这些讲座必须去听。

definitions.definition: the number of people who go to an event , meeting , etc.
definitions.def_translation: 出席（活动、会议等）的人数

examples.text: Attendances at church are falling.
examples.translation: 去教堂做礼拜的人越来越少了。

more_examples.text: As the course becomes more difficult, there's usually a corresponding drop in attendance.
At last month's meeting, attendance was poor.
Attendance at the meeting was rather thin.
Ticket prices were lowered in an attempt to increase attendance at home games.
He failed the course because of his poor record of attendance.

definitions.definition: present with someone and helping or taking care of them :

examples.text: He never goes out without his security men in attendance.
examples.translation: 他出门必有保镖跟随左右。

definitions.definition: someone whose job is to be in a place and help visitors or customers

examples.text: a cloakroom/museum attendant
examples.translation: 衣帽间服务员／博物馆解说员

definitions.definition: someone whose job is to travel or live with an important person and help him or her

examples.text: The Prince was followed by his attendants.
examples.translation: 王子由其侍从陪同。

definitions.definition: coming with a stated thing or resulting from it

examples.text: debt and its attendant problems
examples.translation: 负债和随之而产生的问题

examples.text: There are too many risks attendant on such a large investment of money.
examples.translation: 这样巨额的投资伴有太多的风险。

definitions.definition: present with someone to help them, or present at an event , place , etc.

examples.text: attendant staff
examples.translation: 服务人员

examples.text: the attendant crowd/fans
examples.translation: 在场群众／爱好者

definitions.definition: someone who goes to a place , event , etc.
notice , thought , or interest

examples.text: Ladies and gentlemen, could I have your attention, please?
examples.translation: 女士们、先生们，请大家注意一下好吗？

examples.text: They're organizing a campaign to draw people's attention to the environmentally harmful effects of using their cars.
examples.translation: 他们正在组织一场运动，目的是使人们意识到开车对环境造成的危害。

examples.text: Wait a moment and I'll give you my full/undivided attention (= I'll listen to and think about only you).
examples.translation: 等一下，过一会儿我就可以全神贯注听你说了。

examples.text: After an hour, my attention started to wander (= I stopped taking notice).
examples.translation: 一小时后，我开始走神儿了。

definitions.definition: to make someone notice you:

examples.text: I knocked on the window to get her attention.
examples.translation: 我敲了敲窗，以使她注意到我。

definitions.definition: to watch , listen to, or think about something or someone carefully or with interest :

examples.text: If you don't pay attention now, you'll get it all wrong later.
examples.translation: 如果你现在不注意，后面就会错得一塌糊涂。

definitions.definition: the thing or person that a lot of people notice :

examples.text: He likes telling jokes and being the centre of attention at parties.
examples.translation: 他喜欢讲笑话，成为派对上的焦点。

definitions.definition: to start to think about or consider a particular thing or person :

examples.text: Many countries are starting to turn their attention to new forms of energy.
examples.translation: 许多国家现在已开始把注意力转到新型能源上来。

more_examples.text: The war has diverted attention away from the country's economic problems.
Please excuse me from the rest of the meeting - I've just received a phone call that requires my immediate attention.
He neglects that poor dog - he never takes him for walks or gives him any attention.
I prodded her in the back to get her attention.
Pay attention to what she's saying because she won't explain it a second time.

definitions.definition: special care or treatment

examples.text: The paintwork will need a little attention.
examples.translation: 油漆活需要特别下些功夫。

examples.text: If symptoms persist, seek medical attention.
examples.translation: 如果症状不减轻，请马上就医。

definitions.definition: ( especially in the armed forces ) a way of standing , with the feet together, arms by your sides , head up, and shoulders back, and not moving

examples.text: soldiers standing at/to attention
examples.translation: 立正站立的士兵

definitions.definition: a condition in which someone, especially a child , is often in a state of activity or excitement and unable to direct their attention towards what they are doing
definitions.def_translation: （尤指儿童的）注意力缺乏多动障碍

examples.text: The drug is prescribed to millions of children and a growing number of adults with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
Her oldest son has severe attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.

more_examples.text: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is a common problem among children who struggle at school.
The study suggests that children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder can benefit from participating in more outdoor activities.
The child was taking medication for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is marked by a continuing pattern of inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that interferes with functioning or development.
The website has resources for children and adults with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder and their families.

definitions.definition: the length of time that someone can keep their thoughts and interest fixed on something
definitions.def_translation: 注意广度（指将心思和兴趣集中于某一事物的时间长度）

examples.text: Young children have quite short attention spans.
examples.translation: 小孩子的注意广度很短。

definitions.definition: listening carefully

examples.text: an attentive audience
examples.translation: 全神贯注的听众

definitions.definition: If someone is attentive, they are very helpful and take care of you.
definitions.def_translation: 关心的;体贴的，照顾周到的

examples.text: He was very attentive to her when she was ill.
examples.translation: 她生病时，他对她体贴入微。

examples.text: A good teacher is always attentive to their students' needs.
examples.translation: 一个好的老师总是对学生的需要很关心。

definitions.definition: in a way that is attentive (= listening carefully or giving careful attention )

examples.text: The children sat listening attentively to the story.
examples.translation: 孩子们坐着专心听故事。

examples.text: These developments are being watched attentively.
examples.translation: 这些事态发展正受到密切关注。

more_examples.text: They listened to the message very attentively.
We had two servers waiting on us attentively throughout dinner, and we were never kept waiting.
The child, a girl of about 12, looked attentively at the newcomer.

definitions.definition: the quality of being helpful and taking care of others

examples.text: Parents worry over a school’s quality and the attentiveness of its staff.
examples.translation: 家长们对学校的质量和其员工的细心程度感到担忧。

examples.text: A condolence note should give a sense of caring and attentiveness to the person to whom it's being sent.
examples.translation: 吊唁信应该给收信人以被关怀和受照顾的感觉。

more_examples.text: These new hotels combine exclusivity with the attentiveness of a bed-and-breakfast.
He shows an obsessive attentiveness to his client‘s wishes.
New procedures are intended to increase attentiveness to passengers on long-distance flights.

definitions.definition: to make something less or weaker

examples.text: Radiation from the sun is attenuated by the earth's atmosphere.
examples.translation: 地球大气减弱了太阳辐射。

examples.text: They propose more peacekeeping troops to attenuate the violence.

more_examples.text: The tax code is one of the few tools we have in attenuating income inequality.
The noise can be supressed at source, by screening it or attenuating its power.
Despite the government's efforts to attenuate or eliminate the worst police abuses, they continued.
Engineers began to attenuate the strength of signals at chosen frequencies.
Some factors are known to attenuate the biological effects of stress.
He attenuated the line to a long, thin stroke.

definitions.definition: long and thin or thinner

examples.text: The figurines have long, attenuated necks.
examples.translation: 这些人形小雕像长着纤细的长脖子。

more_examples.text: The lawyer accepted that his client has several connections to the terrorist, but he described them as attenuated.
An attenuated market reduced private investor interest in our company.
A vaccine can be made with an attenuated virus - a live virus that has been modified to delete the serious symptoms of the illness.
The fibres had become attenuated.
The racing cyclists have a lithe, attenuated look.

definitions.definition: causing something to become less or weaker

examples.text: The substance was found to have an attenuating effect on nicotine withdrawal.
examples.translation: 据发现，这种物质可以减弱尼古丁戒断症状。

more_examples.text: Notice the attenuating force of 'a bit' in "That's a bit too much."
The material is highly attenuating, meaning it absorbs and lessens sound going through it.
Exhaustion had an attenuating effect on her feelings.

definitions.definition: the process of making something less or weaker

examples.text: The airport has undertaken a noise attenuation programme.
examples.translation: 机场已实施降噪计划。

examples.text: The drug plays a role in the attenuation of inflammation.
examples.translation: 该药物对减轻炎症有作用。

more_examples.text: Free trade should lead to the attenuation rather than the aggravation of inequalities.
In copper-wire cables, signal attenuation increases as a transmission signal travels longer distances.
Attenuation of the stress involved in surgery improves postoperative outcomes.

definitions.definition: the process or fact of making something longer and thinner

examples.text: the graceful attenuation of a Modigliani sculpture
examples.translation: （意大利艺术家）莫迪利亚尼雕塑的优雅纤细线条

more_examples.text: Free trade should lead to the attenuation rather than the aggravation of inequalities.
In copper-wire cables, signal attenuation increases as a transmission signal travels longer distances.
Attenuation of the stress involved in surgery improves postoperative outcomes.

definitions.definition: to show, say, or prove that something exists or is true

examples.text: Thousands of people came out onto the streets to attest their support for the democratic opposition party.
examples.translation: 数以千计的人走上街头声援主张民主的反对党。

examples.text: The number of old German cars still on the road attests to the excellence of their manufacture.
examples.translation: 在马路上仍可以看到相当数量的老款德国车，这表明其制造工艺十分精良。

examples.text: As his career attests, he is a world-class tennis player.
examples.translation: 他是世界一流的网球选手，其职业生涯便是最好例证。

more_examples.text: The thing is — and my wife will attest to this — I am so insensitive I probably didn't notice.
As any serious gamer will attest, online experiences can have real-life consequences.
The exporter's signature may need to be attested by a witness.
Any deletion or alteration made before the affidavit is sworn shall be attested by the commissioner.

definitions.definition: a formal statement that you make and officially say is true
the space or room at the top of a building , under the roof , often used for storing things

examples.text: I've got boxes of old clothes in the attic.
examples.translation: 我的阁楼里放着好几箱子旧衣服。

examples.text: an attic bedroom at the top of the house
examples.translation: 房子顶部的一间阁楼卧室

definitions.definition: a clear , pleasing style of language that became admired in ancient Greece early in the 1st century BC and later in other places , or a word or phrase typical of this style
definitions.def_translation: 典雅语风（公元前1世纪从古希腊兴起并传至其他地区的清新、令人愉悦的语言风格）;使用这种语风的词句

examples.text: Atticism in Rome may be dated from about 60 B.C.
examples.translation: 罗马的典雅语风可以追溯到公元前 60年左右。

examples.text: It was said that a translator of the New Testament altered an Atticism to a more common, less literary form.
examples.translation: 据说《新约》的翻译者用更日常、更口语化的语言代替了原本使用的典雅语风。

more_examples.text: The Rhodian orators were inclined to Atticism.
He argues that the impact of Atticism on the Greek language has been overstated.
He satirizes Sophists for their ignorant and pretentious use of Atticisms.

definitions.definition: clothes , especially of a particular or formal type
definitions.def_translation: （尤指特定样式或正式的）服装，衣着

examples.text: I hardly think jeans are appropriate attire for a wedding.
examples.translation: 我觉得穿牛仔裤去参加婚礼不怎么合适。

definitions.definition: dressed in clothes of a particular type

examples.text: She was attired from head to foot in black.
examples.translation: 她从头到脚都穿着黑色的衣服。

examples.text: All of the guests at the awards ceremony were elegantly/fashionably attired.
examples.translation: 参加颁奖典礼的所有嘉宾都穿着优雅/时尚的礼服。

more_examples.text: He always arrives at his office attired in a conservative, well-tailored suit.
The judges assembled for their official photo attired in their black judicial robes.
Her four children were attired in matching outfits for a day at the beach.
I was wearing jeans and not appropriately attired, according to the restaurant’s dress code.

definitions.definition: a feeling or opinion about something or someone, or a way of behaving that is caused by this

examples.text: It's often very difficult to change people's attitudes.
examples.translation: 人们对事情的看法通常很难改变。

examples.text: She takes the attitude that children should be allowed to learn at their own pace.
examples.translation: 在儿童学习步调快慢的问题上，她的态度是应顺其自然。

examples.text: He has a very bad attitude to/towards work.
examples.translation: 他的工作态度极差。

examples.text: He seems to have undergone a change in/of attitude recently, and has become much more cooperative.
examples.translation: 他的态度近来好像转变了，变得合作多了。

examples.text: I don't like your attitude (= the way you are behaving).
examples.translation: 我不喜欢你这种态度。

examples.text: That boy has a real attitude problem (= behaves in a way that makes it difficult for other people to have a relationship with him or work with him).
examples.translation: 那个孩子的态度很成问题。

more_examples.text: Her attitude has definitely changed for the better since she started this new job.
The bishop criticized the government for its "callous, uncaring attitude" to the homeless and the unemployed.
My relationship with my father played a major part in shaping my attitude towards men.
Middle age can be the prime of life if you have the right attitude.
He's often been accused of cynicism in his attitude towards politics.

definitions.definition: If you say that someone has attitude, you mean that they are very confident and want people to notice them.
a position of the body

examples.text: She lay sprawled across the sofa, in an attitude of complete abandon.
examples.translation: 她四肢摊开躺在沙发上，一副完全无拘无束的样子。

definitions.definition: relating to people's attitude towards something
definitions.def_translation: 态度的;根据（或表示）个人态度的

examples.text: Recruitment personnel agreed that there was a need for an attitudinal change in this area of business.
examples.translation: 招聘部门同意该领域在态度上需要有所转变。

definitions.definition: a lawyer

examples.text: a defense attorney
examples.translation: 辩护律师

examples.text: an attorney for the plaintiff
examples.translation: 原告律师

examples.text: a civil/criminal attorney
examples.translation: 民事／刑事律师

more_examples.text: a high-powered attorney
She's an attorney who advises companies about mergers and takeovers.
They paid a high-powered attorney to plead their case.
