The Saint Patrick's Day marchers paraded up Fifth Avenue, past the cathedral.
King's Avenue is the first right.
The broad avenues are shaded by splendid trees.

definitions.definition: a method or way of doing something

examples.text: We should explore/pursue every avenue in the search for an answer to this problem.
examples.translation: 我们应该尝试一切途径寻求该问题的答案。

examples.text: Only two avenues are open to us - either we accept his offer or we give up the fight completely.
examples.translation: 我们只有两条路可走——要么接受他的提议，要么完全放弃斗争。

definitions.definition: to say that something is certainly true

examples.text: The lawyer averred her client's innocence.
examples.translation: 那名律师坚称她的当事人无罪。

examples.text: "He's guilty, I tell you," she averred.
examples.translation: “我告诉你们，他有罪，”她一口咬定说。

examples.text: She averred that he was guilty.
examples.translation: 她一口咬定他有罪。

definitions.definition: the result you get by adding two or more amounts together and dividing the total by the number of amounts

examples.text: The average of the three numbers 7, 12, and 20 is 13, because the total of 7, 12, and 20 is 39, and 39 divided by 3 is 13.
examples.translation: 7，12和20这三个数的平均数是13，因为7，12和20的和是39，而39除以3是13。

examples.text: Prices have risen by an average of four percent over the past year.
examples.translation: 物价在过去一年中上涨了4%。

examples.text: My income's rather variable, but I earn £175 a day on average.
examples.translation: 我的收入很不稳定，但是平均每天挣175英镑。

more_examples.text: Countywide, exam results have improved by an average of eight percent.
Rates of pay are above average.
The number of spectators at football matches was lower than average last season.
The number of soldiers killed this week is much higher than the weekly average.
On average, I earn about one and a half thousand pounds a month.

definitions.definition: a standard or level that is considered to be typical or usual
definitions.def_translation: 一般水平；一般水准；平均水平

examples.text: The audience figures were lower than average for this sort of film.
examples.translation: 对于这种类型的电影而言，这样的观众人数是低于平均水平的。

examples.text: In western Europe, a seven to eight-hour working day is about the average.
examples.translation: 在西欧，一天工作7到8小时基本属于平均水平。

examples.text: On average, people who don't smoke are healthier than people who do.
examples.translation: 一般而言，不抽烟的人比抽烟的人身体健康。

examples.text: The quality of candidates was (well) below/above average.
examples.translation: 这些候选人的素质（大大）低于／高于一般水平。

examples.text: I expect to spend an average of $50 to $60 on a meal in a restaurant.
examples.translation: 我去饭店吃饭，一般一顿饭也就想花50到60英镑。

more_examples.text: His marks in English have been below average for some time now.
Tickets for such events will cost around $30 on average.
On average, people seem to go away on holiday twice a year.
I'm afraid his latest piece of work was well below average.
This chocolate cake is superb - much better that the average.

definitions.definition: to reach a particular amount as an average

examples.text: Enquiries to our office average 1,000 calls a month.
examples.translation: 我们办公室每个月平均接到1000个询问电话。

examples.text: Many doctors average (= work an average of) 70 hours a week.
examples.translation: 许多医生每周平均工作70个小时。

examples.text: Trainee accountants average (= earn an average of) £32,000 per year.
examples.translation: 实习会计师平均每年收入32000英镑。

more_examples.text: He averaged 14 strikeouts per game last season.
Ticket prices for the concert average at $45.
Towards the end of the season, the team averaged three goals a game.
The show averages a weekly audience of eight million.
Hotels in the region are expensive, averaging £100 a night.

definitions.definition: An average number is the number you get by adding two or more amounts together and dividing the total by the number of amounts .

examples.text: average earnings/income/rainfall
examples.translation: 平均工资／收入／降雨量

examples.text: The average age of the US soldiers who fought in the Vietnam War was 19.
examples.translation: 参加越南战争的美国士兵平均年龄为19岁。

more_examples.text: The average temperature worldwide has risen by about one degree Fahrenheit in the past 100 years.
The average cost of a new house has gone up by 5% to £76,500.
The average human lifespan in the developed countries has increased over the last hundred years.
The average annual rainfall in this region: 750 mm.
There will be an increase in tax for those earning in excess of twice the national average wage.

definitions.definition: typical and usual
definitions.def_translation: 普通的;平常的;中等的;一般的

examples.text: The average person on the street is a lot better off than they were 40 years ago.
examples.translation: 再普通再一般的人也要比40年前富裕多了。

examples.text: a student of average ability
examples.translation: 才智平平的学生

examples.text: The food was fairly average (= not excellent, although not bad).
examples.translation: 那里的食物很一般。

definitions.definition: an ordinary , typical person

examples.text: He says it takes him longer than the average Joe to get ready for work.
examples.translation: 他说他做准备工作的时间比普通人要长。

examples.text: He plays an Average Joe caught up in extreme events.
examples.translation: 他扮演一个陷入极端事件的普通人。

examples.text: Even your average Joe with no training wouldn’t fail this basic test.
examples.translation: 即使是没有受过训练的普通人也不会通不过这个基本测试。

more_examples.text: In the past only the rich and famous would get their teeth fixed, not the average Joe.
A huge company would probably own enough bandwidth, but an average Joe with a laptop computer wouldn't stand a chance.
I'm a typical consumer, just an average Joe.
The wealth-divide between the richest in society and your average joe on the street has become seemingly insurmountable.
Athletes not only get the benefit of the doubt; many say they are often afforded more protection than Average Joes.

definitions.definition: to have a particular number or amount as the average
definitions.def_translation: 算出的平均值是，平均为

examples.text: My annual holiday varies, but it averages out at five weeks a year.
examples.translation: 我每年的假期时间长短不等，但是平均算来是每年5周。

definitions.definition: to calculate the average of a set of numbers or amounts

examples.text: If I average out what I earn a month, it's about £1,500.
examples.translation: 如果要算算我每月平均挣多少钱的话，大约是1500英镑吧。

definitions.definition: to be or become equal in amount or number

examples.text: The highs and lows of life tend to average out in the end.
examples.translation: 人生一世，往往起起落落，到头来还算公道。

definitions.definition: in a way that is considered typical or usual
definitions.def_translation: 普通地;平常地;中等地;一般地

examples.text: He's an averagely attractive man.
examples.translation: 他是一个吸引力一般的男人。

examples.text: She enjoyed an averagely successful career as a model.
examples.translation: 她的模特生涯还算成功。

more_examples.text: "Middle class" describes people who are averagely well-off.
When I first met him he was just an averagely quiet, fairly intelligent boy.
Most biathletes have a resting heart-rate less than half that of an averagely healthy adult.

definitions.definition: strongly disliking or opposed to
definitions.def_translation: 反对的;嫌恶的;不愿意的

examples.text: Few people are averse to the idea of a free holiday.
examples.translation: 几乎没有人会反对免费假期这个主意。

examples.text: I'm not averse to (= I like) the occasional glass of champagne myself.
examples.translation: 我乐得偶尔自己来杯香槟酒。

definitions.definition: (a person or thing that causes ) a feeling of strong dislike or of not wishing to do something
definitions.def_translation: 厌恶，反感;讨厌的人（或事物）

examples.text: I felt an instant aversion to his parents.
examples.translation: 我立刻对他的父母产生了反感。

examples.text: She has a deep aversion to getting up in the morning.
examples.translation: 早上她很不愿意起床。

examples.text: Greed is my pet aversion (= the thing I dislike most of all).
examples.translation: 我最痛恨贪得无厌。

definitions.definition: a method of treating habits or types of behaviour that are not wanted or not acceptable , by causing the patient to connect them with bad feelings
definitions.def_translation: 厌恶疗法（引起患者对自己的有害习惯或行为的厌恶，以达到戒除目的）

examples.text: Despite what many people think, aversion therapy is no longer used by professional psychologists in this country.
examples.translation: 与很多人所认为的相反，这个国家的专业心理学家已经不再采用厌恶疗法了。

definitions.definition: making someone feel a strong dislike for something, or making them not want to do it

examples.text: emotionally aversive images
examples.translation: 令人心生厌恶的图像

definitions.definition: Aversive methods of stopping someone from behaving in a particular way involve doing something unpleasant to that person whenever they do something you do not want them to do.

examples.text: aversive conditioning
examples.translation: 厌恶制约法

definitions.definition: to prevent something bad from happening

examples.text: to avert a crisis/conflict/strike/famine
examples.translation: 避免危机／冲突／罢工／饥荒

examples.text: to avert disaster/economic collapse
examples.translation: 防止灾难／经济崩溃

definitions.definition: to turn away your eyes or thoughts
definitions.def_translation: 转移（目光、想法等）;把…转（向别处）

examples.text: I averted my gaze/eyes while he dressed.
examples.translation: 他穿衣服的时候我把目光转向一边。

examples.text: We tried to avert our thoughts from our massive financial problems.
examples.translation: 我们尽量不去想我们面临的严重财政问题。

definitions.definition: of or relating to birds
an illness that kills birds and can sometimes pass from birds to people
definitions.def_translation: 禽流感（可造成禽类死亡，也可传染给人类）

definitions.definition: a large cage (= area surrounded by wire or bars ) or closed space in which birds are kept as pets
the activity of flying aircraft , or of designing , producing , and keeping them in good condition
definitions.def_translation: 航空（学）；飞行（术）；航空工业

examples.text: the British Civil Aviation Authority
examples.translation: 英国民航局

examples.text: the US Federal Aviation Administration
examples.translation: 美国联邦航空管理局

examples.text: aviation fuel
examples.translation: 航空燃料

more_examples.text: Orville and Wilbur Wright were aviation trail blazers.

definitions.definition: an aircraft pilot

examples.text: Amy Johnson was a pioneering aviator who made record-breaking flights to Australia and South Africa in the 1930s.
examples.translation: 埃米•约翰逊是一位飞行先驱，她在20世纪30年代完成了到澳大利亚和南非的飞行，打破了前人的纪录。

definitions.definition: a style of sunglasses with thin metal frames and large lenses (= pieces of glass or plastic ) , usually wider on the outside edges and narrower next to the nose
definitions.def_translation: 飞行员太阳镜（通常是细镜框、大镜片，镜片外侧大，中间靠鼻梁一侧小一些）

examples.text: He wore a leather jacket and dark aviator glasses.
examples.translation: 他穿着一件皮夹克，戴着一款深色的飞行员太阳镜。

examples.text: Everyone should own a classic pair of aviator shades.
examples.translation: 每个人都应该拥有一副经典的飞行员太阳镜。

more_examples.text: She stared at me from behind tinted aviator glasses.
With his long sideburns and aviator glasses, he stood apart.
Aviator sunglasses have come in and out of fashion over the years.
The look was gold medallions, instant tan, mirrored aviator shades, and white loafers.
The actor was photographed wearing aviators.

definitions.definition: a style of glasses with thin metal frames and large lenses (= pieces of glass or plastic ) , usually wider on the outside edges and narrower next to the nose
definitions.def_translation: 飞行员太阳镜（通常是细镜框、大镜片，镜片外侧大，中间靠鼻梁一侧小一些）

examples.text: She had a new pair of aviator glasses.
examples.translation: 她有一副新的飞行员太阳镜。

examples.text: Choose curved frames to soften a square face, or aviators to balance out a strong jaw.
examples.translation: 选一款曲线镜框，让方形脸显得柔和一些，或者用飞行员太阳镜来平衡一下棱角分明的下颌。

more_examples.text: She stared at me from behind tinted aviator glasses.
With his long sideburns and aviator glasses, he stood apart.
Aviator sunglasses have come in and out of fashion over the years.
The look was gold medallions, instant tan, mirrored aviator shades, and white loafers.
The actor was photographed wearing aviators.

definitions.definition: extremely eager or interested
definitions.def_translation: 渴望的；急切的；热衷的；劲头十足的

examples.text: an avid football fan
examples.translation: 狂热的足球迷

examples.text: an avid supporter of the arts
examples.translation: 艺术活动的热心支持者

examples.text: He took an avid interest in the project.
examples.translation: 他对这个项目产生了极大的兴趣。

examples.text: She hadn't seen him for six months and was avid for news.
examples.translation: 她已6个月未曾见到他，正望眼欲穿地盼着他的音信。

definitions.definition: the quality of being extremely eager or interested

examples.text: He studied Indian history with avidity.
examples.translation: 他曾如饥似渴地学习印度历史。

examples.text: It seems I'm an ideal target for advertisers, and I am perplexed by the avidity with which they court me.
examples.translation: 我似乎是广告商的理想目标，而我对他们想要俘获我的强烈愿望感到很困惑。

more_examples.text: Teams can't rely solely on fan avidity.
People here follow weather forecasts with avidity and everyone knew that storms were predicted.
He began religious history studies with an avidity not seen in his secular childhood.

definitions.definition: in an extremely eager or interested way

examples.text: She reads avidly.
examples.translation: 她如饥似渴地阅读着书籍。

examples.text: We avidly awaited news of him.
examples.translation: 我们热切地盼望他的消息。

more_examples.text: I listened avidly to the early recordings of Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington.
He avidly follows the tennis matches on television.
Last year she began to exercise avidly and walk for two hours every day.

definitions.definition: related to the science and technology of aeronautics (= the science of designing , building , and operating aircraft )

examples.text: Aircraft today use complex avionic systems.
examples.translation: 今天的飞机使用复杂的航空电子系统。

examples.text: The company makes parts for jets, including avionic components and other systems.
examples.translation: 该公司为喷气式飞机制造零件，包括航空电子部件和其他系统。

more_examples.text: He trained in avionic engineering.
Most of the avionic advancements in small aircraft would not have been possible ten years ago.
About 20 people are employed by his company, including mechanics, avionic technicians, pilots, and office staff.

definitions.definition: the science and technology of the electronic devices used in aeronautics and astronautics
definitions.def_translation: 航空电子学;航空电子技术

examples.text: Avionics forms an important part of the defence industry.
examples.translation: 航空电子技术是国防工业的一个重要组成部分。

definitions.definition: the electronic devices of an aircraft or spacecraft
definitions.def_translation: 航空电子设备;航空电子控制系统

examples.text: The sophisticated avionics enable the helicopter to operate at night.
examples.translation: 先进的航空电子设备使得这架直升机可以在夜间飞行。

definitions.definition: abbreviation for arteriovenous malformation
definitions.def_translation: 动静脉畸形（arteriovenous malformation的缩写）

definitions.definition: an avocado (= a tropical fruit with a large round seed and thick skin ) or its green flesh

examples.text: This dish is a great way to use avos that are a bit past their best.
examples.translation: 这道菜可以非常好地利用略微过了最佳品尝期的牛油果。

examples.text: The salad is just assorted leaves with avo, boiled egg, and olives.
examples.translation: 这道色拉不过是各种菜叶配上牛油果、煮鸡蛋和橄榄。

more_examples.text: I don't think that there's much you can say about the avo and prawns.
Place the fish on a bed of asparagus, leaves, avo and tomato.
As I had no meat I used baby spinach leaves and avo.

definitions.definition: a tropical fruit with thick , dark green or purple skin , a large , round seed , and soft , pale green flesh that can be eaten

examples.text: Half an avocado contains about 160 calories.
Guacamole is a dip, spread or salad made with mashed avocado.

more_examples.text: They grow avocados which taste sensational.
I like to add some diced avocado to the dish.
Avocado farmers say the freeze was devastating to their crop.
The kitchen units are done in the avocado green that was popular in the 1970s.
An en-suite bathroom in avocado led off the master bedroom.

definitions.definition: a food consisting of crushed avocado (= the pale green flesh of a fruit with thick , dark green or purple skin and a large , round seed ) spread on toast (= bread that has been heated until the outside is hard)

examples.text: Avocado toast is an easy and very nutritious breakfast or snack.
examples.translation: 牛油果吐司是一种非常容易做而且有营养的早餐或零食。

more_examples.text: For perfect avocado toast, use fresh, crusty whole-wheat or sourdough bread.
She ordered coffee and avocado toast.
I make my avocado toast with olive oil, coriander, lime and salt.
The millionaire was quoted as saying he got rich by saving and not spending money on frivolous things such as avocado toast.

definitions.definition: to stay away from someone or something

examples.text: I try to avoid supermarkets on Saturdays - they're always so busy.
examples.translation: 我尽量避开周六去超市——那时总是人特别多。

examples.text: I'm anxious to avoid the motorway at rush hour.
examples.translation: 在交通高峰时段，我对高速公路唯恐避之不及。

examples.text: Do you think Lukas is avoiding me? I haven't seen him all day.
examples.translation: 你认为卢卡斯是不是在躲着我啊？我一整天都没见到他。

more_examples.text: If we set off early tomorrow morning we'll avoid most of the traffic.
The bus driver swerved to avoid hitting the cyclists.
We need to examine how an accident like this can be avoided in the future.
Try to avoid foods which contain a lot of fat.
He took a different route which avoids the city centre.

definitions.definition: to prevent something from happening or to not allow yourself to do something

examples.text: I try to avoid going shopping on Saturdays.
examples.translation: 我尽量不在周六去购物。

examples.text: The report studiously avoided any mention of the controversial plan.
examples.translation: 这份报告有意避而不谈那个有争议的计划。

examples.text: The plane narrowly avoided disaster when one of the engines cut out on take-off.
examples.translation: 飞机起飞时一个发动机熄火，差点酿成重大事故。

examples.text: I left the pub to avoid a fight (= prevent a fight from happening).
examples.translation: 我不想动手打架，就离开了酒吧。

examples.text: Unnecessary paperwork should be avoided (= prevented) at all costs.
examples.translation: 应该尽可能避免不必要的文书工作。

more_examples.text: If we set off early tomorrow morning we'll avoid most of the traffic.
The bus driver swerved to avoid hitting the cyclists.
We need to examine how an accident like this can be avoided in the future.
Try to avoid foods which contain a lot of fat.
He took a different route which avoids the city centre.

definitions.definition: to be determined to avoid something completely
definitions.def_translation: 像避瘟疫一样躲避，坚决避开

examples.text: I'm not a fan of parties - in fact I avoid them like the plague.
examples.translation: 我对聚会不感兴趣——实际上，我害怕聚会如同害怕瘟神。

definitions.definition: possible to avoid

examples.text: A number of illnesses are entirely avoidable.
examples.translation: 许多疾病是完全可以避免的。

examples.text: In spite of these latest threats, war may still be avoidable.
examples.translation: 尽管最近战争威胁不断，仍有可能避免开战。

definitions.definition: the act of avoiding something or someone

examples.text: The avoidance of injury is critical to a professional athlete.
examples.translation: 对于一个职业运动员来说，避免受伤是至关重要的。

definitions.definition: an area in southwestern England that was a county (= an area with its own local government ) until 1996
definitions.def_translation: 埃文郡（位于英格兰西南部，1996年撤郡）

examples.text: The hotel is in Bath, Avon.
examples.translation: 这家旅馆位于埃文的巴斯。

examples.text: A pair of barn owls were bred at a farm in Avon.
examples.translation: 埃文的一间农舍里孵出了两只谷仓猫头鹰。

more_examples.text: Her fellow teachers in Avon had organised the perfect day for her.
He is now a consultant to Avon health authority.
Experts from Avon and Somerset Police are carrying out a fingertip search of the area.

definitions.definition: to admit something or say something publicly

examples.text: He avowed that he regretted what he had done.
examples.translation: 他承认对自己的所作所为感到后悔。

examples.text: It is a society in which homosexuality is rarely avowed.
examples.translation: 这样一个社会中，很少有人公开承认自己是同性恋。

definitions.definition: a statement in which you say or admit something that you believe , support , or intend to do

examples.text: They were imprisoned for their avowal of anti-government beliefs.
examples.translation: 由于公开宣称自己的反政府信念，他们被捕入狱。

examples.text: Her public avowals to reduce crime have yet to be put into effect.
examples.translation: 她公开宣称要减少犯罪，但是其计划还有待付诸实施。

definitions.definition: stated
definitions.def_translation: 公开承认的;公开宣称的

examples.text: The government's avowed intent/purpose/aim is to reduce tax.
examples.translation: 政府公开宣称的目的是减税。

examples.text: An avowed traditionalist, he is against reform of any kind.
examples.translation: 他公开宣称自己是个崇尚传统的人，反对任何形式的改革。

definitions.definition: in a way that is stated publicly
definitions.def_translation: 公开承认地;公开宣称地

examples.text: an avowedly feminist author
examples.translation: 一个公开的女权主义作家

examples.text: They have avowedly lofty motives.
examples.translation: 他们有公开的崇高动机。

more_examples.text: This foundation is an avowedly global organization, operating in 40 countries.
Many Indian-Americans have taken an avowedly nonsectarian approach to creating institutions.
He recently wrote an article for an avowedly conservative newspaper.

definitions.definition: to pull or tear something away, especially a part of the body as a result of an accident or surgery
definitions.def_translation: （尤指因意外或手术，身体的一部分）抽出，撕脱

examples.text: Ingrown toenails may need to be avulsed.
examples.translation: 向内生长的趾甲可能需要抽出。

examples.text: the reimplantation of avulsed teeth
examples.translation: 重新植入被抽出的牙齿

more_examples.text: If you pull, you can avulse the muscle in the ventricle.
With steady traction using forceps the lesion was avulsed from its origin.
Care should be taken not to avulse the obturator vessels.
Surgical treatment is generally recommended when the avulsed bone fragments are displaced.

definitions.definition: the action of tearing away a part of the body as a result of an accident or surgery
definitions.def_translation: （因意外事故或外科手术，身体一部分的）撕脱，抽出

definitions.definition: friendly , kind , or helpful , like the expected behaviour of an uncle
definitions.def_translation: 叔伯般的;慈祥的;关怀备至的

examples.text: an avuncular, quietly spoken man
examples.translation: 慈祥和善、谈吐温和的男子

examples.text: His avuncular image belies his steely determination.
examples.translation: 他慈祥的外貌和他坚强的意志形成鲜明对照。

definitions.definition: used to express disappointment or disapproval
definitions.def_translation: （表示失望、不满、同情等时用的）呀

examples.text: He says "Aw, I thought you were somebody else."
If you don't vote, you can't go around saying, "Aw man, everything's all wrong!"
Aw gee, you said you weren't gonna cry!
Aww, you ruined it!

definitions.definition: used to show that you feel embarrassed or shy
showing a shy or a modest (= not making yourself seem important ) character or way of behaving

examples.text: He shrugged and gave us one of his aw-shucks smiles.
examples.translation: 他耸了耸肩，给了我们一个惯用的羞怯微笑。

examples.text: They're taking sort of an aw-shucks attitude and trying not to gloat.
examples.translation: 他们采取了一种谦卑的态度，并试图不幸灾乐祸。

more_examples.text: He's an aw-shucks kind of a guy.
I think his aw-shucks style and rhetorical flourishes are refreshing.
As aw-shucks as that sounds, she really does put collaboration over competition.

definitions.definition: to wait for or be waiting for something

examples.text: He's anxiously awaiting his test results.
examples.translation: 他正焦急地等待着他的测试结果。

examples.text: A marvellous reception awaited me on my first day at work.
examples.translation: 上班第一天，迎接我的是盛大的欢迎会。

examples.text: The long/eagerly awaited sequel is now available online.
examples.translation: 大家期待已久的续集已经在网上了。

definitions.definition: not sleeping

examples.text: "Is Oliver awake yet?" "Yes, he's wide (= completely) awake and running around his bedroom."
examples.translation: “奥利弗醒了吗？”“是的，他完全醒了，正在卧室里乱跑呢。”

examples.text: I find it so difficult to stay awake during history lessons.
examples.translation: 我觉得上历史课不打瞌睡太难了。

examples.text: I drink a lot of coffee to keep me awake.
examples.translation: 我喝了很多咖啡以保持头脑清醒。

examples.text: She used to lie awake at night worrying about how to pay the bills.
examples.translation: 她过去常常夜里躺在床上睡不着觉，发愁怎样付账单。

more_examples.text: The noise from their party kept me awake half the night.
It was 3 a.m. and we were still wide awake.
I'm surprised to see you awake - ten minutes ago you were sound asleep.
She lay awake listening to her sister's steady breathing.
Go and see if Tim's awake - it's time he was getting ready for school.

definitions.definition: If you are awake to something, you know about it:

examples.text: Businesses need to be awake to the advantages of European integration.
examples.translation: 实业界应意识到欧洲一体化的好处。

definitions.definition: to stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping

examples.text: I awoke at seven o'clock.
examples.translation: 我在7点钟醒了。

examples.text: She awoke me at seven.
examples.translation: 她7点时叫醒了我。

definitions.definition: to start to understand or feel something or to make someone start to understand or feel something
definitions.def_translation: （使）领悟，（使）醒悟，（使）意识到;（被）唤起

examples.text: The chance meeting awoke the old passion between them.
examples.translation: 这次邂逅使他们旧情复燃。

examples.text: Young people need to awake to the risks involved in casual sex.
examples.translation: 年轻人应该意识到，随意的性关系会带来很多危险。

definitions.definition: surgery on the brain performed when the patient is awake and able to respond to commands so that the function of the brain and nerves can be tested during the operation
to stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping

examples.text: They were awakened by the sound of gunfire.
examples.translation: 他们被炮声惊醒。

examples.text: I awakened at dawn to find him beside me.
examples.translation: 我在黎明醒来，发现他在我身边。

definitions.definition: If a wish , interest , or emotion awakens or is awakened in you, you notice it for the first time .
definitions.def_translation: 唤起（或激起）某人的（欲望、兴趣、情绪等）

examples.text: My holiday in Paris awakened a passion for French food in me.
examples.translation: 在巴黎度假使我迷上了法国菜。

definitions.definition: If you awaken someone to something, you make them notice it or make them remember it.
definitions.def_translation: 使（某人）意识到;使（某人）认识到

examples.text: I awakened him to his responsibilities for his children.
examples.translation: 我使他认识到，他应对他的孩子们承担起责任。

definitions.definition: the act of starting to understand something or feel something

examples.text: a religious awakening
examples.translation: 宗教意识的觉醒

examples.text: the awakening of public concern about the environment
examples.translation: 公众对环境开始关注

examples.text: He's in for a rude awakening (= will be shocked) when he starts work!
examples.translation: 他开始做时就会大吃一惊！

definitions.definition: to give money or a prize following an official decision

examples.text: Carlos was awarded first prize in the essay competition.
examples.translation: 卡洛斯被授予短文写作竞赛一等奖。

examples.text: The jury awarded libel damages of £100,000.
examples.translation: 陪审团作出裁定，判给受害人名誉损害赔偿金10万英镑。

examples.text: The university has awarded her a $500 travel grant.
examples.translation: 该大学发给她500美元的旅行补助。

more_examples.text: The report criticized boardroom fat cats who award themselves huge pay increases.
The referee awarded a penalty kick.
His parents saw him awarded the winner's medal.
She was awarded a medal for showing supreme courage/bravery.
The court awarded her an unspecified amount of money.

definitions.definition: a prize or an amount of money that is given to someone following an official decision

examples.text: They have authorized awards of £900 to each of the victims.
examples.translation: 他们判给每一个受害者900英镑赔偿金。

examples.text: the Academy Award for Best Director
examples.translation: 奥斯卡最佳导演奖

more_examples.text: Who did the award for Best Actress go to?
She was in London to accept an award for her latest novel.
The film won an award for its photography.
They won the award for the most promising new band of the year.
She felt a great sense of pride as she watched him accept the award.

definitions.definition: having won a prize or prizes for being of high quality or very skilled

examples.text: an award-winning author/TV series/design
examples.translation: 获奖作家／电视连续剧／设计

definitions.definition: a person who is given money , a prize , etc. by an official organization

examples.text: Click on the link below to see a list of this year's research grant awardees.
examples.translation: 点击下面的链接查看今年获得研究经费的人员名单。

definitions.definition: the act of giving something such as money or a prize following an official decision
definitions.def_translation: 颁发奖品，颁发奖金;调拨经费

examples.text: We accept no liability for anything related to the contest and the awarding of prizes.
examples.translation: 我们对与这次比赛和所颁奖项的相关事务不承担任何连带责任。

examples.text: The awarding of these grants to applicants who do not appear to meet the required standard raises serious questions.
examples.translation: 把经费拨给显得没有达到要求的申请人激起了严重质疑。

more_examples.text: He warned against any premature awarding of the title.
There are strict criteria for the awarding of a teacher license.
The awarding of a few extra points will not affect the final result.
Why should we, through the awarding of federal tax dollars, appear to give our blessing to these programs?

definitions.definition: knowing that something exists , or having knowledge or experience of a particular thing
definitions.def_translation: 意识到的;明白的;知道的

examples.text: I wasn't even aware that he was ill.
examples.translation: 我都不知道他生病了。

examples.text: Were you aware of the risks at the time?
examples.translation: 你当时意识到危险了吗？

examples.text: She was well (= very) aware that he was married.
examples.translation: 她很清楚他已结婚了。

examples.text: "Has Claude paid the phone bill?" "Not as far as I'm aware." (= I don't think so)
examples.translation: “克劳德交电话费了吗？”“据我所知没有。”

examples.text: I suddenly became aware of (= started to notice) him looking at me.
examples.translation: 我突然意识到他在看着我。

more_examples.text: People are becoming far more aware of environmental issues.
I'm very much aware of the problem.
"Were you aware of the speed you were driving at, madam?" "No, officer."
She's well aware of her strengths and weaknesses as an artist.
If I'd been aware that things were so serious, I'd have told the police.

definitions.definition: having special interest in or experience of something and so knowing what is happening in that subject at the present time
definitions.def_translation: 有…意识的;有…觉悟的;有…知识的

examples.text: to be ecologically/politically aware
examples.translation: 有生态保护／政治意识

examples.text: sexually aware
examples.translation: 有性意识的

more_examples.text: People are becoming far more aware of environmental issues.
I'm very much aware of the problem.
"Were you aware of the speed you were driving at, madam?" "No, officer."
She's well aware of her strengths and weaknesses as an artist.
If I'd been aware that things were so serious, I'd have told the police.

definitions.definition: knowledge that something exists , or understanding of a situation or subject at the present time based on information or experience

examples.text: Public awareness of the problem will make politicians take it seriously.
examples.translation: 一旦公众意识到这个问题，政客们就会严肃对待它了。

examples.text: Environmental awareness has increased dramatically over the past decade.
examples.translation: 在过去的10年中，环保意识明显增强。

more_examples.text: The leaflet has been produced with the aim of increasing public awareness of the disease.
There is a growing awareness of the seriousness of this disease.
Greenpeace works to promote awareness of the dangers that threaten our planet today.
This task is designed to test the child's spatial awareness.
The campaign has certainly succeeded in raising public awareness of the issue.

definitions.definition: covered with a liquid , especially water

examples.text: By the time I discovered the problem, the floor was awash.
examples.translation: 等到我发现这个问题时，地板已经泡在水里了。

definitions.definition: having an amount of something that is very large or larger than necessary or wanted

examples.text: The city is awash with drugs and the police are powerless to do anything about it.
examples.translation: 该城市毒品泛滥，警方对此束手无策。

definitions.definition: somewhere else , or to or in a different place , position , or situation
definitions.def_translation: 去（或在）别处；向另一方向；向一边

examples.text: Ms Watson is away on holiday until the end of the week.
examples.translation: 沃森女士度假去了，要到周末才能回来。

examples.text: Keep/Stay away from him.
examples.translation: 离他远点。

examples.text: Just go away and leave me alone!
examples.translation: 走开，别管我！

examples.text: The sight was so horrible that I had to look/turn away.
examples.translation: 这场面太可怕了，我不得不移开视线。

examples.text: The recent flood has swept away the footbridge.
examples.translation: 最近爆发的洪水把人行桥冲垮了。

examples.text: I've given away all my old clothes to charity.
examples.translation: 我已把所有的旧衣服都捐给了慈善机构。

examples.text: UKWould you like your burger to eat in or take away?
examples.translation: 你的汉堡是在店里吃还是带走？

more_examples.text: The police went after him but he got away.
The couple next door moved away last year.
He made a sudden movement and frightened the bird away.
He looked away from the computer screen to rest his eyes.
The letter blew away and I had to run after it.

definitions.definition: at a distance (of or from here)

examples.text: How far away is the station?
examples.translation: 车站离这儿有多远？

examples.text: The office is a half-hour drive away.
examples.translation: 从这儿到办公室开车去要半小时。

examples.text: We live five kilometres away from each other.
examples.translation: 我们两人的住处相隔5公里。

examples.text: Life's so much quieter away from the city.
examples.translation: 离开城市，生活清静多了。

examples.text: Oh, it's miles away (= a long distance from here).
examples.translation: 哦，远着呢。

more_examples.text: I don't like the idea of living so far away from my family.
The explosion was of such intensity that it was heard five miles away.
The nearest town is ten miles away.
The museum is just six blocks away.
Is the station far away?

definitions.definition: in or into the usual or a suitable place , especially one that can be closed
definitions.def_translation: 在老地方；在适当的地方；放到，放进（尤指封闭的空间）

examples.text: Would you put the ice cream away in the freezer?
examples.translation: 你把冰激凌放到冰箱里好吗？

examples.text: My grandparents had £800 hidden away in an old shoe box.
examples.translation: 我爷爷奶奶在一个旧鞋盒子里藏了800英镑。

more_examples.text: I told the children to put their toys and games away.
Put that knife away before someone gets hurt.
All the folders have been carefully numbered and filed away.
The diamonds are shut away in a bank vault somewhere.
At a word from their teacher, the children started to tidy away their books.

definitions.definition: gradually until mostly or completely gone

examples.text: All the snow had melted away.
examples.translation: 雪已完全融化了。

examples.text: The music faded away as the procession moved slowly up the street.
examples.translation: 随着街上的游行队伍渐渐远去，音乐声也渐渐听不见了。

examples.text: We used to while away (= spend) the weekends at my aunt's house in the country.
examples.translation: 我们过去常常在我姑母的乡间农舍中度周末。

examples.text: We danced the night away (= until the night was over).
examples.translation: 我们跳舞跳了个通宵。

more_examples.text: Haitian strongman Duvalier could feel his power slipping away.
The sound of his footsteps gradually died away.
He could feel his strength ebbing away.
As the years passed, the memories faded away.
He gambled away all of our savings.

definitions.definition: in the future

examples.text: My English exam's only a week away and I haven't even started to prepare.
examples.translation: 再有一周就要考英语了，可我还没有开始复习呢。

more_examples.text: We're having a holiday in August, but that seems a long way away.
Christmas is only two months away.
The announcement of the winner is just a few minutes away now.
Don't worry about your driving test yet - it's weeks away.
With the concert only a few days away, the band are practising hard.

definitions.definition: continuously or repeatedly , or in a busy way
definitions.def_translation: 连续不断地;一直;劲头十足地

examples.text: I was still writing away when the exam finished.
examples.translation: 考试结束时我还在拼命写个不停。

examples.text: Chris has been working away in the garden all day.
examples.translation: 克里斯在花园里一刻不停地干了一整天。

examples.text: We were chatting away at the back and didn't hear what he said.
examples.translation: 我们一直坐在后面聊天，没有听到他说什么。

more_examples.text: She was singing away to herself as she worked.
They were hammering away at the door.
They were just chatting away while the fire raged around them.

definitions.definition: An away match or game is played at an opposing team's sports ground .
definitions.def_translation: （比赛）客场的，在对方场地举行的

examples.text: We lost the away game but won both home games.
examples.translation: 我们输了客场的那场比赛，但是在主场的两场比赛都赢了。

examples.text: UKEverton unveiled their new yellow-and-blue away strip (= clothing worn by a team at away games).
examples.translation: 埃弗顿队公布了新款黄蓝相间条纹客场比赛服。

definitions.definition: a day that you spend somewhere that is not your home or usual place of work
definitions.def_translation: （不在工作场所的）外出研讨日;（不在家的）外出日

examples.text: Many sign up for conferences just because they feel like an awayday.
examples.translation: 很多人报名参加会议就是想要外出一天。

examples.text: They had an awayday at a local hotel to discuss the proposed changes to the department.
examples.translation: 他们在当地的一个宾馆举行了外出研讨日活动，讨论改造部门的一些提议。

definitions.definition: a feeling of great respect sometimes mixed with fear or surprise

examples.text: I've always held musicians in awe.
examples.translation: 我对音乐家们总是肃然起敬。

examples.text: As children we were rather in awe of our grandfather.
examples.translation: 小的时候，我们对祖父非常敬畏。

examples.text: You can't help but stand in awe of (= respect greatly and fear slightly) powerful people.
examples.translation: 在权势人物面前，你不由自主会毕恭毕敬。

more_examples.text: He's such an important man that I'm rather in awe of him.
We looked on in awe as the gymnast performed her routine.
The scenery was absolutely stunning - I remember gazing in a state of awe over the landscape.
We listened in awe because her voice was remarkable for someone so young.
As the champion played his shots, spectators looked on in awe.

definitions.definition: to cause someone to feel awe

examples.text: I was awed but not frightened by the huge gorilla.
examples.translation: 那只硕大无比的大猩猩让我惊叹不已，但是我并不怕它。

examples.text: Her paintings have awed and amazed the public for half a century.
examples.translation: 半个世纪以来，她的画作一直令公众叹服。

examples.text: The audience was awed into silence by her stunning performance.
examples.translation: 她的出色表演令观众叹为观止，大家都屏气凝神地欣赏。

definitions.definition: causing you to feel great respect or admiration
definitions.def_translation: 令人敬畏的;令人钦佩的

examples.text: Niagara Falls really is an awe-inspiring sight.
examples.translation: 尼亚加拉瀑布确实是一处令人叹为观止的风景。

examples.text: Her knowledge of computers is quite awe-inspiring.
examples.translation: 她对计算机的精通令人叹服。

definitions.definition: in a way that causes you to feel great respect or admiration
definitions.def_translation: 令人敬畏地;令人钦佩地

examples.text: The railway line twists through the mountains, offering magnificent, awe-inspiringly beautiful views.
examples.translation: 铁路线蜿蜒穿过群山，景色壮丽，令人惊叹。

examples.text: The young director shows an awe-inspiringly precocious mastery of technique.
examples.translation: 这位年轻的导演对技巧的掌握成熟老道，令人钦佩。

more_examples.text: Greil Marcus's book Lipstick Traces, a "secret history of the 20th century", remains awe-inspiringly great.
The book is fascinating, witty, challenging, poetic and awe-inspiringly intelligent.
The Palace was awe-inspiringly, breath-takingly beautiful.
Sam Riley is awe-inspiringly convincing as Ian Curtis.

definitions.definition: feeling great respect , sometimes mixed with fear or surprise

examples.text: We stood there in awed silence.
examples.translation: 我们安静地站在那里，心存敬畏。

examples.text: "How does she manage to run so fast at her age?" he asked in awed tones.
examples.translation: “她这个年纪怎么能跑得这么快？” 他用敬畏的语气问道。

more_examples.text: The film inspires awed admiration.
She described his powers in awed terms.
An awed silence greeted the end of the performance.

definitions.definition: (of a ship's anchor ) lifted off the sea bed

examples.text: With a cry of "Anchors aweigh!" they prepared to set sail.
examples.translation: 随着一声大喊“起锚了！”，他们准备扬帆起航。

more_examples.text: They shouted things like "Anchors aweigh!" and "Ship ahoy!"
An anchor that is aweigh is one that has just begun to pull on the rope or chain as it is being hauled in.

definitions.definition: causing feelings of great admiration , respect , or fear
definitions.def_translation: 令人敬畏的;令人惊叹的;令人惊惧的

examples.text: An awesome challenge/task lies ahead of them.
examples.translation: 摆在他们面前的是一项令人望而生畏的巨大挑战／艰巨任务。

examples.text: awesome scenery
examples.translation: 令人赞叹的景致

definitions.definition: extremely good

examples.text: You look totally awesome in that dress.
examples.translation: 你穿那件礼服真是漂亮极了。

definitions.definition: in a way that causes feelings of great admiration , respect , or fear

examples.text: In the profound silence I surveyed the awesomely beautiful Himalayan landscape.
examples.translation: 在深沉的寂静中，我享受着喜马拉雅山令人叹为观止的美景。

more_examples.text: No doubt the Badlands were awesomely grand the day that Michael Eastman snapped his photograph.
The Government must begin the awesomely difficult task of rebuilding the public's trust.
The setup also works awesomely as a wireless music solution.
I have seen a lot of his movies, and in this one he is just awesomely bad.

definitions.definition: extremely well or extremely

examples.text: I have no idea how this trick works, but it does! Awesomely!
examples.translation: 我真的不知道这个办法是怎么奏效的，反正就是行通了！太棒了！

examples.text: I don't believe I can possible explain how awesomely awful he truly is.
examples.translation: 我觉得我完全不可能说清楚他究竟有多坏。

more_examples.text: No doubt the Badlands were awesomely grand the day that Michael Eastman snapped his photograph.
The Government must begin the awesomely difficult task of rebuilding the public's trust.
The setup also works awesomely as a wireless music solution.
I have seen a lot of his movies, and in this one he is just awesomely bad.

definitions.definition: the ability to cause great admiration , respect , or fear
definitions.def_translation: 令人敬畏或惊叹的要素

examples.text: Science can show us the awesomeness of nature.
examples.translation: 科学可以向我们展示大自然的奇妙。

more_examples.text: For all the car's awesomeness, I cannot say that it is truly comfortable.
What he lacks in stature and sheer awesomeness, he makes up for in heart.
There's no denying the awesomeness of the gardens.

definitions.definition: the quality of being extremely good or impressive

examples.text: They're just jealous of your awesomeness.
examples.translation: 他们只是嫉妒你这么厉害。

more_examples.text: For all the car's awesomeness, I cannot say that it is truly comfortable.
What he lacks in stature and sheer awesomeness, he makes up for in heart.
There's no denying the awesomeness of the gardens.

definitions.definition: used to say that something is extremely good, or that you are extremely pleased

examples.text: The video has gone viral! Awesomesauce!
examples.translation: 这个视频像病毒般迅速蹿红了！太开心了！

more_examples.text: It's amazing! Awesomesauce!
It was served with bacon bread pudding! Awesomesauce!
The 20 entries all received an overall score of "awesomesauce!" from our panel of esteemed judges.

definitions.definition: extremely good or pleasing
definitions.def_translation: 极好的;极度让人开心的

examples.text: The message on the front of the card was: You are awesomesauce!
examples.translation: 贴在车前面的留言说：你是个大好人！

more_examples.text: This work of art history is best described as "awesomesauce".
14 quotes have been tagged as awesomesauce.
"Awesomesauce" says US astronaut Jack Fischer of historic spacewalk.
I can't take anyone seriously who says coolbeans, awesomesauce, etc.

definitions.definition: filled with feelings of admiration or respect
definitions.def_translation: 肃然起敬的;充满敬畏的;感到惊惧的

examples.text: an awestruck admirer/fan/visitor/tourist
examples.translation: 充满敬畏之情的崇拜者／追星者／参观者／游客

examples.text: I could tell she was impressed from the awestruck expression on her face.
examples.translation: 从她肃然起敬的表情我可以看出她被深深打动了。

definitions.definition: extremely bad or unpleasant
definitions.def_translation: 极坏的;恶劣的;糟糕的;令人极不愉快的

examples.text: He suffered awful injuries in the crash.
examples.translation: 他在撞车事故中受了重伤。

examples.text: We had awful weather.
examples.translation: 我们碰上了糟糕的天气。

examples.text: She has an awful boss.
examples.translation: 她的老板极难相处。

examples.text: What an awful thing to say!
examples.translation: 说这种话，太不像话了！

examples.text: Would life be so awful without a car?
examples.translation: 没有车，日子就那么难过吗？

examples.text: The food was awful.
examples.translation: 这食物糟糕透顶。

examples.text: She'd been ill and she looked awful.
examples.translation: 她一直在生病，气色糟透了。

more_examples.text: If the party is awful, we can always leave .
The hotel was awful! To begin with, our room was far too small.
The awful spectre of civil war looms over the country.
It's a good job they didn't go camping last weekend - the weather was awful.
They live downwind of a pig-farm and sometimes the smell is awful.

definitions.definition: very great

examples.text: I don't know an awful lot (= very much) about art, but I'm learning.
examples.translation: 我对艺术知道的不是特别多，但是我正在学。

examples.text: Fortunately it won't make an awful lot of difference if I don't pass the test.
examples.translation: 幸好，我就是过不了考试也没有太大的关系。
